author: C4SS
title: An Attack on Tech Freedom, an Assault on Dissent
content:
We live in a world of

surveillance states

,

militarized police

, and

crackdowns


on


dissent

. Meanwhile, corporate behemoths will often ally with the state to

shut down dissident speech

 or aid and abet

surveillance

. 


In this context, it’s important for independent groups to develop and maintain encrypted communications platforms and independent web hosting.


But the Trump administration recently

declared

 that an Italian tech collective is a “Specially Designated Global Terrorist” for doing exactly this. That Italian tech collective is Autistici/Inventati, which operates the independent web hosting service

NoBlogs

 along with other digital infrastructure projects for activists.


The State Department

claims

 that “Autistici/Inventati (A/I Collective) is an Italy-based extremist group that builds and operates the digital infrastructure for violent Antifa cells and other far-left militants across the world.”


That emphasis on

Antifa cells

 reflects the Trump administration’s ongoing attempt to crack down on dissent by demonizing “Antifa.” This has been the explicit aim of

NSPM-7

, and it has been central to prosecutions of anti-ICE activists, including the

Minneapolis 15

 and the

Prairieland defendants

.


In their obsessive desire to tie all leftist and anarchist dissent to “Antifa,” the Trump administration has made blatantly false claims. The State Department asserts: 


Oregon-based Rose City Antifa has relied on A/I Collective tools and services to organize and incite violent and criminal acts domestically, including an attack on Customs and Border Patrol helicopters that led to a federal indictment. Rose City Antifa also used A/I Collective tools and services to disseminate doxing lists and release illegally obtained personal information of Federal Immigration and Customs Enforcement, along with calls for targeted attacks on ICE agents in the streets and “in their homes.” 


However, as Torch Antifa Network

points out

, Rose City Antifa does not use A/I services and did not carry out these actions. Federal officials are instead referring to communications by Rose City Counter-Info, an entirely different group that does use A/I services. “Rose City” is a common nickname for Portland, Oregon. Not all groups that use this phrase in their name are identical. These outright falsehoods were credulously amplified by reporters at

Fox News

 and the

National Review

. 


Yet despite the incompetence this shows, designating A/I Collective as a “Specially Designated Global Terrorist” poses a very serious threat. As C4SS’s Technical Coordinator William Gillis

put it

, “This is a HUGE attack on basic free speech. Words completely fail me when addressing the potential loss to the anarchist movement of — as the US names it — 5,500 mailing lists, and 10,000 blogs.”


The State Department emphasizes users of the A/I Collective’s services that have allegedly committed crimes, including sabotage and terrorism. But many users are engaged in clearly First Amendment protected activities. These include anarchist bookfairs, antifascist researchers who study and expose far-right groups, the blog of a peer-reviewed academic journal, and an anarchist podcast and radio show. 


The “Specially Designated Global Terrorist” classification subjects Autistici/Inventati to sanctions. This means that purely based on a decree from the U.S. executive branch, anyone who engages in transactions with the A/I Collective becomes vulnerable to legal reprisal. As a result, the collective’s website has been

taken down

,

PayPal

 has blocked their account, and the Italian bank

Banca Etica

 plans to close their account. 


These sanctions have had a devastating effect on the A/I Collective. As

Sabot Media

reports

, “On September 6, eleven days after the United States placed the Italian technology collective on its terrorism sanctions list, A/I announced that the collective itself will close and that the email, blogging, hosting and communications services it has provided for a quarter century will soon be discontinued.” 


This is a chilling precedent. The executive branch can unilaterally declare that a provider of web hosting, email services, and other communications infrastructure is a “Specially Designated Global Terrorist.” By doing so, they can impose sanctions, and thereby destroy that provider. This can impose serious costs on speakers, organizers, and researchers that use the providers’ services. And …

title: BANDA : Il n’y a pas eu de sixième, mais il y a eu, il y a et il y aura une SEXTA-Mexique. Invitation à la Pépinière Cybernétique d’Art et de Graphisme Numérique. « Une réalité rebelle et en résistance contre l’Intelligence (haha) Artificielle »
content:
BANDA : Il n’y a pas eu de sixième, mais il y a eu, il y a et il y aura une SEXTA-Mexique.

En mémoire de Jorge Salinas Jardón l’ouvrier insoumis, travailleur des télécoms, que la répression de Fox et de Peña Nieto à Atenco n’a pas brisé, que les mensonges de la 4T n’ont pas séduit, qui restera à jamais notre compañero de la Sexta-Mexique. Juillet 2026.

Aux personnes individuelles, groupes, collectifs, mouvements, organisations et autres, adhérent·es à la Sexta-Mexique,

Parce qu’il y a des chercheuses. Parce qu’il y a des disparus. Parce qu’il y a des personnes déplacées. Parce qu’il y a des peuples originaires. Parce qu’il y a des autrEs. Parce qu’il y a des afrodescendants. Parce qu’il y a des migrants. Parce qu’il y a des enseignants rebelles. Parce qu’il y a des étudiants. Parce qu’il y a des activistes. Parce qu’il y a des militants.

Parce qu’il y a des employées. Parce qu’il y a des chauffeurs. Parce qu’il y a des paysans. Parce qu’il y a des ouvriers. Parce qu’il y a des livreurs. Parce qu’il y a des personnes qui défendent leur quartier. Parce qu’il y a des gens de toutes les couleurs. Parce qu’il y a des croyants religieux. Parce qu’il y a des artistes. Parce qu’il y a un graphisme insoumis. Parce qu’il y a un en bas et à gauche.

Parce qu’il y a des personnes comme ça, qui ne se rendent pas, qui ne se vendent pas, qui ne capitulent pas

Par ces personnes et avec elles, il y a eu, il y a et il y aura la Sexta Mexique,

C’est pour cela que nous vous invitons à la

Pépinière Cybernétique d’Art et de Graphisme Numérique. « Une réalité rebelle et en résistance contre l’Intelligence (haha) Artificielle »

Il sera possible de partager toute sorte de matériel graphique numérique créé par des humains (sans l’usage de l’IA) qui promeuve, diffuse et visibilise la lutte anticapitaliste et pour la vie au Mexique et dans le monde. Et il faudra qu’il puisse être utilisé par des personnes, des groupes, des collectifs, des mouvements et des organisations en résistance et en rébellion. À savoir :

Affiche Apps et logiciels libres Auto-collant Bannières BD Broderie Calligraphie Caricature Collage Dessin Dessin animé

Enseigne Fanzine Flyer Graffiti Identité visuelle

Illustration Impression Mème Modèles de conception (graphique, web, logo, livre, journal, revue) Peinture Peinture murale Photo Textile Toile Typographie Vidéo

Ce que l’on inventera pour l’occasion

Ou tout ce qui pourra servir à la lutte contre le système de manière graphique et créative. Il s’agit ainsi de soutenir celles et ceux qui luttent et résistent contre le système, en offrant du matériel graphique pour informer de leurs luttes, les promouvoir et les diffuser.

Dès lors qu’on partagera un matériel graphique via ce support, on acceptera qu’il puisse être reproduit, diffusé et modifié librement, mais en veillant toujours à reconnaître le crédit de l’œuvre à son auteur, autrice ou auteur·ice selon les modalités spécifiées propres à chacun·e. Il n’y a pas de copyrights mais bien une origine créatrice.

Pour partager du matériel, vous pouvez envoyer un courrier en précisant le crédit des créateur·euses et la catégorie dans laquelle vous considérez qu’il doit être inclus. Les contributions que nous recevrons à la suite de l’invitation seront classées dans différentes rubriques selon leur catégorie. Elles seront ensuite publiées dans une section spéciale du site Internet d’Enlace Zapatista.

Le mail pour les envois est semillerocibernetico@gmail.com

Les fichiers qui pèsent plus de 25 megas devront être partagés via des plateformes numériques de transfert de fichiers et l’envoi du lien de téléchargement à l’adresse mentionnée. Dans le cas où les fichiers seront déjà hébergés sur un site virtuel et peuvent être partagés et téléchargés par ce biais, envoyer uniquement le lien vers l’adresse du site web ou, dans le cas des vidéos, le nom de la chaîne ou de la plateforme sur laquelle ils sont hébergés. Nous faisons confiance à votre bon sens collectif pour choisir la façon la plus simple de partager votre matériel.

Recommandations : il est conseillé de parcourir les différents médias libres et blogs d’information et de dénonciation. Vous y trouverez une multitude de luttes, de résistances et de rébellions qui attendent votre regard et en ont besoin.

author: Sabot Media
title: Neunzehn Tage vor Ablauf der Frist stellt Autistici/Inventati den Betrieb ein [D/EN]
content:
The Italian communications collective survived raids, surveillance and server seizures for 25 years. Eleven days after the United States designated it a global terrorist organization, A/I says the risk to its users has become too great to continue.


Autistici/Inventati is shutting down. On September 6, eleven days after the United States placed the Italian technology collective on its terrorism sanctions list, A/I announced that the collective itself will close and that the email, blogging, hosting and communications services it has provided for a quarter century will soon be discontinued. “A/I is shutting down,” the collective wrote. “The Autistici/Inventati collective is shutting down and will soon discontinue all of the services we provide.” The announcement turns what had been a developing fight over sanctions, infrastructure and political speech into something considerably more concrete. Twenty-five years of independent communications infrastructure are being dismantled.


And A/I says plainly why. The collective said continuing to operate now risks exposing its users, collaborators and communities to legal and financial consequences simply because they interact with an organization the United States has designated a Specially Designated Global Terrorist. “The possibility that our work may cause legal and financial consequences to those who are close to us,” A/I wrote, “leaves us no choice.” The shutdown comes nineteen days before the expiration of the temporary wind-down period the U.S. Treasury Department created when it sanctioned A/I. That deadline is September 25. A/I did not make it there.


Eleven days


On August 26, the Treasury Department’s Office of Foreign Assets Control added Autistici/Inventati to its Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List under Executive Order 13224. Treasury accused A/I of supplying “specialized digital architecture, tools, and services” to what the department described as Antifa cells and other violent far-left organizations. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the government would bring the “full weight” of its economic tools against what it called their enablers and continue cutting their financial lifelines “until they are eliminated.”


Eleven days later, one of the organizations named in that announcement said it could no longer safely exist.


The United States did not issue an order instructing Autistici/Inventati to turn off its servers. That distinction matters. It also does remarkably little to soften what happened. Economic sanctions operate through banks, registrars, payment processors, hosting companies and other intermediaries that suddenly have their own reasons to sever ordinary relationships with a designated entity. Washington does not necessarily need to seize a server when it can make everybody touching the server afraid to keep touching it.


A/I’s September 6 announcement describes precisely that pressure. The collective says the danger now extends beyond itself to users and people who merely “have something to do with us.” Every additional relationship becomes another possible point of exposure. In other words, the pressure does not stop at the sanctioned organization. It radiates outward until isolation becomes the rational response.


The wind-down that wasn’t


OFAC simultaneously issued Counter Terrorism General License 36 when it designated A/I, temporarily authorizing transactions ordinarily necessary to wind down relationships involving the collective. The authorization runs through September 25. On paper, that provided roughly one month for an orderly retreat. Reality moved considerably faster.


Within days of the designation, autistici.org became unreachable through ordinary DNS resolution. A/I continued trying to keep its infrastructure accessible and its users informed. Now, in announcing its closure, the collective itself warns that similar disruptions may happen again without warning before users can complete their migrations. It says instructions for backing up blogs, mailboxes and websites are coming, but it cannot guarantee what parts of its infrastructure will remain reachable in the meantime.


This is what “wind-down” looks like outside Treasury’s vocabulary. People scrambling to recover years of email. Blogs needing emergency backups. Websites looking for somewhere else to live. Administrators spending their remaining time evacuating an infrastructure instead of maintaining it. The machinery is administrative. The …

author: Julius Gavroche
title: The US government attacks internet privacy
content:
The email and website provider

Autistici/Noblog.org

 has been designated as a “global terrorist threat”.


from

lundimatin

 #531, 02/09/2026


Founded in 2001, Autistici/Inventati is a volunteer and free provider of email, websites, mailing lists, blogs, and communication tools focused on privacy for users who prefer not to rely on corporate platforms. According to the U.S. State Department, Autistici/Inventati hosts “roughly 16,000 mailboxes, 1,500 websites, 5,500 mailing lists, and 10,000 ‘blogs’” on its custom-built platform. On August 26, 2026, the U.S. government designated the Italian collective as a “Specially Designated Global Terrorist,” citing its “far-left” politics.


The slide towards dictatorship through the gradual abandonment of democratic “rules” is not new. Nevertheless, the “Designation of Autistici/Inventati as a Specially Designated Global Terrorist”

[1]

 by the US State Department

[2]

 on August 26 is not insignificant.


Autistici/Inventati not only provided a messaging service considered one of the most confidential in the world, but also a whole range of services, still confidential, for just about everything related to information and communication via the internet. The first, fundamental point is that A/I was simply respecting the original idea of ??the web, this now “outdated” idea which stipulated that “information wants to be free” on the internet, a mantra tirelessly chanted by the early builders of the global web in the 1990s,

[3]

 including by Tim Berners-Lee, the inventor of hypertextualisation, and therefore of internet navigation. Of course, we have long known that the major web companies have relegated this idea to the realm of antiquity after having nonetheless capitalised on it. This idea of ??free communication has been perverted, with Google positioning itself at the forefront of this freedom-crushing movement,

[4]

 through the means we all know about.


You who are reading this article, if your email goes through gmail, hotmail or wanadoo, please switch to a confidential email service: for a month now Google, Microsoft or Orange have been systematically sending A/I messages to spam, and since August 26, it has been impossible to connect to A/I regardless of the browser used.


The State Department claims: “Autistici/Inventati (A/I Collective) is an Italy-based extremist group that builds and operates the digital infrastructure for violent Antifa cells and other far-left militants across the world. A/I’s cadre of radical hackers and tech developers provide a full spectrum of services – including encrypted chats and email, web hosting, secure video conferencing and streaming, anonymity shields, and a suite of other technological tools – to Marxist, anarchist, and other left-wing extremist groups in the United States, Europe, and elsewhere. These tools are specifically designed to support the operations of far-left terrorist networks, built to enable them to organize, recruit, communicate, disseminate propaganda, share target information and tactics, and carry out violent attacks – all while remaining anonymous, untraceable, and beyond the reach of the law.”


According to the State Department, A/I hosted 16,000 email accounts, 1,500 websites, and 5,500 mailing lists. Individuals who funded A/I (which offered its users the opportunity to contribute from time to time, approximately once a year, without any obligation) are now liable under US law for supporting a terrorist organisation. The US “designation” concludes with a somewhat ludicrous list of claims of responsibility that A/I relayed, without any evidence being provided of A/I’s actual participation in the alleged violent acts.


As Serge Quadruppani had clearly shown in his pioneering work at the time,

L’Antiterrorisme en France

 (1989) and then with

La Politique de la peur

 (2011), or Philippe Godard in

Il Consenso nell’epoca del terrorismo

 [

The Consensus in the Age of Terrorism

; published by Elèuthera, 2018], anti-terrorism has never aimed to put an end to the state of extreme violence or terror in our societies, but rather to maintain it, by justifying state violence.


By prohibiting us from using a website perfectly aligned with the fundamental principles of what some call “the first internet,” the US government

[5]

 is unilaterally depriving us of a tool that in no way contradicted democracy, including its current imperfect form.

[6]

 Providing information is not the same as organizing …

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: “Architects of Atrocities”: Amnesty Says Iran Committed Crimes Against Humanity in 2022 Crackdown
content:
Four years ago today, the Woman, Life, Freedom uprising erupted in Iran after the death in custody of Zhina Mahsa Amini, a 22-year-old Kurdish woman who had been arrested by Iran’s “morality police.” Over the next three months, hundreds of thousands of people took to the streets protesting against Iran’s discriminatory compulsory veiling laws.


Amnesty International has released a new report concluding that the repressive measures used by Iranian authorities to crush the Woman, Life, Freedom protests in 2022 constitute crimes against humanity. Investigating the killings of 377 protesters and bystanders in 2022, Amnesty International’s report calls for international criminal investigations into 87 Iranian officials.


“Crimes against humanity are system crimes. This means that they require resources, organization, structures, and state policy,” says Raha Bahreini, a human rights lawyer and researcher on Iran for Amnesty International, which also recently condemned the U.S-Israeli war on Iran. “We’ve been very clear that the suffering of victims of crimes against humanity must not be instrumentalized or weaponized by actors such as [the] U.S. and Israel,” she adds.

title: İran saldırılarının ABD üslerindeki yıkımı fotoğraflandı
content:
CBS News’in yayımladığı fotoğraflarda, Suudi Arabistan’daki Prens Sultan Hava Üssü ile Kuveyt’teki Buehring ve Arifjan kamplarında meydana gelen hasarın boyutu görülüyor.

Prens Sultan Hava Üssü’nden bir karede, İran saldırısında ağır hasar gören Boeing E-3 Sentry tipi erken uyarı uçağı yer alıyor. Uçağın arka bölümü ve kuyruğunun parçalandığı, gövdesinin ise yandığı görülüyor. Üsten yayımlanan diğer fotoğraflarda binaların ve kışlaların ağır hasar aldığı görülüyor.

Kuveyt’teki Camp Buehring’den fotoğraflar ise saldırıların askeri araçlar, konteynerler ve yapılarda yarattığı tahribatı ortaya koyuyor. Camp Arifjan’da da bir binanın ağır hasar gördüğü bildirildi.

Fotoğrafları CBS News’e gönderen ABD’li askerlerden biri, üslerdeki hasarın kamuoyuna yeterince aktarılmadığını savundu. Asker, “Bu, üslerimize yönelik ciddi bir hasar. Orada gözlerimiz kapalı şekilde dururken yüzümüze yumruk yiyoruz.” ifadelerini kullandı.

Aynı asker, ABD’nin bölgedeki üslerini yeterince savunamadığını belirterek, “Bu üsleri savunmuyoruz. Sadece yok olmalarını izliyoruz.” dedi. Pentagon ise CBS News’in konuyla ilgili yorum talebine yanıt vermedi.

Fotoğrafların yayımlanması, ABD Savunma Bakanlığı Genel Müfettişliği’nin İran savaşıyla ilgili yayımladığı son raporun ardından geldi. Rapora göre İran’ın saldırıları Kuveyt, Bahreyn, Katar, Birleşik Arap Emirlikleri, Suudi Arabistan, Irak, Umman ve Ürdün’deki ABD mevzilerini hedef aldı.

Raporda ABD ordusunun ekipman kayıplarının 3,7 milyar dolara kadar ulaştığı ve yaklaşık 60 uçağın hasar gördüğü veya kaybedildiği belirtildi. Savaşın 29 Haziran’a kadar ABD Savunma Bakanlığı’na maliyetinin ise 33,4 milyar dolar olduğu hesaplandı.

CBS’nin yayımladığı fotoğraflar, ABD yönetiminin İran saldırılarının etkisine ilişkin açıklamalarıyla sahadaki hasarın boyutu arasındaki tartışmayı da yeniden gündeme getirdi.

author: Franck Dick Rosete
title: BARMM polls plagued by militarization, fraud, violence
content:
A highly militarized environment may create a “climate of fear” that could result in voter disenfranchisement.


MARANTAO, Lanao del Sur — Upon arriving at polling centers for the first-ever Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) Parliamentary Elections on September 14, soldiers were seen guarding the entrances.


They were the ones allowing voters to enter.


Katungod Bangsamoro, an independent local observer accredited by the Commission on Elections (Comelec), recognized the need for the presence of state armed forces but legitimate concerns should be heard as a highly militarized environment may create a “climate of fear” that could result in voter disenfranchisement.


“Given the BARMM’s complex history of militarization, election authorities must assess whether the presence of security forces in and around polling precincts, however well-intentioned, undermines voters’ sense of safety and their genuine freedom of political choice,” the local observer said in its preliminary statement released on September 15.


Two military armored carriers were seen several meters away from an established entrance at Marawi City Pilot Elementary School. According to the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP), nearly 12,000 soldiers were deployed across the BARMM.


Voters form a queue outside Marawi City Pilot Elementary School during the first-ever BARMM Parliamentary Elections on September 14, 2026. Photo by Franck Dick Rosete/Bulatlat


In Sultan Guro Central Elementary School (SGCES), one of the polling centers in Marantao, Lanao del Sur, there were no massive people roaming around the area, far different from the crowded situation in Daanaingud-Bacong Elementary School in the same municipality. Aside from allowing voters to enter the polling center per batch (10 persons only), soldiers stationed in SGCES roamed the area, asking those done casting their votes to exit the school premises. 


Military personnel also guarded the polling precincts in SGCES after closing the polls at 7 p.m., preventing unauthorized individuals from entering or going near the precincts while electoral board members are processing the transmittal of election returns.


A soldier guards the polling precincts after the polls were closed at Sultan Guro Central Elementary School during the first-ever BARMM Parliamentary Elections on September 14, 2026. Photo by Franck Dick Rosete/Bulatlat


Moreover, Katungod Bangsamoro also noted the augmentation of Philippine National Police (PNP) personnel as part of the electoral boards. “[T]he psychological impact of having armed police officers inside polling centers must also be considered.”


PNP personnel served as “special electoral boards” following the reported withdrawal of around 800 teachers from their participation in the BARMM Parliamentary Elections. In Lanao del Sur alone, 71 teachers reportedly skipped their poll duties, the reasons for which are not yet known.


Irregularities were also observed. In SGCES, many voters who were on their way out after casting their votes did not have marks of indelible ink on their fingers. In fact, military personnel were the ones putting the ink to avoid multiple entry, contrary to Comelec rules.


A soldier puts indelible ink to a voter as the latter was about to exit Sultan Guro Central Elementary School after casting his vote during the first-ever BARMM Parliamentary Elections on September 14, 2026. Photo by Franck Dick Rosete/Bulatlat


The absence of indelible ink on voters raised suspicions as this is first checked by the chair of the electoral board before handing the ballot to avoid multiple voting. The chair must also be the one to apply the indelible ink on the forefinger nail of the voter, or any other nail.


Moreover, under Comelec rules, the ballot of a voter shall be rendered as spoiled if he or she refuses to have his or her fingernail stained with the ink.


An electoral board member told

Bulatlat

 that many voters refused the ink to be applied on their fingers, citing religious prohibition. This response also raised questions considering that many voters did not refuse when the soldiers stained them with the indelible ink.


On the other hand, in a polling precinct at SGCES, an automated counting machine (ACM) was reportedly overheating, with an electoral board member continuing to feed a ballot without the presence of the voter which is also contrary to the rules. The explanation was that voters could no longer wait …

author: David Swanson
title: Don’t Look Away
content:
Displaced Palestinians staying in flimsy tents. Photo by Zyad Abu Mariam, courtesy of Norwegian Refugee Council.

By Kathy Kelly, World BEYOND War, September 15, 2026

Over the past two years, World BEYOND War members have been grateful to ally with a coalition called Global Solidarity for Peace in Palestine. In weekly online meetings, Palestinians living in the West Bank update our coordinating committee about their experiences amidst ongoing, U.S. provisioned Israeli genocide against Palestinians. They speak with anguish about people in the West Bank and Gaza enduring siege, hunger, disease, forcible displacement, bereavement, poisoning, contamination, and the frustrations of an Occupying force that constantly wages pogrom-style attacks.

Our Palestinian coalition members living in the West Bank long to extend a helping hand to people trapped in Gaza. They recently raised the dilemma of Gazan children who have already lost years of education. Many live in wretched tent encampments, lack adequate food and medicine, and struggle with psycho-social traumas because of having lost their loved ones.

In June of 2026, the Norwegian Refugee Council estimated that 170,000 households in Gaza, equivalent to nearly one million people, were living in tents. “Another 5,000 households sleep outdoors,” they reported, “while 52,000 households live in overcrowded shelters.” As Gazans enter the rainy and cold months of winter, they still lack emergency shelter items. They need plastic sheeting, plywood, and rope. Genocidal war and siege drive the crisis they face as the Israelis continue destroying Gazan homes and shelters and imposing restrictions which block desperately needed relief.

A Palestinian NGO, PYALARA, (Palestinian Youth Association for Leadership and Rights) suggested that our coalition could assist with practical measures to assist Gazan children who are eager to learn but who lack basic school supplies. The children are bereft of paper, pencils, pens, books, desks, and bookbags.

Recently, for UN News, an interviewer spoke with Julia Dicon, the Director of Education for UNRWA (United Nations Relief and Works Association). Dicon described what education means for Palestine refugee children and why sustained support is critical. She expressed deep respect for the many ways that Palestinians maintain capacities to educate their children, even in dire times.

The interviewer asked her to tell a story about Palestinian young people who represent courage in the face of unspeakable adversity as they continue efforts to learn and teach.

Dicon talked about two Gazan sisters, 17-year-old Tala Mousa and her 15-year-old sister, Farah Mousa, who were recently named winners of the 2026 Middle East Earth Prize. The young women regularly looked at rubble surrounding their home which Israel had bombed. They longed to rebuild, but how? Together, using their scientific knowledge, they developed a practical way to transform rubble into reusable blocks for garden beds, pavement, and partitions.

Tala and Farah represent the potential of Gazan youth to make a significant difference in their community’s lives and futures. We have an opportunity to assist Gazan youth through supporting their education, in practical ways. In doing so, we can also help build community among Palestinians living in the West Bank and those who are under siege in Gaza.

We are living in harsh, dark times. Daily, we witness Israel’s war crimes, imposing siege, pogroms, and vicious attacks that traumatize Palestinians. PYALARA, conscious of how children are suffering, encourages us not to turn away. Their guidance and testimony are indispensable.

If you select to make a recurring contribution of at least $15 per month, you may select a thank-you gift. We thank our recurring donors on our website.

author: groundxero

content:
Our imperial overreach began 25 years ago with the War on Terror. It is being brought to a grim conclusion by Donald Trump’s war on Iran.


 


CHRIS HEDGES


SEP 13, 2026


 


Donald Trump, whose war on Iran is the greatest strategic 

blunder

 in United States history, is not responsible for triggering the decline of the American empire, but he is responsible for its fatal denouement.


 


This is the end.


 


U.S. bases in the oil-rich Persian Gulf have been 

damaged

 or 

destroyed

 and I expect will not be rebuilt. Our allies, even those in Europe, are abandoning us. The decadence and immorality of American society, embodied in the vulgarity, stupefying ignorance and cruelty of Trump, are the defining characteristics of the Empire. The Global South, horrified at the Empire’s flagrant disregard for international humanitarian law, including the enabling of genocide in Gaza, sees us as the enemy. Abu Ghraib Prison may have receded from our consciousness, but for the rest of the world, its

 

images

 of U.S. soldiers and contractors sadistically 

humiliating and torturing

 imprisoned Iraqis has replaced the Disneyfied version of America we once exported. The war on Iran, which has 

disrupted

 the world’s oil supply, is rapidly 

pushing

 the global economy over the cliff.


 


We are going down. And we will bring many with us.


 


Osama Bin Laden may be in a watery grave in the North Arabian Sea. Al-Qaeda may be a shadow of itself. But Bin Laden’s most fervent dreams have been realized in the last twenty-five years of gross miscalculations of the Empire — its squandering of trillions of dollars on military debacles and the ascendancy of our version of 

Ubu Roi

, 

Donald J. Trump.


 


Rather than defeating supposed enemies, the U.S. has swelled their ranks. It and its colony, Israel, are 

the most

 

reviled nations on the planet. Every advance by Iran in its asymmetrical war against the Empire is cheered across the globe.


 


The humiliating defeats, the diversion of resources and at least 

$8 trillion

 to mount one war after another, which has killed an 

estimated

 4.5 to 4.8 million people, has hollowed the Empire out. Its infrastructure is crumbling. Its democratic institutions are impotent. It survives on an unsustainable $ 40 trillion 

debt

. The jewels of its democracy, including its education system, fair elections and a free press, are discredited and degraded.


 


An abandoned working class, crippled by economic insecurity and a government that steadily strips away social programs that keep those in distress afloat, is propagandized to believe the palpable decline is the work of traitors and enemies within. It has led Trump supporters to turn on the very institutions and ideals designed to sustain democracy. The usual targets of fascism — the “radical left,” Muslims, migrants, intellectuals, artists, people of color and journalists — are persecuted under laws such as 

The Espionage Act

. Lies permeate the airwaves buttressing the self-delusion that once internal enemies are silenced, or eradicated, the glory days of the Empire, defined by hyper-nationalism, patriarchy, stable jobs and white supremacy, will return.


 


Violence against internal enemies along with election fraud are openly advocated by Trump and his court of sycophants, buffoons, grifters and Christian fascists. Attempting to bribe voters by promising them $5,000 if Republicans win the midterms, along with Trump’s contempt for the constitutional order, is the transparent admission that U.S. democracy is a farce.


 


George W. Bush, who was appointed to the presidency by judicial 

fiat

, planted these seeds of lawlessness and impunity. Trump has brought them to floraison.


 


Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) 

goons

, masked and offered the kind of impunity that allowed the torture and killing of innocents in Iraq and Afghanistan, terrorize U.S. cities. They carry out military-style raids against unarmed civilians that look no different than those the Empire carried out in Fullujah or the Helmand Province in Afghanistan. They are setting up a network of squalid internal concentration camps.


 


The tools of subjugation the Empire used abroad, including the stripping of civil liberties and the implementation of mass surveillance, were legalized at home with the passage of 

The Patriot Act

, with its watchlists, informants and racial and religious profiling.


 


Empires in decay …

author: Moataz Hagag
title: How agricultural reclamation village Al-Ray bel-Rash became beset by weapons, drugs and the informal gold trade
content:
Two armored vehicles, a police car and two small open pick-up trucks entered the Al-Ray bel-Rash village in the Edfu district in northern Aswan in the afternoon of September 5, part of a security campaign targeting the home of Abdallah al-Hugairy. 


An exchange of fire that would last around two and a half hours was about to begin.


Hugairy has repeatedly been implicated in incidents of gunfire and forcefully stealing cars, motorcycles and tuk tuks from villagers and

dahaba

(people who work in informal gold mining), according to  Ahmed al-Bagga, a farmer from the village.

 He also says Hugairy is among those accused of killing a villager about two years ago.


Bagga tells Mada Masr that Hugairy fought most of Saturday’s skirmish alone, before jumping from the roof of his house to that of a neighbor, whose livestock, “his source of livelihood,” was hit and killed by a stray bullet in the fray. Bagga says two police personnel were wounded in the uproar: the assistant investigator at the Edfu district, Mohamed Zidan, and a police conscript. News circulating about the incident recorded Zidan’s injury, without mentioning the conscript or further detailing the raid.


Despite all this, Hugairy managed to escape from the village, while security forces raided another house, killed its owner — whom Bagga describes as a drug dealer — and then withdrew from the area. 


The next day, Hugairy returned to the village, “as if nothing had happened,” Bagga says.


The eruption of violence at the beginning of the month exposes the recurring pattern that has taken root in Al-Ray bel-Rash. The village sank into deprivation in the 1990s, isolated from essential resources and services. Residents describe how these conditions gave space and air to the flourishing of informal and illicit arms and drug trades. 


Occasional security interventions and clashes, increasing over recent years, have done little to break these trades’ entrenchment. 


Instead, the volatile dynamic has deepened the isolation of both the village and its residents.


The village, whose name roughly translates to sprinkle irrigation, was established only around six decades ago as part of a state-sponsored agricultural reclamation project. One of its farmers, Shazly, describes it to Mada Masr as still “the most famous village growing tomatoes in the governorate” of Aswan.


So how has the village become a place whose name, for those in the area, is synonymous with drugs and weapons?


The beginning of the road linking the desert to the village of Al-Ray bel-Rash in northern Aswan, September 2025. Photo: Mada Masr


*

*

*


Al-Ray bel-Rash was established in 1968 as part of an agricultural reclamation project implemented by the

Upper Egypt Agricultural Company

 in Wadi al-Radisiyah.

 


When the company was

liquidated

 in 1990, the lands it had reclaimed from the desert were broken up and re-apportioned to individual farmers — the company’s former employees — at reduced prices per feddan payable with a low interest rate over a 30-year period, on condition that the employees accept their redundancy from the company and be barred from applying to government jobs in the future.


It’s here that the problems begin.

According to an agricultural administration employee speaking to Mada Masr on condition of anonymity, when the

Upper Egypt company

was active, it cultivated only around 300 of the roughly 1,500 feddans that fall within the village’s official boundaries.


But when the employees became land owners, they needed to make a living from farming and accumulate money to pay off the land’s cost and the interest. So, they sought to cultivate their new plots to the fullest possible extent.


The village was not equipped to host all of this activity. Wadi Radisiyah begins at the villages of Tunab and Hasaya near the Nile, deepening eastward into the desert and passing through the villages of Bassaly, Zaqlouna, Raiya, reaching Al-Ray bel-Rash and Umm Salama before approaching the Nile again at the neighboring Adwa village.

title: Kutschpferde ohne Schutz: Vorstösse in Stadt, Kanton und Bund
content:
Anwohner:innen dokumentierten diesen Sommer in Interlaken

Kutschpferde im Dauereinsatz

: dasselbe Pferd um 14 und um 21 Uhr desselben Tages, bei 31 Grad. Das kantonale Veterinäramt erklärte zu einer Temperaturlimite, die Tierschutzgesetzgebung biete

«keine Grundlage für derartige Anordnungen»

. An dieser Lücke setzen die drei Vorstösse an.


Die

Tierschutzverordnung

 regelt, wie viel Bewegung ein Pferd mindestens braucht – nicht, wie lange es vor der Kutsche arbeiten darf. Hitzeschutz schreibt sie für Wasserbüffel, Yaks und Schweine vor, für Pferde im Geschirr fehlt jede Bestimmung. Die Motion von Nationalrätin Meret Schneider (Grüne) beauftragt den Bundesrat deshalb, die Verordnung zu ergänzen: mit einer Höchstdauer des täglichen Einsatzes und Ruhezeiten, Einsatzgrenzen bei Hitze und einem Fachkundenachweis für das gewerbliche Kutschieren.


«Die Tierschutzverordnung kennt Hitzeschutz für Wasserbüffel, Yaks und Schweine – nur für Pferde, die bei grosser Hitze Kutschen über den Asphalt ziehen, fehlt jede Regel», sagt Meret Schneider. «Diese Lücke kann der Bundesrat auf dem Verordnungsweg schliessen, ohne Gesetzesänderung.»


Wie gross die Risiken auch für Menschen sind, zeigte der

Unfall im Val Roseg

 vom 16. August: Die Bremsleistung einer Kutsche reichte nicht mehr aus, ein Pferd stürzte, das Fuhrwerk prallte gegen einen Baum. Eine 73-jährige Frau starb, zwölf Mitfahrende wurden verletzt. Wer ein Tierfuhrwerk lenkt, braucht nach Bundesrecht einzig das vollendete vierzehnte Altersjahr, eine Prüfung besteht nicht.


Im Grossen Rat verlangt Susanne Clauss (SP) mit der Interpellation «Hitzefrei für Kutschpferde?» Auskunft darüber, wie viele Pferde im Kanton Bern für gewerbliche Kutschfahrten eingesetzt werden, wie der Kanton kontrolliert und was aus den Meldungen aus der Bevölkerung wird.


«Verbindliche Regeln nehmen den sorgfältigen Betrieben nichts weg», sagt Susanne Clauss. «Sie stoppen die Betriebe, die ihr Pferd von Mittag bis Mitternacht durcharbeiten lassen.»


In der Stadt Bern fragt Tobias Sennhauser, Stadtrat von Tier im Fokus (TIF), welche Bewilligungen die Stadt für Kutschenbetriebe erteilt, welche Vorgaben für die Kutschenfahrten des städtischen Tierparks gelten und wie weit ihr Handlungsspielraum reicht – bis hin zu einem Verbot.


«Die Kutsche ist Unterhaltung auf Kosten der Tiere», sagt Tobias Sennhauser. «Wir wollen von der Stadt wissen, ob sie im 21. Jahrhundert daran festhalten will, Pferde zwischen Tram, Bussen und Menschenmengen einzuspannen.»


Andere Städte sind weiter:

Berlin

 lässt seit 2019 ab 30 Grad im Schatten keine Kutschfahrten mehr zu, Barcelona, Madrid und Málaga haben den gewerblichen Kutschenbetrieb ganz beendet.

Kutschpferde ohne Schutz: Vorstösse in Stadt, Kanton und Bund

 erschien zuerst auf

Tier im Fokus (TIF)

author: webadmin
title: Convicted Huntsman ‘Bloods’ A Young Child At The Flint & Denbigh Hunt
content:
At the beginning of this year the Hunt Saboteurs Association was sent some of the most disturbing images we have seen in over sixty years of campaigning against bloodsports.


They show a young child having their face smeared with the blood of a freshly slaughtered fox by huntsman Conall McGrath, then of the Flint & Denbigh Hunt who operate in North Wales.


On receiving the images, the HSA immediately forwarded them to the police but, many months on, we are not aware of any action being taken.


Conall McGrath holds a dead fox aloft as a small child approaches. Terrier men smile behind them, one is holding a terrier.


The practice shown in the images is known as ‘blooding’. Blooding is an initiation ritual practised by hunts which ‘celebrate’ a hunter’s first successful kill. Prince Harry wrote about being ‘blooded’ after stalking a stag as a 15 year old boy.


Blooding relies on the animal being freshly killed as – obviously – the blood needs to be wet. The images show a fox whose blood is still fresh. It is inconceivable that the fox in the image is anything other than a fox killed moments earlier by the hunt.


In the first image, McGrath can be seen holding the body of the fox and encouraging the hounds to attack it as the child approaches. Behind the child stand two grinning terrier men: Rob Smith Jnr on the left, and Joe Scillario on the right, holding a terrier.


In the second image, McGrath grabs the child’s hair with one hand and smears blood on their face with the other.


The photographs are believed to have been taken on the 17th January 2026. On this same date, hounds from the hunt were filmed out of control on the busy A55, footage which we published at the time. You can watch the video sent in by an

unsuspecting motorist here

.


To protect their welfare, the HSA is concealing the identity of the child.


McGrath smears the dead fox’s blood on the child’s face


Incredibly, McGrath was convicted of illegal hunting just a few months before the images were taken, when he was a whipper-in for the

Blackmore and Sparkford Vale Hunt

. This incident made national news when the hunt were caught on camera hunting and killing a fox by North Dorset Hunt Sabs.


McGrath was one of four men convicted for his role in illegal fox hunting at Pelsham Farm in December 2023.


An HSA spokesperson commented:


“Over twenty years on from the passing of the Hunting Act, these harrowing images show continued illegal hunting and the utter determination of today’s hunters to induct a new generation of vulnerable youngsters into their sick and criminal activities.


This week we have already highlighted safeguarding concerns in relation to a private school whose ‘Games Coach’ was recently convicted of illegal hunting, whilst pupils of the school were present.These failings are a direct result of a Hunting Act that is not fit for purpose – we need much stiffer penalties to deter the likes of McGrath.


Following the recent consultation on trail hunting the government must immediately follow through on its manifesto promise and come down hard on those who break the law and hunt wildlife with packs of dogs”.


The post

Convicted Huntsman ‘Bloods’ A Young Child At The Flint & Denbigh Hunt

 appeared first on

Hunt Saboteurs Association

title: Chris Packham Joins Woman Living In Pig Crate During 21-Day Stand Against Factory Farming
content:
Wildlife presenter and former RSPCA president Chris Packham joined Michelle Farnham inside a pig farrowing crate outside the National Gallery today, where she has been living for over a week to highlight suffering on British factory farms.

Animal Rising campaign lead Michelle Farnham is living inside the crate 24 hours a day as part of a living art installation outside the National Gallery. She does not leave the crate at any point, day or night, from 1 to 22 September. [1]

Animal Rising campaign lead Michelle Farnham is living inside the crate 24 hours a day as part of a living art installation outside the National Gallery. She does not leave the crate at any point, day or night, from 1 to 22 September. [1]

Farrowing crates are still used in approximately 92% of indoor pig production systems, confining more than 200,000 mother pigs each year [2] - but Animal Rising says the crates are just one part of a much wider problem, and is calling on the Government to end factory farming by 2040.

Farrowing crates are still used in approximately 92% of indoor pig production systems, confining more than 200,000 mother pigs each year [2] - but Animal Rising says the crates are just one part of a much wider problem, and is calling on the Government to end factory farming by 2040.

The action follows Animal Rising’s release of hidden-camera footage documenting the life of Luna, a mother pig kept in a farrowing crate on a Suffolk factory farm. Over 19,000 people have now signed a petition calling for her release to sanctuary. [3] [4]

The action follows Animal Rising’s release of hidden-camera footage documenting the life of Luna, a mother pig kept in a farrowing crate on a Suffolk factory farm. Over 19,000 people have now signed a petition calling for her release to sanctuary. [3] [4]

Chris Packham joined Michelle in the crate today (09/09/26) on her ninth consecutive day living inside behind its bars in Trafalgar Square.

Animal Rising is now calling on the government to commit to the end of factory farming by 2040, arguing the scale of suffering in intensive farming systems can no longer be ignored.

Visiting today, Chris Packham said:

Packham stepped down as president of the RSPCA in December 2024 following Animal Rising investigations into RSPCA Assured farms and slaughterhouses, saying he had seen “no meaningful change” in response to the findings. [5] [6]

Michelle Farnham has spent years examining conditions inside British animal farms. She studied Animal Management for two years and has since reviewed hundreds of hours of undercover footage recorded inside UK pig farms, working alongside veterinary and animal welfare law experts to assess conditions, including during Animal Rising’s investigations into RSPCA Assured farms and slaughterhouses.

Farrowing crates can confine mother pigs for four to five weeks at a time around giving birth and nursing their piglets, leaving them unable to turn around or take more than a step forward or back. Sows are put through this cycle repeatedly, returning to the crates with successive litters until they are eventually culled.

Animal Rising released its investigation into Luna’s life last week, after documenting her for a month on a factory farm in Suffolk. Hidden-camera footage narrated by Michelle shows Luna giving birth and nursing her piglets while confined inside a farrowing crate, unable to turn around or freely interact with her piglets. Animal Rising is calling for Luna to be released to a sanctuary home that has been offered to her, alongside its wider call for the Government to commit to ending factory farming by 2040.

Over 19,000 people have signed the petition since Luna’s story was released.

Michelle and Animal Rising spokespeople are available for interviews and comment at the crate outside the National Gallery. Please email press@animalrising.org or call +44 1225 29 6691 to arrange.

title: La rentrée pas classe de Carrefour
content:
Ton dessin a été envoyé à l’équipe de L214, qui se chargera de le remettre au siège de Carrefour. Donne un coup de patte supplémentaire : signe la pétition ci-dessous

Carrefour doit s’engager à réduire de moitié le nombre d’animaux tués d’ici 2030, pour sortir de l’élevage intensif !

Contre la souffrance des animaux, agissez à nos côtés avec un don.

Choisissez le montant de votre don

À l’occasion des soldes d’été, les bénévoles de L214 se mobilisent pour demander à Carrefour de ne plus « solder la vie » des animaux. Ils rappellent que l’enseigne recourt massivement à l’élevage intensif pour faire baisser les coûts – au prix de la vie des animaux.

L214 organise une manifestation hors norme dans le plus grand magasin Carrefour de France, à Villiers-en-Bière (Seine-et-Marne) : 120 militants ont brandi les portraits d’animaux photographiés dans des élevages intensifs fournissant Carrefour. Le même jour, des bénévoles ont exposé ces portraits devant des dizaines de supermarchés Carrefour, partout en France.

L214 publie une nouvelle enquête sur un élevage intensif du Maine-et-Loire approvisionnant Carrefour. Les dindes y vivent dans leurs déjections, elles montrent des signes de souffrances, jusqu’à en mourir, pour certaines. À l’issue de la période d’élevage, les dindes sont violemment chargées dans des cages non conformes, direction l’abattoir. Lire le communiqué de presse

Une trentaine d’activistes de L214 mènent une action d’infiltration dans un supermarché Carrefour situé à proximité du siège international du groupe à Massy. En répandant des dizaines de milliers de plumes ensanglantées dans les rayons, ils dénoncent le recours massif du groupe à l’élevage intensif et la mise à mort de près de 10 millions d’animaux par mois pour l’enseigne.

L214 dévoile une enquête dans un élevage de cailles à Grosbreuil (Vendée) approvisionnant en oeufs la Filière Qualité Carrefour. Derrière des mentions telles que « cailles libres de voler », « élevage respectueux des animaux » ou « produits responsables », 95 000 cailles vivent entassées, sur un sol entièrement grillagé, et dans des conditions d’hygiène épouvantables.

L214 révèle une enquête dans un élevage de lapins à Beaupréau-en-Mauges (Maine-et-Loire) qui approvisionne la Filière Qualité de Carrefour. Des milliers de lapins sont enfermés dans des cages. Carrefour s’est pourtant engagé, à plusieurs reprises, à ce que 100 % de la viande de lapin de ses marques soit issue d’animaux qui n’ont pas été élevés en cage.

Les bénévoles de 37 villes de France manifestent devant des magasins Carrefour et y saupoudrent des “confettis” demandant à l’enseigne de s’engager à réduire de moitié le nombre d’animaux tués pour ses rayons.

L214 distribue plus de 10 millions de décorations festives militantes, symbolisant les plus de 10 millions d’animaux que Carrefour abattra au mois de décembre. Ces “confettis” seront répandus pendant les fêtes dans les rayons des magasins Carrefour. Ils ont pour objectif de sensibiliser la clientèle de cette enseigne, et d’encourager Carrefour à réduire de moitié le nombre d’animaux tués.

35 antennes locales de L214 se sont mobilisées devant des supermarchés Carrefour. Les militants ont déployé des tickets de caisse de 12 mètres qui énuméraient une partie des 330 000 individus tués chaque jour pour Carrefour. En ce week-end de Black Friday, et à l’aide d’un coupon, les clients ont interpellé leurs magasins et réclamé auprès de l’enseigne une réduction de 50% d’animaux tués.

L214 publie une enquête sur deux élevages intensifs de cochons situés à Plénée-Jugon et à Éréac dans les Côtes-d’Armor, en Bretagne. Ces élevages appartiennent à Bernard Rouxel, président de la coopérative Cooperl et fournisseur de Carrefour pour sa Filière Qualité. Lire le communiqué de presse Carrefour déclare que les pratiques observées dans cette exploitation sont “absolument inacceptables” et suspend ses approvisionnements en provenance de l’élevage SCEA Rouxel. Bien que cette réaction renforce la pertinence de la demande portée par L214, elle reste insuffisante au regard des révélations présentes dans notre enquête. La veille, L214 avait porté plainte pour mauvais traitements contre les élevages EARL Sainte-Marie et SCEA Rouxel, et pour pratiques commerciales trompeuses contre Carrefour, auprès du procureur du tribunal judiciaire de Saint-Malo.

title: Tierschutz kritisiert den Abbau der Taubenschläge
content:
Gemeinsame Medienmitteilung von Stadttauben Schweiz und Tier im Fokus (TIF)


Bern, 7. September 2026 – Die Stadt Bern muss sparen. Das bekommen nun auch die Tauben zu spüren: Von 2027 bis 2030 will der Gemeinderat beim Taubenmanagement jährlich 81’254 Franken einsparen. Betroffen ist der Tierpark Bern, der die Stadttauben im Auftrag der Stadt in mehreren Schlägen betreut. Er soll

«Teile dieses Angebots» einstellen

, wie es im Finanzplan des Gemeinderats heisst.


Der Verein Stadttauben Schweiz kritisiert diesen Abbau. «Betreute Taubenschläge sind das wirksamste Mittel, um die Zahl der Stadttauben tief und die Tiere gesund zu halten», sagt Nina Bachellerie, Präsidentin des Vereins.


Seit der Gemeinderat die Taubenkontrolle 2010 dem Tierpark Bern übertragen hat, ist die Population von über 10’000 Tieren auf rund 1’500 gesunken – betreut in acht Schlägen in der Altstadt und den Quartieren. Die Tiere werden

jährlich geimpft und tierärztlich kontrolliert

, ihr Kot fällt im Schlag an statt an Fassaden und Haltestellen: rechnerisch rund 85 Tonnen weniger pro Jahr. Das Berner Konzept gilt als «weltweit einzigartig», wie kürzlich

im «Bund» zu lesen war

 – Städte aus ganz Europa lassen sich die Praxis erklären.


Interpellation verlangt eine Bilanz


Was das Taubenmanagement kostet, ist bekannt: rund 240’000 Franken pro Jahr (Stand 2022). Was es der Stadt erspart, hat der Gemeinderat hingegen nie beziffert. Tier im Fokus (TIF) hat deshalb die Interpellation «Was leistet das Berner Taubenmanagement für die Stadt?» im Berner Stadtrat eingereicht. Sie verlangt Auskunft über die vermiedenen Reinigungs- und Instandsetzungskosten sowie über den Beitrag der Taubenschläge an den Gesundheitsschutz, den Tourismus und den Erhalt des UNESCO-Welterbes.


«Der Gemeinderat kennt die Kosten des Taubenmanagements, aber nicht seinen Nutzen», sagt Tobias Sennhauser, Stadtrat von Tier im Fokus (TIF). «Mit dem Abbau der Taubenschläge steigt das Risiko, dass die Verschmutzungen an den Fassaden wieder zunehmen.»


Der Stadtrat entscheidet in der Budgetdebatte vom 10. und 17. September über die Kürzung.

author: hsa_oryx
title: One Giant Leap: Stag Jumps Hunt Supporters to Escape the Quantock Staghounds
content:
A terrified stag made a dramatic leap for his life on the 24

th

 August, leaping over hunt supporters who were attempting to prevent him from escaping onto land where the Quantock Staghounds could not follow.


Incredible footage of the hunt and the stag’s subsequent escape – albeit temporary – was captured by

Dorset Borders Hunt Sabs

 and

North Dorset Hunt Sabs.


The stag makes a leap for life, as one of the hunt supporters who had been trying to scare him back ducks for cover. Image credit: Dorset Borders Hunt Sabs.


The chase began early that morning, at around 6am at Upcott Farm, Bicknoller. The stag had been chased from maize fields at Heddon Oak, near Crowcombe, over the Minehead railway line, and through woodland owned by Fountain Forestry, before seeking refuge in a small area of miscanthus grass. 


By 8am the hunt had surrounded the grass, and entered hounds, flushing the stag out into the open.


The stag is flushed out of the miscanthus grass into the open.

Image credit North Dorset Hunt Sabs


The land where the stag emerged adjoined a road. On the opposite side of the road lay safety – land that is out of bounds to the hunt, offering some refuge to the stag.


Hunt supporters had lined the road and attempted to prevent the stag from making his escape.


In the video, you can hear one hunter loudly cracking a whip, whilst others shouted and screamed, in an attempt to frighten the stag back towards the hunt.


But the stag did not turn back.


Wayne Gregory, convicted huntsman for the Vale of Taunton & Banwell Harriers attempts to scare the stag back towards the hunt.

Image credit: Dorset Borders Hunt Sabs.


Instead, he leapt for his life, breaking out directly above four men who were screaming and flailing their arms in an attempt to stop him.


The stag landed on the other side and entered the land beyond the hunt’s reach.


But his respite was short lived…


Other hunt supporters positioned on the far side of the out-of-bounds land, spotted the stag as he emerged on the other side and alerted the huntsman. The hounds were promptly brought around and put straight back on the stag’s scent.


The terrified animal was pursued for 4 hours in total, but managed to escape. 

Image credit North Dorset Hunt Sabs.


They pursued him for a further two hours, before the hunt finally lost the stag completely.


But it isn’t guaranteed that the stag survived the trauma. Extreme fear and distress can bring on a severe condition called capture myopathy in deer. If you have ever witnessed an injured deer at the roadside, the animal can sometimes succumb to this condition, rather than the injuries sustained in a collision.


Organs and muscle damage can occur over a period of hours or even days, with the animal displaying symptoms such as weakness, ataxia (poor muscle control), paralysis, hyperventilation and ultimately death.


Even when a hunt is unsuccessful, it can still result in the animal’s death.


When the stag leapt over the hunt supporters, the front supporter frantically flailing his arms before taking a tumble, was none other than Wayne Gregory, the recently convicted huntsman of the Vale of Taunton & Banwell Harriers.


Gregory pleaded guilty after he was caught illegally hunting a fox during a hunt meet in Chilton Trinity on 26 November 2025. He was filmed by Somerset Hunt Sabs using a drone as he directed the hounds to flush then hunt a fox. Immediately after the trial, he declared to the waiting press and public that he was off to change out of his suit to go hunting with the Quantock Staghounds.


Wayne Gregory, convicted huntsman of the Vale of Taunton and Banwell Harriers, and chief stag-shooer for the Quantock Staghounds.

Image Credit: Somerset Sabs


Gregory’s adaptability to switch which quarry he likes to torment, is proof that ‘trail hunting’ is nothing but a cover for illegal hunting.


The Quantock Staghounds routinely invoke various smokescreens for their activities.

Covert hunt sabs

 attending the first meet of the QSH in 2025 witnessed a laughable speech from a hunt master who claimed that the hunt conducts “Research and Observation” of stags, but also stating that ‘trails may be laid’.


An earlier victim of the QSH taken on 25/09/2025.

Image Credit: HSA


The hunt also invokes the “flushing to guns” smokescreen, and claims to be ‘rescuing a casualty animal’. Given the level of terror inflicted on these animals by these hunt thugs is it any wonder there are so many ‘casualty …

author: Katie Surma
title: Every 3 Days an Environmental Defender Is Murdered
content:
Trump’s 2025 dismantling of the US Agency for International Development had serious implications for defenders.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

Every three days someone is killed for defending nature.

In 2025, watchdog group Global Witness documented 124 such deaths worldwide, a toll researchers say is likely only a fraction of the total number because repression and armed conflict make many deaths impossible to verify.

The victims included Indigenous people, small-scale farmers and community organizers peacefully protecting forests, farmlands, waterways and other ecosystems from harm posed by companies, criminal syndicates and governments, according to the report released on Tuesday.

Mining was once again the industry most often linked to the killings. Global Witness also identified alleged links to organized crime or contract killings in more than a third of the cases.

In some regions, extractive industries and organized crime target the same territories.

That’s playing out in parts of Colombia, according to the report, which was also released in Spanish. It remained the deadliest country for environmental defenders, with 39 people killed. Nearly half were Indigenous people, and another 15 were small-scale farmers. Many of those victims were caught in conflicts over land, illegal mining and cultivation of the coca plant grown for cocaine. The report pointed to suspected links to organized crime in 17 cases and to contract killings in five more.

The epicenter of the violence was in Colombia’s biodiverse Cauca region, located near the Ecuadorian border and Pacific cocaine-trafficking routes. Coca production there has increased fivefold over the past decade, according to Global Witness, while armed groups are driving deforestation, illegal mining and the destruction of rivers.

Colombia has topped Global Witness’ rankings for several years. But researchers cautioned that the high number is in part a reflection of the nation’s relatively open society, making it easier to track and verify killings compared to more repressive countries such as China, which doesn’t appear on the list at all.

Brazil was the second-deadliest country in 2025, recording 26 killings, double the number reported the year before. All but one case stemmed from land conflicts. Researchers said half of the attacks occurred in the Amazonian states of Rondônia and Pará, where the “agricultural and extractive frontiers continue to encroach on small-scale farming communities, with illegal loggers, miners and cattle ranchers driving incursions, land grabs and lethal violence.”

Brazilian officials’ failure to demarcate and recognize Indigenous land rights has also contributed to the escalating violence, researchers said.

Next on the list are the Philippines and Honduras, which each recorded 12 killings, followed by Mexico with 10, Guatemala with eight, Peru with four and Nicaragua and Ecuador with three each.

In Honduras, 10 of the defenders killed were small-scale farmers. All of those murders were linked to organized crime, while corporate interests were implicated in eight of them, according to the report.

Global Witness has tracked the killings and disappearances of environmental defenders since 2012. The 2025 figures bring the total number of killings documented since then to 2,375. That figure, too, is widely considered a vast undercount.

Environmental defenders are a subset of human rights defenders, people acting peacefully to protect fundamental freedoms and rights. Many environmental defenders resist mega-projects imposed on their communities — such as mines, dams, industrial farming, logging and oil and gas operations — without meaningful consultation or consent. Many communities’ land claims remain unrecognized or are disrespected, setting the stage for conflict.

Global Witness highlighted the case of the Indigenous Dayak peoples, who have lived for centuries in West Kalimantan, a biodiverse Indonesian region of rainforests, peatlands and mangroves. Yet, only a fraction of this area larger than New York state is formally recognized, or in the process of being recognized, as Dayak territories, according to Yetno Budi Wibowo, of Lingkaran Advokasi & Riset Borneo, a nonprofit focused on environmental and human rights issues in West Kalimantan.

title: Çözüm burjuvazinin sınırlarında değil
content:
Bu Pazartesi, ODTÜ’de COP31 Başkanlığı ve Birleşmiş Milletler Türkiye ortaklığında “Gençlik İklim Zirvesi” düzenlendi. COP31’e hazırlanan ODTÜ, daha önce de COP’lara dair bir Learn&Connect etkinliği ve METU Climate Talks Pre-COP Webinar serisi düzenlemişti. Zirvede, “gençlerin iklim alanında karar alma süreçlerine katılımı üzerine interaktif bir diyalog gerçekleştirileceği ve COP31 Eylem Gündemi’ne iletilmek üzere bir dizi öneri içeren Gençlik Bildirisi hazırlanacağı” duyuruldu.

Konferans salonunda bulunan gençlerin sayısı 20 civarındaydı (zirveye çevrimiçi katılımın da olduğunu belirtelim). Zirvenin içeriğini tartışmaya gelen ODTÜ Öğrencileri ise Rektörlük konuşması sırasında atanmış rektörün Rant Yolundaki tutumuna ve COP31’in sahici bir çözüm getiremeyeceğine dair söz aldılar. Öğrenciler, “Bir etkinlik yapılıyor ama biliyoruz ki bu etkinliği yapan rektörlük rant yoluna asfalt döküyor”, “emeğimizin, ormanımızın, madenimizin talan planının yapıldığı COP31 Zirvesini kampüsümüzde kabul etmiyoruz; sizin doğa talanınız, sizin emperyalist sömürünüz varsa bizim örgütlü mücadelemiz var”, “ODTÜ Rektörlüğü ile belediye arasındaki protokol derhal iptal edilmeli, Rant Yolunun yapımı acilen durdurulmalıdır” diyerek seslerini yükselttiler.

Gençliğin iklim tartışmalarına ve bu tür zirvelere katılımının teşvik edilmesi değerli gözüküyor. “İklim sorununun çözümü için ne yapabiliriz?” sorusunun cevabını ne kadar kalabalık ararsak, o kadar doğru bir cevaba ulaşacağımızı düşünebiliriz. Ancak önce bu soruyu hangi zeminde tartıştığımıza bakmalıyız. Çünkü işin doğa bilimleri tarafına baktığımızda, sorunun sebebini ve buna bağlı olarak nasıl çözülebileceğini aslında halihazırda biliyoruz. Hükümetlerarası İklim Değişikliği Paneli'nin (IPCC) 6. Değerlendirme Raporu'na göre, küresel ısınmayı 1,5°C'de durdurmak ve sonrasında geri çevirmek için 2030'a kadar atmosfere salınan toplam sera gazlarında %43, 2035'e kadar ise %60 net düşüş sağlanmalı. 2050'ye kadar kömür kullanımı neredeyse tamamen sonlandırılmalı, petrol kullanımı %60-90 oranında, doğal gaz kullanımı ise yarıdan fazla azaltılmalı. Metan salınımı 2030 yılına kadar en az %34 oranında azaltılmalı; bunun için tarım ve hayvancılıktan kaynaklanan emisyonlar düşürülmeli.

Yani buradaki esas tartışma, “Bu çözümleri nasıl uygulayabiliriz?” sorusunda düğümleniyor. Bu da üretimi planlayanların ve yönetenlerin alması gereken aksiyonları gündeme getiriyor. Fosil yakıtlara alternatif olarak öne çıkan sürdürülebilir enerjinin üretimi için bol miktarda nadir toprak elementi gerekiyor. Bugünkü üretimin tamamını karşılayacak sürdürülebilir enerji kaynaklarının ve bunlara ilişkin materyallerin üretimi ise yeryüzünde başka bir talan alanı açıyor. Ayrıca fosil yakıt tekellerinin pazarlarının zayıflamaması için attığı her adımı bir kenara bırakalım; fosil yakıt kullanarak üretim yapan şirketlerin sürdürülebilir enerjiye geçebilmesi için kısa ve orta vadede kârlarının bir bölümünden vazgeçmeleri gerekiyor. Bu ise kimsenin, diğer herkesin de aynı kısıntıyı uygulayacağından emin olmadan göze almadığı bir süreç.

Ancak bu çıkmazların hepsinin temeli, üretimi planlayanların ve yönetenlerin penceresinden bakmaktan geliyor. Üretim üzerinde söz sahibi olan burjuvazinin esas önceliği kendi devamlılığı ve kârı; üretim üzerinde ise topyekûn bir anarşi söz konusu. Dünyanın dört bir yanı üretim fazlasından çöplüğe dönüşmüş durumda. Yani şu anki üretimi karşılamak için gereken enerji miktarından bahsetmek bile burjuvazinin sınırlarını kabul etmek demek. Dünya halkları olarak insanca yaşanılabilir bir dünyaya ve bu dünyayı gelecek nesillere bırakabilmeye ihtiyacımız var. Bu ihtiyaç doğrultusunda hareket edebilmek için ne kadar üretmeye ihtiyacımız olduğunu, bu üretimi nasıl karşılayabileceğimizi ve hangi kaynakları nereye, nasıl yönlendirebileceğimizi tartışmamız gerekiyor. Bunu yapabilmemizin ve uygulayabilmemizin tek yolu ise üretimi planlayanların üreten yığınlar olması. Burjuvazinin sınırları içerisinde gerçekleştirilen iklim tartışmaları bizi bir sonuca ulaştıramaz; sorunu üreten sistemin içerisinde kalıcı bir çıkış yolu bulamayız. Bu yüzden gençliği bu tartışmaların etrafında bir araya getiren girişimler, bizim iklim ve çevre mücadelemizin sorularını burjuvazinin sorularına sıkıştırıyor; mücadelemizi burjuvazinin çizdiği sınırlar içine hapsediyor.

Sermayenin temsilcisi saray rejimi ile atanmış rektörünün kol kola düzenlediği iklim etkinliklerini de bu çerçeveden değerlendirmeliyiz. Rant Yoluna, ülke …
