title: Moradi: Jin, Jiyan, Azadî is a project for a free, democratic society
content:
The Freedom for Warisha Moradi Campaign published an article written by Kurdish political prisoner Warisha Moradi, who is being held in Evin Prison, to mark the fourth anniversary of the Jin, Jiyan, Azadî (Woman, Life, Freedom) Revolution.


Moradi said Jin, Jiyan, Azadî is not merely the name of a protest, but represents a desire for life, freedom, dignity and human agency, as well as a determination to break down social relations built on power, violence, discrimination and inequality. She stressed that Jin, Jiyan, Azadî is not a process that has ended, but one that continues.


Moradi said women are themselves a driving force for change and that no democratic transformation can succeed without women’s will. She described the repression of women activists and political prisoners, along with the severe sentences imposed on them, as attempts to contain a movement that challenges the foundations of the existing structures of power and social organisation.


She stressed that the struggle does not end at the prison gates and said resistance in prisons and during court proceedings represents a continuation of the choice to pursue a free life. Rather than being a personal matter, she said, this resistance reflects broader public demands for freedom, justice and equality.


Moradi said Jin, Jiyan, Azadî cannot be reduced to a single demand, adding that its anniversary should not be limited to commemorating those who lost their lives. She said it would gain greater meaning through efforts to strengthen organisation, educate new generations, reinforce women’s leading role in society and build democratic institutions.


Moradi concluded her article by saying: “Jin, Jiyan, Azadî is not merely the commemoration of a revolution; it is also a reminder that another way of life is possible, and that we must begin working now to build it.”

title: Tribute paid to Jina Amini at her grave
content:
Jina Amini was killed by Iran’s “morality police” in Tehran, a group of activists visited her grave in Saqqiz, four years ago.


Today activists released white balloons bearing Jina Amini’s name and the words “Jin, jiyan, azadî” (“Woman, Life, Freedom”) at her grave.


The activists called on the public to take part in this symbolic act on the anniversary of Amini's death and to keep alive her memory and the memory of those who lost their lives for freedom by releasing white balloons.


Another activist who shared footage of the grave visit said: “Jina’s story continues to be told, and her voice echoes in the hearts of those who believe in freedom, dignity, and justice. Jina will never be forgotten. Her memory will endure forever as a symbol of hope and courage. Jina’s name will live on forever.”

title: Abdullah Öcalan: An Alevi Renaissance is one of the most important pillars of a democratic future
content:
Following their meeting with Abdullah Öcalan on 13 September, members of the Peoples’ Equality and Democracy Party (DEM Party) Imralı Delegation, Pervin Buldan, Mithat Sancar, and Özgür Faik Erol, shared his assessments regarding the process with the public.


According to Mezopotamya Agency (MA), DEM Party officials spoke to journalists about the content of their latest meeting with Öcalan, particularly the discussions surrounding notes circulated as allegedly having been written by him.


Öcalan once again said that some of the records of the meeting that had been circulated and had sparked the discussions in question had no connection to reality. It was reported that Öcalan referred to his earlier assessments of Idris-i Bitlisi in relation to the Democratic Society Manifesto.


Alevi renaissance


Abdullah Öcalan gave the following message on the subject: “Recalling Idris-i Bitlisi’s alliance between the Sunni

mirs

 and the Ottoman Empire does not mean reviving it as it was, along with its shortcomings. On the contrary, it means updating the understanding of alliances that were established in the past in the interests of the mirs and rulers, in accordance with the interests of peoples and faiths today. The historical memory of the Alevis, and the concerns that have arisen from it, must of course be taken seriously. The aim here is not to assimilate Alevism into Sunnism, but to make Kurds and Alevis, with their own identities and distinct characteristics, the founding subjects of this new democratic alliance. What is at issue is an alliance of peoples, not of mirs. The aim is an alliance of equality and freedom, not of domination. The Alevi Renaissance is also one of the most important pillars of this common democratic future.”


Events in Rojava are an "open provocation"


It was reported that Öcalan also commented on developments in Rojava, describing what had happened as “an open provocation.” In particular, he said: “You will brutally kill a young person and then use it as an excuse to enter the city. This is an open provocation. This sabotage of the basis for dialogue must stop immediately.”


Iran must stop its attacks


It was reported that Öcalan also drew attention to developments in Iran, and said he considered the policies pursued by the Kurdistan Free Life Party (PJAK) to be correct and that its strategy of defending the people without entering other spheres of influence was appropriate.


It was stated that Öcalan emphasized that his priority regarding Iran was to stop the “execution frenzy” and for Iran to cease attacking the Kurdish region, saying, “If this is not done, the Kurds will have the right to legitimate self-defense. Turkey should play a positive role in this issue.”


Message of condolence for Mehdi Zana


Abdullah Öcalan also sent a message following the recent death of Mehdi Zana. Expressing his sorrow over Zana’s death, Öcalan's message was conveyed as follows: “Mehdi Zana made an important effort to ensure that the people had a say on the basis of local democracy. I extend my condolences to his entire family, especially Leyla Zana.”

author: Unknown
title: A prison is still a prison!
content:
Special warfare operatives are also working to distort the facts surrounding the Peace and Democratic Society Process. Reports have claimed that a two-storey villa with a large garden has been built for Abdullah Öcalan on Imrali. The timing of this report is also significant. It comes at a time when the Turkish state is expected to take steps but has failed to do so. By putting such a story into circulation, attention is being diverted from the state’s failure to act.


According to information we received from DEM Party circles, a new building has been constructed within the Imrali prison complex. The original building where Abdullah Öcalan was held was demolished and replaced with a slightly larger prison building. It is neither a villa nor does it have the large garden described in the reports. Describing a few square metres of ground as a large garden already reveals the purpose behind the story. The area is also reportedly surrounded by very high walls, meaning there is no view outside. How can a place like this, built inside the Imrali prison complex, be portrayed as a two-storey villa?


This report was circulated by a journalist at a time when the Kurdish people are insisting that Abdullah Öcalan should be able to live and work freely. The same journalist also claimed that Recep Tayyip Erdoğan had rejected granting Öcalan any status. In other words, the message is that there is no right to hope and no status, but that a comfortable place has supposedly been provided inside the prison. Portraying this prison as a villa is intended to weaken and undermine the Kurdish people’s demand for the right to hope and for Öcalan to be able to work freely.


Erdoğan once spoke about what happened in Diyarbakır (Amed) Prison No. 5 and said that if only the walls could speak, they would tell of the torture and persecution inflicted there. His government claimed that prisons would no longer be like that. Yet prisons of virtually every type were built under the Justice and Development Party (AKP) government, including pit-type prisons. Similar pit-like spaces reportedly existed in older prisons, where prisoners serving severe sentences were confined. The AKP sometimes boasts about everything it has built in Turkey. It could perhaps also boast about how many “modern” prisons it has built. What it calls modern prisons are places where prisoners are made to experience a prison within a prison.


A journalist is now claiming that the prison facility on Imrali has been renovated into something resembling a villa. Praising a prison in such terms reveals the mentality and character of the person making the claim. The apparent assumption is that this will weaken the Kurdish people’s reaction and demands. A prison is still a prison. The facility on Imrali is not even an open prison. It is an enclosed space surrounded by very high walls. How can it be called a villa simply because it is slightly larger?


The facility was built only last year. Abdullah Öcalan was reportedly encouraged to move there in an attempt to undermine the demand for the right to hope and the Kurdish people’s demand for his freedom. Öcalan did not move there, however, because what matters to him is his political position and political status. The way a journalist has reported on this facility on Imrali makes the intention behind it even clearer. Are they trying to convince the Kurdish people and international public opinion that conditions on Imrali are somehow good? It appears that the facility is being brought onto the agenda as a way of stalling the process and presenting the situation differently from what it is. This approach itself demonstrates a lack of seriousness towards the process.


The journalist who claimed that a villa had been built on Imrali has opposed the process from the outset. He has not abandoned the old discourse, terminology or jargon. More precisely, he consciously continues to use this language and tone. This journalist neither shows concern for Turkey nor any empathy towards the Kurds. He speaks as though he were a spokesperson for certain circles within and around the AKP, articulating their mentality and approach.


A DEM Party delegation held talks on Imrali. There were differing views on how the law should be implemented. Qandil has made clear in various ways that the law cannot be implemented in the manner described in the media and that a realistic and workable approach is needed. title: Preparations are underway in Marseille for 6th Sinan Dersim Kurdish Cultural Festival
content:
The  6th Sinan Dersim Kurdish Cultural Festival will be held on Saturday 20 September in Marseille. It aims to bring together the Kurdish community living in the city and the people of Marseille. As part of the program, stalls serving Kurdish cuisine, art exhibitions, and areas featuring Kurdish-language books will be set up. The day-long event is planned to offer visitors both a cultural and gastronomic experience.


 


The stage program will feature numerous artists and groups. Alongside Koma Amed, Kawa Urmiye, Hozan Azad, and Ibo Qamişlo, the ZarokMa children's group, the Kecên Rojê folklore troupe, and the Soul Brasilian Rhythm group will also perform. In this way, Kurdish music and dance, as well as rhythms from different cultures, will come together on the same stage at the festival.


The Festival Preparatory Committee stated that they have been visiting local shopkeepers and families to publicize the event, putting up posters, and making calls for participation through social media.


In a statement, the committee said: “Our most important goal is for the festival to be embraced by broad sections of the community and to achieve strong participation.”


The festival also includes activities specifically aimed at children and young people, and the participation of the ZarokMa group is expected to increase families’ interest.


The Sinan Dersim Kurdish Cultural Festival will be held at Parc du Ravelle La Rosse Newroz Park in Marseille.

title: Jin, Jiyan, Azadî uprising continues Kurdish women’s struggle
content:
The European Kurdish Women’s National Unity Platform issued a statement marking the fourth anniversary of the Jin, Jiyan, Azadî (Woman, Life, Freedom) Revolution, which began following the killing of Jina Mahsa Amini.


The statement said policies of repression, arrests, torture and executions continue to target women demanding their rights and freedoms in Iran and Eastern Kurdistan (Rojhilat), with Kurdish women facing particularly severe repression. The platform stressed that women continue to resist despite these pressures.


The statement said: “On behalf of the European Kurdish Women’s National Unity Platform, on the fourth anniversary of the killing of Jina Mahsa Amini, we commemorate her with respect and gratitude, along with all the women and young people who lost their lives on the path to freedom.


The killing of Jina Mahsa Amini in Tehran on 16 September 2022 sparked an uprising in Iran under the slogan Jin, Jiyan, Azadî, which within a short time became the voice of women’s resistance across the world. Jina Mahsa Amini became a symbol of the struggle against repression, patriarchal rule and violence against women. For Kurdish women, however, Jin, Jiyan, Azadî is not merely the slogan of the 2022 uprising. It is rooted in the historical legacy of Kurdish women’s struggle. Kurdish women have fought for years against occupation, repression and patriarchal rule, and through their efforts and sacrifices have played a particular role in preserving the identity, language and freedom of their society. The Jin, Jiyan, Azadî uprising can therefore be seen as a continuation of this historic struggle.


Women demanding their rights and freedoms in Iran continue to face policies of repression and coercion. Women are subjected to arrests, torture, executions and political punishment. Kurdish women are also facing severe repression in this process. Women continue to resist these policies. The voices of women in prison, those subjected to violence and their families must be heard. The international community and human rights organisations also have a responsibility to take a strong stand against these violations. For Kurdish women and the Kurdish people, this period requires strong and organised unity. Women’s unity must be built on the basis of solidarity, trust, respect and responsibility among Kurdish women across all parts of Kurdistan and in the diaspora.


On the fourth anniversary of the killing of Jina Mahsa Amini, we commemorate with respect and gratitude all Kurdish women who have struggled against repression and occupation throughout history. We make our position clear against the arrest, torture and execution of women and all forms of violence against them. We consider the role of women’s organisations, democratic forces, human rights organisations and the international community important in women’s struggle for freedom, equality and a life of dignity, and we call on them to stand with women. We believe that the strength of Kurdish women lies in their unity. Organised unity can amplify their voices and provide a strong foundation for building social and national unity. On the anniversary of the revolution, we pledge to continue the struggle for freedom and equality and to keep raising the banner of Jin, Jiyan, Azadî.”

author: Unknown
title: Emin Ay becomes the new co-mayor of Amed Metropolitan Municipality
content:
Emin Ay has been appointed to replace Doğan Hatun, who resigned from his position as co-mayor of Amed Metropolitan Municipality under the “Principle of Withdrawal.” In a statement issued by the DEM Party’s Democratic Local Governments Board, it was stated that the process of selecting the new co-mayor was carried out by taking into consideration the views and recommendations of the Diyarbakır Metropolitan Municipality Council, provincial and district party organizations, and democratic institutions in the city.


The board’s statement said that the process of selecting the co-mayor was conducted in accordance with the procedures and principles set out in the Democratic Local Governments Position Paper, based on “common sense and collective will.”


The statement said that the proposals that emerged from the consultations were evaluated together with the party’s governing bodies. It added: “Accordingly, Emin Ay will serve as co-mayor of Diyarbakır Metropolitan Municipality as of today.”


The statement emphasized that co-mayorship is not merely a model of governance, but a democratic mechanism that strengthens the direct participation of society in government and places the will of the people at the center of decision-making processes.


The statement said that, in the new period, the municipality would continue to follow an approach to local government based on the will of the people, common sense, and democratic participation, and wished Emin Ay success in his new role.

author: Unknown
title: Mother of three martyrs: I am proud of them
content:
Tributes are being held in many cities across Kurdistan, Turkey, and Europe for the guerrillas whose deaths have recently been announced. Rojgirav Amed (Mürsel Nergiz), who was killed in Metina on 13 March 2020, was commemorated at a condolence gathering held in Amed.


Refika Nergiz, the mother of Rojgirav Amed, Felat Amed (Yüksel Nergiz), and Ilhan Amed (Tarık Nergiz), who were killed on different dates and in different regions, said that she was proud of the three sons she had lost in the Kurdish freedom struggle. Wishing condolences to all the families, the Kurdish guerrillas, and to Abdullah Öcalan, Refika Nergiz, the mother of three martyrs, said: "My three sons fell as martyrs. First Ilhan left; after he fell as a martyr, Felat left, and before Felat was killed, Rojgirav left. I was in the village. Before Rojgirav left, he called me to central Amed. He told me that he was going to leave. He had already been imprisoned before and had suffered severe torture for about 40 days. When he got out of prison and told me he was going to leave, I didn’t believe him."


Nergiz added: "We stayed together in Amed for 15 days. He told me, ‘I made a promise. I can’t stay here anymore. I can’t go to prison again; I can’t endure that much torture. I’ve made my decision. I’m going to leave.’ I said, if you are really going to leave, then I will see you off. His father, his sister, and his brother Ali, who is currently in prison, were in the village. I stayed with Rojgirav until he left. He said goodbye to all his relatives and friends, telling them he was going abroad, but he had told me that he was going to join the guerrillas. It was hard for me that my third son was leaving too, but I saw him off with my own hands. I also went to visit him several times. Rojgirav was very intelligent and knowledgeable. After I visited him and returned, his father asked about his condition, and I told him. That day, he suffered a cerebral hemorrhage. He remained in a hospital in Amed for three days and then passed away."


Nergiz continued: "Our relatives asked whether we should hold the condolence gathering in the village. I said no. My son loved his comrades and his community very much, so I said we would hold his condolence gathering together with his comrades. May no mother’s heart ache anymore. My three sons were martyred, and all three live on in my heart. I am proud of them. Hopefully, peace will be achieved from now on and families will be reunited with their children."

title: "Kürt çocukları anadillerinde eğitim görme hakkına sahip olmalı"
content:
Van Dil, Kültür ve Sanat Araştırmaları Derneği (ARSİSA), yeni eğitim-öğretim yılının başlaması dolayısıyla anadilinde eğitim talebiyle Erciş İlçe Milli Eğitim Müdürlüğü önünde basın açıklaması düzenledi.


Açıklamaya DEM Parti Erciş İlçe eşbaşkanları, ilçede faaliyet yürüten çeşitli sivil toplum örgütlerinin temsilcileri ve çok sayıda yurttaş katıldı.


Açıklama sırasında katılımcılar, üzerinde ‘Zimanê me hebûna me ye’ (Dilimiz varlığımızdır), ‘Kurdî dayîka me ye’ (Kürtçe anadilimizdir), ‘Bê ziman jiyan nabe’ (Dilsiz yaşam olmaz), ‘Ziwanê min qedexe meke’ (Dilimi yasaklama) ve ‘Ma statuyê bi Kurdî wazenê’ ifadelerinin yer aldığı dövizler taşıdı.


Basın açıklamasını ARSİSA yönetim üyesi ve aynı zamanda Kürtçe dil eğitmeni Mecit Sargut okudu.


Yeni eğitim yılının başladığını belirten Sargut, Kürt çocuklarının anadillerinde eğitim hakkından yoksun bırakıldığını belirterek,

"Okullar açıldı, milyonlarca çocuk sınıflarına döndü. Ancak Kürt çocukları açısından yeni eğitim yılı, anadilinde eğitim sorunu çözülmeden başladı. Milyonlarca Kürt çocuğu, anadili olmayan bir dilde eğitim görüyor"

 dedi.


Barışın eşitlikle mümkün olabileceğini ifade eden Sargut, dil hakkının devam eden barış ve çözüm tartışmalarının temel başlıklarından biri olması gerektiğini söyledi.


Sargut, "Barış eşitlikle başlar. Eğer barıştan, çözümden ve ortak bir gelecekten söz ediliyorsa, bunun somut adımlarla desteklenmesi gerekir. Barış yalnızca sözlerle kurulmaz; hakların tanınması ve güvenin oluşturulmasıyla mümkün olur" ifadelerini kullandı.


Dil ile kimlik arasındaki ilişkiye dikkat çeken Sargut, anadilinin yalnızca bir iletişim aracı olmadığını belirterek şöyle konuştu:


"Dil yalnızca bir iletişim aracı değildir; dil aynı zamanda varoluştur. Dili yasaklanan bir çocuk, kendi varlığının da yasaklandığını hisseder. Altı, yedi yaşındaki bir çocuk okula başladığında kendi dilini kullanamıyorsa, bunun onun kimliği ve gelişimi üzerinde doğrudan etkisi olur. Dilimiz varlığımızdır, dilimiz onurumuzdur."


Kürtçenin eğitim sistemindeki konumuna ilişkin de konuşan Sargut, taleplerinin Kürtçenin yalnızca seçmeli ders olarak okutulması olmadığını söyledi.


Sargut,

"Kürtçe yeni eğitim yılında eğitim dili olarak kabul edilmelidir. Kürt çocukları anadillerinde eğitim görme hakkına sahip olmalıdır. Bu hak seçmeli bir ders düzeyine indirgenmemeli; temel ve doğal bir hak olarak tanınmalıdır"

 dedi.


Açıklamada uluslararası sözleşmelere de atıfta bulunan Sargut, çocukların kendi dillerini öğrenme ve kullanma hakkının korunması gerektiğini ifade etti. Anadilde eğitimin çocukların akademik, zihinsel ve toplumsal gelişimleri açısından önem taşıdığını belirtti.


Kalıcı bir barışın dil ve kimlik haklarının tanınmasıyla mümkün olabileceğini savunan Sargut,

"Anadilinde eğitim vazgeçilmez bir haktır. Kalıcı bir barış kurulmak isteniyorsa, bunun yolu halkların birbirini, birbirlerinin dilini ve kimliğini tanımasından geçer"

diye konuştu.


Açıklama, ‘Bê ziman jiyan nabe – Dilsiz yaşam olmaz’ sloganıyla sona erdi.


(İY/HA)

author: anred
title: Alemania: «abajo los alquileres, arriba el salario»
content:
«Abajo los alquileres, arriba el salario». Foto: Ana Muro.


Hace cinco años, la mayoría de los berlineses y berlinesas, el 59 ℅ de las personas que participaron, votó a favor de que las empresas inmobiliarias privadas con ánimo de lucro que contaran con más de 3.000 viviendas fueran nacionalizadas. A pesar de que la sociedad hizo uso de sus herramientas legales para defender el derecho a la vivienda, todos los gobiernos, desde ese momento, hasta ahora no aplicaron la decisión del referendum. La iniciativa “expropiemos a Deutsche Wohnen”, elabora una nueva iniciativa popular,  pero esta vez vinculante.

Por Ana Muro, corresponsal de ANRed en Alemania.


La iniciativa «Deutsche Wohnen & Co enteignen» (DWE) elaboró hace cinco años un referendum

. La Constitución alemana, en su artículo número 15, establece que “la tierra, los recursos naturales y los medios de producción «con fines de socialización(…) pueden transferirse a la propiedad colectiva o a otras formas de economía colectiva».

La vivienda es un derecho, no una mercancía.


Hace cinco años, la mayoría de los berlineses y berlinesas, el 59 ℅de las personas que participaron, votó a favor de que las empresas inmobiliarias privadas con ánimo de lucro que contaran con más de 3.000 viviendas fueran nacionalizadas. A pesar de que la sociedad hizo uso de sus herramientas legales para defender el derecho a la vivienda, todos los gobiernos, desde ese momento, hasta ahora no aplicaron la decisión del referendum. La iniciativa “expropiemos a Deutsche Wohnen”, elabora una nueva iniciativa popular,  pero esta vez vinculante.


Hasta ahora, el Senado, ha retrasado, dilado y denegado la aplicación de la voluntad popular; primero creó una comisión de expertos, luego aprobó una ley marco de socialización de dudoso valor y, finalmente, no ha transferido ni una sola vivienda al ámbito del bien común.


Foto: Ana Muro.


DWE ha elaborado entretanto su propia ley de socialización y pretende poner en marcha una

nueva iniciativa popular, pero esta vez vinculante

, para que no quede nuevamente ineficaz la voluntad popular.


El apoyo de la población sigue siendo elevado. Es tan notorio el malestar popular: alquileres altísimos, saneamientos y reparaciones inexistentes, falta de propiedades para alquilar, construcción solo de apartamentos de lujo. Vonovia y Deutsche Wohnen, las dos colosas corporaciones innmobiliarias, se han fusionado y en lo que respecta al mantenimiento, cobran costos de calefacción y de operación inexplicablemente altos y tampoco y se destacan especialmente por sus inversiones en nuevas construcciones, por no hablar de la construcción de viviendas asequibles. Con su conducta empresarial, las grandes empresas inmobiliarias han perdido desde hace años la confianza de las berlinesas y los berlineses.


Recién ahora el tema vivienda se ha vuelto “importante” para los políticos y se ha puesto en las campañas políticas para las próximas elecciones. Aunque el próximo 20 de septiembre, con las elecciones en Berlín, la socialización no se someta directamente a votación, será un factor decisivo para muchos votantes a la hora de decidir a quién van a votar. 


En la campaña electoral se puso en marcha una campaña contra la socialización, impulsada por todo tipo de personas que hasta ahora apenas habían prestado atención a la crisis de la vivienda en Berlín, encabezadas por el canciller federal Friedrich Merz.


«Socializar lo que le pertenece a la sociedad». Foto: Ana Muro.


Esta legítima reivindicación ha sido asociada por actores cada vez más diversos del ámbito económico y político, con actividades anticonstitucionales. La expropiación se presenta una y otra vez como una medida coercitiva arbitraria de un régimen antidemocrático e injusto. Lo que se omite es que las expropiaciones son algo cotidiano en la República Federal. Sobre todo para la construcción de carreteras y para la extracción a cielo abierto de lignito,se expropian grandes extensiones de tierra sin decir nada al respecto. Nadie lamenta por ello el fin de la democracia. En Berlín, la autoridad de expropiación forma parte de la Administración del Senado para el Desarrollo Urbano, la Construcción y la Vivienda. La base legal es la Ley de Expropiación de Berlín, vigente desde 1964.

author: anred
title: La UBA salió a la calle: clases públicas y servicios gratuitos en Plaza de Mayo
content:
Fotos: Dani Ávalos.


Este martes 15 de septiembre, la Universidad de Buenos Aires trasladó sus aulas, laboratorios y servicios a Plaza de Mayo para visibilizar la situación que atraviesa la universidad pública y reclamar el cumplimiento de la Ley de Financiamiento Universitario. Durante toda la jornada hubo clases abiertas, atención gratuita y actividades científicas frente al Ministerio de Economía.

Por Dani Ávalos, para ANRed.


Desde la mañana, Plaza de Mayo se convirtió en un espacio universitario a cielo abierto. Docentes, estudiantes, trabajadores y autoridades de la Universidad de Buenos Aires llevaron sus actividades al espacio público, en una jornada que se extendió desde la mañana hasta la medianoche.


Foto: Dani Ávalos.


Foto: Dani Ávalos.


Los 13 decanos de la UBA participaron de la iniciativa y dictaron clases magistrales abiertas. A la propuesta académica se sumaron servicios gratuitos para la comunidad, entre ellos atención odontológica, clínica médica, óptica y veterinaria, además de asesoramiento jurídico y contable. También se presentaron proyectos de investigación y desarrollos tecnológicos realizados en el ámbito universitario.


Foto: Dani Ávalos.


Foto: Dani Ávalos.


La actividad tuvo como eje el reclamo por la aplicación efectiva de la Ley 27.795 de Financiamiento Universitario y el cumplimiento de las decisiones judiciales relacionadas con su implementación. La comunidad universitaria denuncia que, pese a los fallos existentes, persisten dificultades vinculadas al financiamiento, los salarios, las becas, la investigación y el funcionamiento de las universidades.


Foto: Dani Ávalos.


Foto: Dani Ávalos.


La Asociación Gremial Docente de la UBA (AGD-UBA) se incorporó a la jornada con clases públicas desde las 11, en el marco de las medidas de lucha que vienen desarrollando las universidades nacionales.


La escena en Plaza de Mayo buscó mostrar, en la práctica, qué significa la universidad pública para la sociedad: conocimiento, formación, investigación, atención y servicios que salen de las facultades y llegan directamente a la comunidad.


Foto: Dani Ávalos.


Foto: Dani Ávalos.


La jornada se produjo además en un contexto de conflicto salarial y presupuestario que atraviesa al sistema universitario nacional. Los gremios y las autoridades universitarias sostienen el reclamo por el financiamiento y por una recomposición de los salarios docentes y no docentes.


Con las aulas en la calle, la UBA convirtió este martes a Plaza de Mayo en un espacio de enseñanza, investigación y atención comunitaria. Una manera de hacer visible que detrás del reclamo presupuestario también está en discusión el presente y el futuro de la universidad pública.


Foto: Dani Ávalos.


Foto: Dani Ávalos.

author: Unknown
title: Li Rojavayê çalakiyên ji bo zimanê kurdî didomin
content:
Wezareta Perwerdehiyê ya Sûriyeyê di 27ê Tebaxa 2026an de ji bo rewşa 

zimanê Kurdî

 li Rojavayê biryareke bi hejmar 2068/943 derxist.


Li gorî biryarê, xwendekar dê di hefteyê de 3 saetan bi Kurdî bixwînin. Ev biryar derfetê dide ku zimanê kurdî wekî zimanekî niştimanî li dibistanên fermî û taybet ên li deverên Kurdan bibe beşeke bernameya dersan.


Di çarçoveya ve biryarê de, xwendekar dikarin dersên zanistên civakî yên weke dîrok, cografya û felsefe bi erebî an jî kurdî bixwînin. Lêbelê dersên zanistî yên wekî bîrkarî/matematîk, fîzîk, kîmya û biyolojî dê bi zimanê Erebî bin.


Piştî biryara 27ê Tebaxê ya sînorkirina zimanê kurdî, xwendekar û welatiyan nerazîbûn li dijî biryarê nîşan dan. Çalakî û nerazîbûn li Rojavayê berdewam dikin.


Di çarçoveya çalakiyên ji bo zimanê dayikê de li bajarê Qamişloya Rojavayê, xwendekar û malbatên wan ji bo parastina mafê xwendin û fêrbûna bi zimanê kurdî û li dijî biryara sînordarkirinê, li pêşiya avahiya Neteweyên Yekbûyî kona çalakiyê vedan. Dê çalakî du rojan berdewam bike.


Li Rojavayê, Kurd li dijî biryara hikumeta Sûriyeyê a ji bo kurdî daketin qadan


31 Tebax 2026


Xwendekarên ku tev li çalakiyê bûne diyar dikin ku ew biryarên sînordarkirina zimanê Kurdî bi temamî red dikin û dibêjin heta biryar were paşdegirtin dê çalakiya xwe bidomînin.


Daxwazên xwedekarên Rojavayê


1. Pêşxistina biryara wezaretê ya hejmar 68/943/ da ku bibe gaveke ber bi misogerkirina fêrbûna bi zimanê kurdî û ne tenê rêxistina fêrkirina wê wekî materyaleke fêrkirinê.


2. Misogerkirina mafê xwendekar û şagirdên kurd di fêrbûna zimanê wan ê dayikê da li hemû aliyên Sûriyeyê û negirêdana vî mafî bi cihê niştecihbûnê yan bi rêjeyeke niştecihî ya destnîşankirî ve.


3. Pêwîst e her nezelalîya di pîvana “herêmên ku di wan de rêjeyeke berçav a hemwelatiyên kurd hene” ji holê rabe û pîvanên zelal û aşkere werin danîn da ku jihevcihkirina di navbera xwendekaran de li gor niştecihbûna wan ji holê were rakirin.


4. Pêjirandina sê waneyan di heftîyê de pêwîst ene wekî banekî dawîn ê fêrbûna zimanê kurdî were hesibandin.


5. Danîna planeke demî ya zelal a çûna hin bi hin ji fêrkirina zimanê kurdî ber bi fêrkirina bi zimanê kurdî ve û di hejmara zêdetir a materyalan de heta ku bigihîje nimûneyeke fêrkirinê ya duzimanî di pêvajoyên guncav de.


6. Misogerkirina sûdgirtina xwendekar û şagirdên ku niha li dibistanan in ji siyaseta nû ya fêrkirinê û sînordarkirina vî mafî bi nifşên bê.


7. Amadekirina mamosteyên ku dikarin bi zimanê kurdî di hemû astan û di hemû materyal û beşan de fêr bikin û sînordarkirina kadroyên fêrkirina zimanê kurdî tenê.


8. Sûdgirtina ji pêşnivîsên perwerdeyî yên ku berê di warê perwerdeyê bi zimanê kurdî de hene, bi taybet bi hezaran mamosta û karmendên di qada perwerdeyê de yên xwedî pêşnivîsên curbicur û vekirina rêyê li pêş wan da ku di prosesa perwerdeyî ya fermî de beşdar bibin li gor bingehên akademîk ên zelal û bê duristina paşguhkirin.


9. Amadekirin û pêşxistina tegihên zanistî û akademîk ên pêwîst.


10. Tevlîkirina çand, wêje, dîrok û kevneşopiya kurdî di mihênahên neteweyî de bi awayekî zanistî û hevseng ku tê girêdayîya çand û dîroka civaka sûrîyeyî derxîne pêş.


11. Misogerkirina berdewamûna fêrkirina zimanê erebî li gel zimanê kurdî, herweha pêjirandina fêrkirina duzimanî wekî rêyeke xurtkirina wekhevîya derfetên, ne ku zimanek ji zimanekî din çêtir were ditin.


12. Vekirina rêgehên di xwendina bilind de ji bo amadekirina mamosta, vekoler û pisporên bi zimanê kurdî û piştgiriya lêgerîna zanistî û berhemana zanînê ji derên akademîk jî.


13. Misogerkirina ku zimanê kurdî nebe materyaleke ezmûnî ya negering, lê pêwîst e di aliyên curbicur ên jiyana dibistanî û fêrkarî de bibe xwedî amadabûneke rastîn.


14. Dayîna garantiyeke qanûnî, xweçî û qanûnsaz ji bo mafên zimanî û fêrkarî yên hemwelatiyên kurd da ku ev maf nebe têkildarî biryarekê îdarî ya ku pêkane û were serrastkirin an betalkirin.


Em piştrast dikin ku danpêdana bi zimanê kurdî gaveke giring e û li ser tê avakirin. Lê danpêdana rastîn ne tenê ew e ku di tabloya waneyên de were rêzkirin, lê karîna xwendekar a bikaranîna wê ya di fêrbûn, derbirîn û berhemana zanînê de ye.


Herweha em piştrast dikin ku tecrîbeya 14 salî ya fêrkirina bi zimanê kurdî û pê re jî komîser hebûna pisporî, minhac û kadroyên fêrkirinê, pêwîst e wekî embareke. perwerdeyî were ditin ku dikare were pêşxistin û di asta neteweyî de sûd jê were girtin, û ne wekî tecrîbeyekê were ditin ku pêwîst e were paşguhkirin. author: CNT Santander
title: 18 de septiembre. Charla de Andrew Gartzea
content:
El

GT de Feminismos

, nos trae una charla, abierta y gratuita, muy interesante del comunicador:

ANDREW GARTZEA

.


Tendrá lugar el

18 de septiembre a las 18: 30h

 en nuestra sede de Santander.


El título escogido para este encuentro es:

Más allá de los límites establecidos: La Queerización de lo cotidiano como propuesta para comenzar a desarticular lo conocido.


SOBRE LA CHARLA

: Cuando decimos «queer» estamos hablando de un proyecto crítico, heredero de la tradición feminista y anticolonial, que tiene como objetivo el análisis y la deconstrucción de los procesos históricos y culturales que han conducido a la invención del cuerpo blanco y

cis-heteros-sexual

 como ficción dominante en

Occidente


(Preciado, P.B.(2019). Un apartamento en Urano: Crónica del cruce. Anagrama).


Si queremos

despatriarcalizar, desrracializar y desheterosexualizar

 la sociedad, las utopías queer son un horizonte a perseguir. Andrew nos propone rearticular lo queer para

hackear

 la normalidad y acabar con toda norma capitalista, sea el sistema de género y sexualidad, el racial o el capacitista.


SOBRE EL PONENTE

:

Andrew Gartzea

 (el/elle) es un comunicador audiovisual, investigador y autor cuyo trabajo se centra en cuestiones de género desde la

perspectiva queer, feminista, anticapitalista y antisupremacista

. O, en sus propias palabras, antinormativo.


Además de figurar entre los autores de la reciente publicación

«Transbordes – Nuevas líneas para el pensamiento trans«

, también forma parte del colectivo de comunicadoras críticas y radicales

Pantube

 (

pantube.tv

) y ha escrito en medios digitales como

El Salto o el Pikara Magazine

.


¿Te atreves a hackear la normalidad?


Acompáñanos para un ejercicio de imaginación política radical interseccional.


¡Te esperamos!


La entrada

Charla de Andrew Gartzea

 se publicó primero en

CNT Santander

.

 se publicó primero en

Confederación Nacional del Trabajo

author: CNT Aranjuez
title: 19 de septiembre. Presentación de Candelarias de la Virgen
content:
Este sábado 18 de septiembre de 2026, qué mejor plan que venirse al Ateneo Libertario de la CNT de Aranjuez a la hora del vermú para conocer algo más el proyecto Candelarias de la Virgen. Un libro, pero no solo eso.


La obra aborda las secuelas del golpe de 1936 con una mezcla de memoria histórica, realismo mágico y crítica anticapitalista, desde una óptica cercana al éxodo rural y la resistencia antifranquista.


Y no solamente eso. Teodoro Balmaseda, escritor riojano y autor de Candelarias de la Virgen (ganadora del I Certamen LaFec Euskadi de Narrativa) e Israel (bajista de Terzero en Discordia y líder de la banda palestina) son un equipo que se vienen para Aranjuez y nos presentan un libro con concierto acústico, buscando colaborar con espacios que entiendan la cultura como herramienta de transformación.


Por todo ello, os invitamos este sábado a asistir a la presentación de la novela Candelarias de la Virgen, junto a su autor y acompañades de la música en directo.


Salud y acierto.

19 de septiembre. Presentación de Candelarias de la Virgen

 se publicó primero en

Confederación Nacional del Trabajo

.

author: Solange Guimarães
title: Crise no STF: professor aponta contaminação da Corte pela política e pela elite financeira
content:
A sessão do plenário do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) realizada nesta terça-feira, 15 de setembro, deixou um certo amargo no paladar dos brasileiros. O desafio de decidir se o ministro Alexandre de Moraes poderia ser investigado em função do relatório da Polícia Federal (PF) apresentado ao presidente da Corte, Edson Fachin, pelo ministro André Mendonça, mostrou-se um fracasso.


Depois de muita troca de acusações entre os colegas de corte e falas com tom alterado, a conclusão foi que as teses de defesa de Moraes não convencem a maioria dos ministros do Supremo.

 Isso, entretanto, não foi suficiente para dar seguimento à análise, tendo em vista que o ministro Flávio Dino, aliado de Moraes, usando uma discussão entre Mendonça e Mendes como pretexto, pediu vista do processo.


A crise do STF, que chegou ao seu ápice nessa reunião, não começou agora. Para o historiador e professor de História pela Universidade de São Paulo (FFLCH/FE-USP) Caio Rubini, o que veio à tona na Corte expõe tensões acumuladas ao longo da última década, período em que o Supremo passou a ocupar o centro de algumas das principais disputas políticas do país.


“O STF se tornou um dos grandes centros do embate político brasileiro nos últimos anos, que foi acentuado fortemente após o julgamento da tentativa de golpe de Estado de 8 de janeiro de 2023, conduzido por Alexandre de Moraes”, avalia Rubini.


Acusações, enfrentamentos e questionamentos entre integrantes do próprio tribunal reproduzem, segundo Rubini, parte da polarização que se aprofundou no Brasil. Conflitos que há anos atravessam o Legislativo e o Executivo chegaram também ao STF.


A crise, no entanto, não se resume à disputa política. A relação entre integrantes dos poderes do Estado e a elite econômica brasileira ocupa lugar central na análise do professor e ajuda, segundo ele, a compreender o atual desgaste institucional.


É também por essa perspectiva que Rubini enxerga no episódio uma questão de economia política. Interesses privados e poder econômico se misturam às disputas que chegaram ao Supremo, deslocando a discussão para além das condutas individuais de seus ministros.


“Testemunhamos um embate majoritariamente político e de economia política, pois envolve grandes nomes da economia nacional, dentro do Supremo Tribunal Federal. A sensação de ‘ideias fora do lugar’, como diria Roberto Schwarz, faz todo o sentido aqui”

, explica o professor.


O próprio ambiente da Corte mudou. O enfrentamento público entre ministros e a sobreposição de argumentos jurídicos e políticos contrastam, na avaliação do historiador, com o rigor e o decoro exigidos de integrantes da mais alta instância do Judiciário brasileiro.


Caio Rubini é historiador e professor de História pela Universidade de São Paulo (FFLCH/FE-USP)


Há ainda um efeito que ultrapassa os limites do tribunal. O desgaste da imagem do STF pode ampliar a desconfiança da população nas instituições e reforçar a personificação da política — quando o debate público passa a se concentrar mais em determinados líderes do que nos projetos, interesses e estruturas que eles representam.


O professor salienta que “a população passa a desconfiar e desqualificar aquela que deveria ser a instituição salvaguarda da nossa democracia, que é o Supremo Tribunal Federal. Com a imagem da Corte manchada, aumenta, e muito, o perigo para a democracia brasileira”. 


Para Rubini, recuperar a credibilidade do Supremo exigirá enfrentar questões que a crise colocou em evidência. Entre elas estão os conflitos de interesses, o alcance das decisões monocráticas, as relações entre autoridades e agentes econômicos e a transparência na atuação da Corte.


Nesta entrevista, Caio Rubini fala sobre as origens da crise, analisa os embates no Supremo e discute o que o atual episódio revela sobre as relações entre poder político, poder econômico e Judiciário no Brasil.


Leia os principais trechos:


Como avalia a sessão desta terça-feira no Supremo?


Acima de adjetivações exageradas e sensacionalistas, ocorridas principalmente pela manhã, a sessão é um reflexo do que a sociedade brasileira e suas instituições vêm construindo nos últimos anos: brigas, dedos em riste, acusações de todos os lados, desvio do assunto principal. Afirmações veementes que se colocam acima da dúvida, ausência de decoro, respeito e do rigor que o cargo de ministro do STF exige.


A Corte vive um momento de ‘hemorragia interna’. Dois de seus membros — [Alexandre de] Moraes e [André] Mendonça …

author: CNT Colmenar Viejo
title: 20 de septiembre. El crédito mutuo: una alternativa anarquista
content:
Este próximo

domingo 20 de septiembre a las 18:00 h, en el local del sindicato, calle Carrilejos 37 de Colmenar Viejo,

 nos juntamos realizar una charla-debate sobre el crédito mutuo como una alternativa anarquista.


El acceso obrero a crédito libre de usura ha sido una parte del programa revolucionario del anarquismo desde prácticamente los orígenes del movimiento con la propuesta de Proudhon del Banco del Pueblo en 1848. Este banco establecería un sistema de crédito mutuo que permitiera a la clase obrera establecer sus propias cooperativas para, de ese modo, tomar el control de los medios de producción en sociedad.


Junto al socorro mutuo y el apoyo mutuo, el crédito mutuo es uno de los ejes principales de la teoría mutualista de Proudhon y sus sucesores. Para profundizar en este sistema, en la CNT de Colmenar Viejo vamos a proyectar el próximo domingo 20 de Septiembre a las 18:00 para ver un pequeño video explicativo del divulgador Andrew Sage y realizar un coloquio posterior para discutir los pros y contras del modelo y su viabilidad como herramienta revolucionaria.

I was having a nice time being more offline but then Ed Sheeran decided to nuke his career for a few more stadium gigs and it is a joy to watch that go down in real time. Well done buddy, everyone knows you’re a spineless twat now. Get fucked. Free Palestine.

BTW what Macklemore has said about it:

>“I’m going to speak from the heart and share the truth. Ed Sheeran and his team have made the decision to remove me from The Loop tour. But before I get into it, I want to say something that should be obvious. In this moment I think it matters. I am not a victim. Ed Sheeran is not a victim. Pink is not a victim. We have careers, money, opportunities, safety and audiences around the world. Whatever consequences any of us face for what we say, we get to go home to our families.

>The victims are the Palestinian people. The men, women and children who have been killed, starved, displaced and forced to live through unimaginable violence. More than 20,000 children have been killed in Gaza alone. People are being killed today, and people will be killed tomorrow. I want to make sure that as I tell this story, we don’t lose sight of that.

>Last Monday, in the middle of all the media attention surrounding Pink and what I said at MetLife, Ed told me that Robert Kraft called him. We were scheduled to play Gillette Stadium later this month, which is owned by the Kraft Group. Ed told me that Kraft said I would not be allowed to perform in his stadium. Ed also told me that Kraft had rallied some of the other stadium owners and collectively they gave him an ultimatum: if Macklemore stays on the tour, you will not be allowed to play in our venues.

>Ed was in a fucked up position. He knew it. His typical apolitical stance was being challenged in a way it never had been before. He told me that the words “Free Palestine” and the image of the Palestinian flag were hurtful to a lot of people he spoke with. I told him that if those words were more offensive than tens of thousands of Palestinian children being killed by Israel, then there was a fundamental disconnect between where those people stood and where I stood. But he couldn’t get past his public facing, “I don’t take sides.

>And I get why people don’t. Taking a side can cost you. Money, brand deals, sponsorships, festivals, private shows, relationships and access. I’ve lost all of those things. But there is no neutral position between the oppressor and the oppressed. When one side has the bombs and bottomless financial and military support from America, refusing to take a side doesn’t leave you in the middle.

>What I said at MetLife I have been saying on stages around the world for almost three years. So why is it an issue now? Because now I’m sharing a stage with one of the biggest artists in the world, in some of the biggest stadiums in America. At a certain level of exposure, "Free Palestine” becomes too much of a risk. If I kept doing the shows, saying Free Palestine, with Ed implicitly supporting it, the crowd getting loud and showing undeniable support for Palestinian liberation, what artist might speak out next? The stage becomes resistance. Maybe that’s why this time it became so important to silence me.

>And one of the most effective ways to enforce that silence has been to weaponize the accusation of antisemitism. Antisemitism is real. And that is exactly why the word matters too much to be used as a shield against criticism of the Israeli state. When criticizing Israel, opposing Zionism or saying “Free Palestine” gets conflated with hatred of Jewish people, it doesn’t protect Jewish people. It protects Israel from accountability.

>Who is winning the internet, who is getting canceled, who gets to play the stadium and who doesn’t, all of it becomes so small when held against what we are actually witnessing in Gaza and the West Bank. An entire people being displaced, starved and killed while the world debates which words we are allowed to use to describe it, how those words make us feel, and whether our discomfort matters more than the people living through a genocide.

>I didn’t need 10 shows from Ed. I needed 2. Two chances to stand in front of 90,000 people and say the words that somehow became too dangerous to say. Free Palestine. But if those words cost me the stage, while turning the conversation back to Palestine, then it was the most successful tour I’ve ever been on.“

author: Unknown
title: Rojhilat Alliance: People’s demands must be basis for change
content:
The Rojhilat (Eastern Kurdistan) Political Forces Alliance issued a written statement marking the fourth anniversary of the Jin, Jiyan, Azadî (Woman, Life, Freedom) Revolution.


The statement said: "Four years have passed since the killing of Jina Amini and the Jin, Jiyan, Azadî Revolution. As the Political Forces Alliance of Iranian Kurdistan, we attach great importance to this historic period and approach it from a broad perspective, as it became a turning point in strengthening the struggle in Kurdistan and other parts of Iran against the rule of the Islamic Republic. This revolution is a continuation of decades of struggle for freedom and liberation, while also representing women’s struggle for their rights alongside the Kurdish rights movement."


The statement added that "the Jin, Jiyan, Azadî uprising, launched by women and young people in Kurdistan following the martyrdom of Jina Amini, rapidly developed into a nationwide political and social movement across Iran. The period that began with uprisings in Kurdistan continued through different forms of action, including strikes, student protests and demonstrations by professional groups. The participation of women and young people, as well as different social classes and professional groups, ensured that the movement did not remain limited in scope but developed into a broader public discourse centred on freedom, human dignity and the struggle against discrimination and silencing.


The spread of protests across different cities in Iran, demonstrations at universities, strikes, actions by workers and professional groups, commemorations for the martyrs and the expansion of protests among other peoples, particularly in Baluchistan, demonstrated the movement’s considerable capacity to bring different demands together. One of the most important features of this revolution has been its ability to unite the demands of women, young people, students, different peoples, classes and sections of society within a common framework."


The statement continued: "From a strategic perspective, the experience of the Jin, Jiyan, Azadî uprising has demonstrated that across Iran there is both the potential and the capacity to build a broad movement capable of bringing about fundamental change, mobilising the energy of the protests and political consensus, and developing a common programme for the future. The experience of the movement has also shown that when women’s demands, civil liberties, national rights and the demands of different social classes develop within a common framework, they can become a powerful force for securing rights and standards of equality.


Four years later, the political, social and economic conditions of the people have reached their worst levels. High inflation and unemployment have reached record levels, further deepening poverty across Kurdistan and Iran and making life increasingly unbearable for the poor and the working class. This is a direct consequence of the regime’s domestic and foreign policies, which divert the people’s resources and income towards war while pursuing a policy of marginalisation in Kurdistan and other regions."


The statement said that "the wave of arrests targeting political and civil activists, women’s rights activists, cultural and environmental activists, workers and teachers has also reached unprecedented levels. The regime’s use of executions, imprisonment and torture as instruments of intimidation and silencing is increasing across Iran, particularly in Kurdistan. Violence against women has systematically intensified. The suppression of women’s rights stems not only from patriarchal attitudes within society but also from the support of legal and state institutions. The burden of the crises and difficulties facing society has also significantly increased the pressure on women.


The Islamic Republic of Iran’s continuing attacks against Kurdish parties and its insistence on enforcing international agreements are another manifestation of the regime’s hostility towards every political demand and of its mentality opposed to freedom and humanity. Despite all the crises and obstacles, Kurdistan continues to occupy a central position in the balance of forces in Iran. Kurdish political forces in Iran have taken an important step towards building an alliance and strengthening internal unity by correctly assessing this period. Amid this crisis, the position of the Kurds has grown stronger both within Iran and internationally …

What you’re about to read is the second edition of this zine. This will continue to be a living text, hopefully. We here at Punch Up • Kick Down invite you to engage with it. We’d love for you to voice your critiques, point out blind spots, offer fresh ideas, and we welcome feedback of any kind. Our email is on the back of this book. More importantly, we invite you to further the conversation with the people around you.

Since I am not an academic, this is not an academic work. I have done my best to cite references and credit resources. The numbers you see next to quotes or excerpts - like this1` – correspond numerically to the list on the reference page in the back of this zine. For sources, refer to that reference page. I am highly indebted to the source materials that I cite and refer to within, and want to acknowledge those works for inspiring, shaping, informing, and building this piece.

By no means is this an exhaustive or definitive work. I don’t claim to be breaking new ground here. My goal has been to gather and collect some ideas, distill and organize those ideas, and to present them in a way that is (hopefully) coherent and accessible. I hope this can help folks think critically about these topics even if they may be challenging.

Also (I can’t believe I have to say this) at no point in the writing or editing of this work did we utilize Large Language Models (aka A.I.) While this whole work is a critique of punishment, I wish nothing but Destruction to the demonic machines who threaten our capacity to think and relate, who deny us our full humanity.

As meaning-seeking creatures, human beings long for narrative structure. In response to the disempowering conditions of today's world, we often cling to a dichotomy of Good versus Evil. Filled with righteous indignation, burdened by economic stress, haunted by existential uncertainty, and emboldened by cognitive biases and social conditioning, we search for somewhere to place the blame for these feelings. Inflicting pain on someone we deem deserving of it is the only power that feels within reach. “Being alive in a knife-edge moment like this, being forced to be complicit in it while our so-called leaders fail so miserably to act, unavoidably generates all kinds of morbid symptoms. Inevitably, people reach for narratives to make sense of this reality.”6

Modern conditions create moral panic and foster a social dynamic that reframes systemic social problems as individual moral failings. This path leads us towards a belief that other people are a threat; that cooperation is impossible and we must therefore seek out and punish some existential enemy. This general blaming structure is a phenomenon prevalent all along the socio-political spectrum: identifying a target for discontentedness and deriving a sense of identity, purpose, and superiority by punishing scapegoats.

author: Dyepeson Martins
title: Ministra Cármen Lúcia dá o tom do dia no STF: “não garantimos o rigor que deveríamos”
content:
A sessão histórica do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), marcada para analisar as mensagens trocadas entre o ministro Alexandre de Moraes e o ex-banqueiro Daniel Vorcaro, dono do Master, estava marcada para começar às 10h. Já passava das 16h20 desta terça-feira, 15 de setembro, e a reunião ainda não tinha alcançado a discussão do mérito da pauta – nenhum dos nove integrantes da mais alta Corte do país havia se manifestado sobre a a—bertura de uma investigação sobre a conduta de Moraes, exposta por outro magistrado do grupo, ministro André Mendonça. O debate, naquele momento, envolvia uma Questão de Ordem apresentada pelo decano Gilmar Mendes, que tentou suspender a reunião extraordinária e marcá-la para o próximo dia 23.


Duas horas depois, a sessão foi finalizada, e o mérito continuou sem análise. Ao longo de todo o dia, os ministros deliberaram apenas se Moraes deveria ter seu julgamento conjunto com o de Mendonça. No turbilhão da crise que assolou o Supremo desde o dia 2 de setembro, Moraes havia pedido ao presidente do Corte, Edson Fachin, a inclusão de Mendonça no inquérito das Fake News. A decisão foi baseada em relatórios de inteligência fornecidos pela Polícia Federal (PF), em que a corporação aponta um desequilíbrio na condução de André Mendonça no caso Master contra políticos, com indícios de “enviesamento”.


Alexandre de Moraes conta com aliados como Gilmar Mendes e Flávio Dino para evitar uma investigação sobre sua suposta relação com o caso Master


Prevaleceu no plenário, por quatro votos a três, a recusa à Questão de Ordem apresentada por Gilmar, de unir os dois casos. Foram favoráveis os ministros Gilmar Mendes, Alexandre de Moraes, Cristiano Zanin e Flávio Dino. Enquanto Fachin, André Mendonça e Luiz Fux e Cármen Lúcia foram contrários à união das duas análises. Houve, porém, o pedido de vista do ministro Flávio Dino. Isso significa que a sessão será interrompida por até 90 dias para que ele possa analisar melhor o caso e posteriormente devolver aos magistrados.


Única mulher a integrar a Corte, Cármen Lúcia só tomou a palavra às 17h56, após mais de sete horas do início do julgamento, em que permaneceu em silêncio, diferentemente de seus pares do gênero masculino. Em sua fala, ela declarou estar “profundamente consternada e triste” com a crise institucional do STF. Apontou, ainda, que a Corte provocou “intranquilidade” no país, que está a menos de 20 dias do primeiro turno das eleições presidenciais. Em seguida, pediu “desculpa” ao “povo brasileiro”. “Eu peço desculpa ao povo brasileiro por talvez ter esperado de mim uma postura diferente. Mas acho que todos nós aqui queríamos a mesma coisa, que era tentar resolver, e as questões não foram resolvidas e foram crescendo demais”, afirmou.


A ministra ainda criticou o que chamou de “espetacularização” dos julgamentos do STF. “Nós não garantimos o rigor e seriedade que deveríamos. Peço desculpas aos colegas e ao povo por não ter conseguido resolver essas questões de melhor modo. Houve uma espetacularização desses casos, dessa sessão, que não faz mal apenas ao Supremo, mas ao país. O país espera uma tranquilidade do Supremo que não conseguimos dar.”


A declaração da ministra ocorreu após uma série de embates entre os ministros durante a reunião desta terça-feira. O primeiro deles foi protagonizado pelo ministro Flávio Dino e o próprio presidente da Corte, Edson Fachin, que abriu a sessão centralizando em seu discurso a necessidade de preservar “sensatez, decoro e serenidade”. Ainda na primeira hora, porém, o equilíbrio entre os magistrados pareceu se desfazer. Dino pediu um aparte a Toffoli, que também esteve no epicentro do inquérito do Master, mas teve seu caso arquivado após uma reunião a portas fechadas entre os ministros.


Interrompendo Dino, Fachin respondeu que a palavra deveria ser sempre solicitada à presidência. Último ministro a compor a Corte, Dino retrucou que seguiria o regimento interno do Supremo, que, segundo ele, tem o aparte “dirigido ao relator”. A troca de farpas continuou, com direito a citação por Dino dos filósofos Thomas Hobbes e Aristóteles, além do cantor e compositor Chico César.


Antes mesmo do início da sessão, o ministro encaminhou um requerimento ao decano Gilmar Mendes, para que ele, na sua condição de substituto legal do Presidente e do Vice-presidente da Corte, restabelecesse o cumprimento da Constituição Federal, da lei e do Regimento Interno do STF. De acordo com Dino, há irregularidades na condução do processo por …

title: Acuerdo para designación de jueces: como era previsto, fue una semana de fallos para el poder
content:
Luego del escandaloso acuerdo entre el oficialismo, el peronismo y el pro para el acuerdo de pliegos y designación de jueces paso lo esperado. En apenas unos días, una serie de decisiones judiciales beneficiaron a Mauricio Macri, Javier Milei, Luis Caputo y funcionarios de la gestión macrista. Las resoluciones se conocieron al mismo tiempo que se consolida la nueva composición de la Cámara Federal porteña, integrada entre otros por Pablo Bertuzzi y Pablo Yadarola, recientemente designados por el Gobierno. Por ANRed


El 3 de septiembre, el juez Marcelo Martínez de Giorgi sobreseyó a Gustavo Arribas, Silvia Majdalani y otros exfuncionarios de la AFI en la causa por las tareas de inteligencia realizadas durante las cumbres de la OMC de 2017 y el G20 de 2018. El CELS cuestionó la decisión y anunció que apelará.


El 7 de septiembre, la Sala I de la Cámara Federal confirmó el sobreseimiento de

Mauricio Macri, Arribas y Majdalani

 en otra investigación por la presunta recolección ilegal de correos electrónicos de dirigentes políticos, periodistas y miembros de fuerzas de seguridad.


Ese mismo tribunal confirmó el sobreseimiento de

Luis Caputo

 en una causa iniciada en 2017, vinculada con su actuación durante el gobierno de Macri y la supuesta omisión de información patrimonial y posibles incompatibilidades relacionadas con operaciones financieras.


También fue archivada la investigación por el préstamo de

US$57.000 millones del FMI solicitado durante el gobierno de Macri

. Los camaristas Mariano Llorens y Pablo Bertuzzi consideraron que se trató de una decisión política que no configuraba un delito probado. La Procuración del Tesoro, ya bajo el gobierno de Milei, había desistido de continuar como querellante.


En el caso de

Javier Milei

, la Justicia todavía no cerró la causa $LIBRA, pero la nueva Cámara Federal confirmó que cinco inversores que denunciaron haber sido perjudicados no podrán actuar como querellantes. La investigación continúa, aunque queda sin esas querellas particulares. Días después, el juez Martínez de Giorgi también rechazó que dos diputados de la Coalición Cívica se incorporaran como querellantes.


Y este martes se sumó otro sobreseimiento:

Flavio, Hugo y Rosana Caputo

, hermanos del ministro de Economía, fueron desvinculados de la causa que investigaba el presunto financiamiento de Revolución Federal mediante contrataciones de Caputo Hermanos. La Justicia sostuvo que no pudo acreditarse una finalidad delictiva en esas operaciones. Los integrantes de Revolución Federal, en cambio, fueron enviados a juicio por amenazas e incitación a la violencia colectiva.


 


Ver esta publicación en Instagram


 


Una publicación compartida de Agencia de Noticias Red Acción (@anredaccion)


EL ACUERDO QUE PRECEDIÓ A LOS FALLOS


Los nuevos fallos tienen como antecedente inmediato la votación del Senado del 28 de agosto. Con los votos del oficialismo, el PRO, la UCR y el peronismo, fueron aprobados

66 de 67 pliegos judiciales

.


Entre ellos estuvo

Pablo Yadarola

, uno de los jueces que participó en el viaje a Lago Escondido de 2022 junto a magistrados, fiscales, funcionarios y empresarios. La designación había sido cuestionada anteriormente por sectores del kirchnerismo, que habían vinculado aquel viaje con una trama de relaciones entre miembros del Poder Judicial y sectores del poder económico.


La votación fue cuestionada por

Myriam Bregman

, quien señaló que en el Senado sectores que se presentan como opositores terminaron votando junto con el oficialismo y el macrismo los mismos jueces que anteriormente habían cuestionado.


“

Se hacen los opositores, pero votan juntos

”, sostuvo Bregman, y cuestionó que se aprobara a jueces vinculados al episodio de Lago Escondido.


La secuencia deja una postal política que merece ser mirada en conjunto:

designación de nuevos magistrados, acuerdos entre bloques para aprobar sus pliegos y, pocos días después, una batería de resoluciones que beneficia a figuras centrales del macrismo y del actual gobierno

.

title: Lionel Messi’nin milli takım veda maçı belli oldu
content:
Lionel Messi, Arjantin Milli Takımı’nın 6 Ekim’de Benin ile oynayacağı hazırlık maçında forma giyecek. Karşılaşmanın Messi’nin milli takıma veda maçı olması bekleniyor.

Arjantin Milli Takımı’nın ekim ayında oynayacağı hazırlık maçları öncesinde kadrosu açıklandı.

Teknik direktör Lionel Scaloni tarafından belirlenen kadroda Avrupa’da forma giyen birçok önemli oyuncu yer aldı.

Arjantin Futbol Federasyonu’nun (AFA) duyurusuna göre Lionel Messi, Rodrigo De Paul ve Giovani Lo Celso, 6 Ekim’de oynanacak Benin maçının kadrosunda yer aldı.

Arjantin’in yerel liginde forma giyen oyuncuların yer alacağı kadronun ise 18 Eylül Cuma günü açıklanacağı belirtildi.

AFA’nın duyurusunda, Scaloni’nin ekim ayındaki hazırlık karşılaşmaları için ilk oyuncu grubunu belirlediği ifade edildi.

Lionel Scaloni tarafından belirlenen kadroda şu isimler bulunuyor:

title: Bologna, Tedesco'yla yollarını ayırdı
content:

Serie A ekibi Bologna, geçen sezon Fenerbahçe'yi çalıştıran teknik direktör Domenico Tedesco'yla yollarını ayırdı.

Hem Almanya hem İtalya vatandaşı olan Tedesco yönetiminde 4 maçta 1 puan toplayabilen Bologna, Raffaele Palladino ile anlaştı. 42 yaşındaki Palladino daha önce Monza, Fiorentina ve geçen sezon da Atalanta'yı çalıştırdı.

Domenico Tedesco, 2025/26 sezonunda Fenerbahçe ile Süper Kupa kazanmış, ligi de Galatasaray'ın ardından ikinci tamamlamıştı. Alman teknik direktör, görevine son verilmesinin ardından çok sarı-lacivertli taraftar tarafından tesislerden uğurlanmıştı.

author: Trojka
title: 3 października, Toruń – DEMONSTRACJA PRZECIWKO KSENOFOBII – NASZE ULICE, WASZE GRANICE
content:
Ksenofobia często przedstawiana jest jako pogląd marginalny, charakterystyczny wyłącznie dla skrajnych środowisk. W rzeczywistości uprzedzenia wobec migrantów i migrantek coraz częściej stają się elementem codziennego języka debaty publicznej, polityki i medialnych narracji. Lęk przed „obcym”, straszenie migracją, terroryzmem, przemocą, chorobami czy utratą miejsc pracy są wykorzystywane do budowania podziałów i kierowania społecznego niezadowolenia przeciwko tym, których najłatwiej wskazać jako winnych.


Nie zgadzamy się na świat, w którym człowiek oceniany jest przez pryzmat miejsca urodzenia, pochodzenia, koloru skóry, języka, dokumentów czy posiadanego obywatelstwa. Nie zgadzamy się na dzielenie ludzi na „swoich” i „obcych”, na tych, którym należy się bezpieczeństwo, godność i prawa, oraz tych, których można pozbawić ich tylko dlatego, że przekroczyli granicę.


Nasza demonstracja jest częścią kampanii „Nasze ulice, wasze granice”, prowadzonej wspólnie przez Federację Anarchistyczną i 161 Crew. Kampania skupia się na problemie dyskryminacji migrantów i migrantek oraz na sposobach, w jakie państwo i jego instytucje zarządzają migracją, wykorzystując do tego dyskurs antagonizmu, strachu i supremacji etnicznej.


Chcemy mówić nie tylko o pojedynczych przypadkach przemocy czy dyskryminacji, ale przede wszystkim o ich systemowych źródłach. O przepisach, procedurach i instytucjach, które utrudniają ludziom funkcjonowanie, podejmowanie pracy, organizowanie się i walkę o swoje prawa. O ograniczeniach, które sprawiają, że migrantki i migranci są szczególnie narażeni na wyzysk, zależność i przemoc. O tym, że nierówność nie zaczyna się i nie kończy na ulicznym wyzwisku — jest również zapisana w prawie, polityce migracyjnej i sposobie organizowania naszego wspólnego życia.


Podsycanie lęku przed Innym nie jest nowym sposobem sprawowania władzy. Straszenie „migrantami”, którzy mają rzekomo zabierać pracę, podnosić ceny mieszkań, odpowiadać za pogarszającą się jakość życia czy stanowić zagrożenie dla bezpieczeństwa, pozwala odwrócić uwagę od rzeczywistych przyczyn problemów społecznych. Zamiast pytać, dlaczego coraz więcej osób nie może pozwolić sobie na mieszkanie, dlaczego praca staje się coraz bardziej niepewna, dlaczego rosną nierówności i dlaczego coraz trudniej o dostęp do podstawowych usług, wskazuje się kolejne grupy, które mają ponosić za to odpowiedzialność.


Nie kupujemy tej opowieści! Problemem nie są ludzie, którzy przemieszczają się w poszukiwaniu bezpiecznego i godnego życia. Problemem jest system, który wykorzystuje ich niepewną sytuację, aby łatwiej ich kontrolować i eksploatować.


Nie chcemy świata opartego na strachu i podejrzliwości.


Chcemy świata, w którym prawa człowieka nie zależą od paszportu. W którym żadna osoba nie jest traktowana jako mniej wartościowa dlatego, że urodziła się po drugiej stronie granicy. W którym miejsce urodzenia nie decyduje o tym, czy można legalnie pracować, mieszkać, organizować się i żyć bez ciągłego strachu przed deportacją.


Nasza odpowiedź na politykę strachu to solidarność. Na podziały odpowiadamy współpracą. Na nacjonalistyczne hasła odpowiadamy przekonaniem, że żadne granice nie powinny decydować o wartości człowieka.


Zapraszamy wszystkich i wszystkie, którym nie jest obojętne, jak wygląda nasze wspólne życie. Zapraszamy osoby, które sprzeciwiają się rasizmowi i ksenofobii, osoby działające na rzecz praw człowieka, pracownic i pracowników, migrantów i migrantek, osoby zaangażowane społecznie oraz wszystkich tych, którzy uważają, że solidarność jest silniejsza niż podziały.


NASZE ULICE, WASZE GRANICE.

RÓWNE PRAWA DLA WSZYSTKICH.

SWOBODA PRZEMIESZCZANIA SIĘ.

3 PAŹDZIERNIKA

author: anred
title: «AySA no se privatiza, el agua no es una mercancía
content:
Hoy numerosas agrupaciones ambientales, sindicales, sociales y partidarias se convocaron frente al Ministerio de Economía para denunciar el llamado a licitación de AySA por parte del gobierno nacional que pretende transformar un servicio público en un negociado de unos pocos, en oposición a las normativas nacionales e internacionales que declaran al agua como un derecho humano.


Por Patricia Rodríguez para ANRed 


Esta mañana, a las 9.30, las organizaciones socioambientales y territoriales nucleadas en el Foro Hídrico y Ambiental de Lomas de Zamora convocan a una movilización frente al Ministerio de Economía (Hipólito Yrigoyen 250, CABA) contra la privatización de AySA. La protesta tuvo lugar el mismo día en que vencía el plazo para la presentación de ofertas por el 90% de las acciones de la empresa que permanecen en manos del Estado nacional.


Con las consignas «No a la privatización de AYSA», «No a la reducción de controles de la calidad del agua» y «No a las tarifas abusivas ni al corte de agua por falta de pago», las organizaciones vuelven a poner en el centro la defensa del acceso al agua potable y el saneamiento como derechos, mientras cuestionan las condiciones del proceso privatizador y la participación de la empresa israelí Mekorot como asesora.


Además, pese a la medida cautelar dictada por la Defensoría del Pueblo bonaerense que ordenaba no innovar, hoy se abrieron los sobres electrónicos de la primera etapa de la licitación y quedaron confirmados dos consorcios, Rowing-Arcos-Transclor-PHX, y Roggio.


Mauricio Filiberti, dueño de Transclor, el proveedor del insumo más importante que consume AySA, el cloro, es, además, socio de José Luis Manzano y de Daniel Vila accionistas de Edenor. Por lo tanto, Aysa, principal cliente de Edenor constituirían ambas empresas un monopolio que manejaría la electricidad y el agua del Amba.

author: Keelan Jacobs
title: Anishinabek Nation tells Carney summit resources ‘are not theirs to give’
content:
As Prime Minister Mark Carney wraps up the first investment summit with investors from around the world, the Anishinabek Nation has a warning for the government.


“The lands and resources being targeted for development and investment are within the treaty territories of the Anishinabek First Nations around the Great Lakes region,” said Grand Council Chief Linda Debassige in a statement.


“As with the first European contact, the Governments of Canada and Ontario, along with investors, continue to fail to recognize our Nation’s sovereignty over lands and resources.


Carney’s two-day gathering brought federal and provincial ministers, leading global investors, Canadian CEOs and public-sector representatives and was focused on accelerating new investments into Canada.


“At the first Canada Investment Summit, we unleashed nearly $500 billion of new investment into Canada,” Carney said in his closing speech at the summit. “That means more good jobs for our workers. Major new opportunities for our businesses. Canada is boldly unleashing our potential — and we are just getting started.”


But Debassige called out the government for its “continued failure to respect our Nations’ inherent rights and the treaties.


“First Nations will continue to demand justice, respect, and the fulfillment of the Crown’s constitutional and treaty obligations to the original relationship. Trust must be built before any investment can be made in our territories,” she said.


Anishinabek Grand Council Chief Linda Debassige is pictured appearing before the Senate committee on human rights earlier this year. Photo: APTN.


Debassige tied that warning to the royal investment that first commercialized the region.


In 1670, Debassige said, the Crown King Charles II of England – issued a Royal Charter to create the Hudson’s Bay Company. Backed by that investment, the company established remote trading posts and built long-term commercial relationships with First Peoples that relied on trust to supply European demand for beaver-pelt hats.


“Governments and investors must understand that, just as it was in 1670, these resources belong to our Nations; certainty is only assumed,” she said.


Access to Anishinabek land and resources “begins with our trust,” Debassige said, and projects must foster meaningful, respectful relationships for sustainable investment.


She called on all governments to “move beyond the ignorance of our Nation’s inherent rights,” and further said the prime minister is “brokering deals involving our Nation’s resources overseas and without our Nations.”


At the first Canada Investment Summit, we unleashed nearly $500 billion of new investment into Canada. That means more good jobs for our workers. Major new opportunities for our businesses.


Canada is boldly unleashing our potential — and we are just getting started.

pic.twitter.com/Yd9yJr7lnV


— Mark Carney (@MarkJCarney)

September 15, 2026


That charge echoed a separate warning issued Monday by the Anishnabe Nation of Lac Simon in Quebec.


The council said the proposed Kino Aski liquefied natural gas project — a pipeline that would move gas from Western Canada to Baie–Comeau on Quebec’s North Shore for export to Europe “currently lacks both community consent and significant social acceptance.”


Chief Lucien Wabanonik said the project “has not been approved and must, without fail, obtain the free, prior and informed consent of the Anishnabe Nation of Lac Simon and the other affected First Nations — which is not currently the case.” The council told potential investors and Ottawa that consent “cannot be presumed, circumvented, or replaced by discussions conducted without the full and meaningful participation of the many affected First Nations.”


Debassige called on Carney to demonstrate the Crown’s meaningful commitment to upholding the Honour of the Crown, upholding the treaty relationships, upholding the principles of reconciliation, and respect for the sovereignty of the many Nations of the Anishinabek Nation.

Lac Simon warns LNG project requires First Nations consent 


The Anishinabek Nation said it stands ready to work collaboratively, provided that adequate, equitable economic development occurs with its communities, that respects and supports environmental integrity and advances true reconciliation.

title: Macklemore’un kesilmesine tepki: Ed Sheeran’ın ABD turnesindeki tüm ön gruplar çekildi
content:
Ed Sheeran’ın ABD turnesindeki tüm ön gruplar, rapçi Macklemore’un sahnede Filistin yanlısı açıklamalar yapmasının ardından turne kadrosundan çıkarılmasını protesto ederek çekildi.

Turneden ayrılan isimler arasında Finneas, Aaron Rowe, Lukas Graham ve Sheeran’a sahnede eşlik eden İrlandalı folk grubu Beoga bulunuyor. Finneas, “Sanatçılar, ezilenler için seslerini yükselttiklerinde susturulmamalı,” açıklamasını yaptı.

Açıklamalar, Sheeran’ın Gazze konusunda kamuoyu önünde yürütülecek bir tartışmanın içine çekilmeyeceğini söylemesinden ve Macklemore’un turneden çıkarılmasından kendisinin sorumlu olmadığını iddia etmesinden saatler sonra geldi.

Macklemore, New Jersey’deki iki konserde “Özgür Filistin” çağrısında bulunmuş ve Gazze’deki yıkımı gösteren görüntüler yayımlamıştı. Açıklamaların bazı Yahudi kuruluşların tepkisini çekmesinin ardından kimi konser mekanlarının organizatörlere baskı yaptığı belirtildi. Macklemore, bu isimler arasında NFL takımı New England Patriots'ın ve Gillette Stadyumu'nun sahibi milyarder Robert Kraft'ın bulunduğunu belirtti.

Sheeran, Macklemore’un turneden çıkarılmasının kendisinin değil organizatör Messina Touring Group’un kararı olduğunu söyledi. İsrail-Filistin çatışmasından “dehşete düştüğünü” belirten İngiliz şarkıcı, konserlerini siyasi bir platform olarak kullanmamayı tercih ettiğini ve kalan konserleri iptal ederek hayranlarını ve turne çalışanlarını yüzüstü bırakmayacağını ifade etti.
