title: Emon Azmi - The Reformism Inherent to Statism
content:
Author

: Emon Azmi

Title

: The Reformism Inherent to Statism

Subtitle

: Autonomous Politics against Fascism

Date

: September 15, 2026

Source

: https://thatanarkatamuslim.substack.com/p/the-statism-inherent-to-fascism


 As oppressive conditions internal to the u.s. settler empire are clarified through the (re)consolidation of amerikan fascism, the prospect of revolution feels strikingly urgent and yet ever more remote. So much of our “past” seems to be reappearing as our present, but our moment is not the same and the state of our struggles reflect this fact.


 Many purported “revolutionary outlooks” are taking on reformist ends and proposing reformist means. (Neo)liberalism is shaping the political projects of most progressive forces in the imperial core. Much of ‘the left’ continues holding to statist theories and methodologies of struggle despite these proving incapable of meeting the challenges defining our political epoch in any revolutionary way, especially on u.s. occupied Turtle Island.


 Our stands against fascism, if they are to be effective, must come through our liberation struggles. And our liberation struggles, if we are to win, must move beyond statism.


 Here, we will explore: 1) how the State, repression, and reformism interconnect as counterrevolutionary forces and fuel fascism; 2) why government, statism, and the politics of appeal must be rejected to struggle toward liberation; and 3) the politics of autonomy as necessarily revolutionary, and expropriation as an alternative strategic logic for winning concessions from the government.


 Inshallah, i hope you derive something beneficial from this essay and engage the works i reference throughout further.


The State, Repression, & Reformism


 There’s a pervasive notion across progressive spaces, especially in the u.s. settler empire, that we should quell the ire of the State to “win favorable policy changes (concessions) until conditions are right for revolution”. That unless a movement is big enough, the people angry enough, the cause popular enough, we do what’s necessary to stave off the State’s mobilization against us, to keep its repression confined and not widely felt.


 So when radicals within these movements and spaces say, as the writers of

Black Armed Joy

 do,

“We seek unmediated and uncompromising conflict with the State and Capital… Living by principle means we dismantle systems (as best we can) in this world at this moment.”

, they are marginalized, framed as undisciplined and impractical for “inviting repression”.


 There are crucial things to consider around repression when acting on our conditions. Protecting those in and across our communities who are most vulnerable when it heightens and as it spreads is necessary. Organizing to effectively counteract it is necessary and a task in itself. But we should not confuse giving these things proper attention and effort with the impulse to avoid or stave off repression in itself, whether all-together or until some arbitrary “revolutionary moment”.


 Jonathan Jackson illustrates the significance of repression in

Blood In My Eye

. Discussing the aftermath of a 1969 shootout around the Black Panther Party LA headquarters, he says:


 Have you grasped the significance of the backlash? It has stung the fascist. The people are in foment, all of them, of all persuasion. They don’t dig midnight or dawn raiding parties, bullets with steel jackets, cowardly pigs perched upon their roofs, the same gases manufactured for use against the Vietnamese Liberators blowing back into their faces: Repression. Do you see the effect it has on the uncommitted? Comrade, Repression exposes. By drawing out the violence of the beast, the vanguard party is demonstrating for the world to examine just what terms [capitalist, fascist, rule] is predicated on — their power to organize violence, our acquiesce.

(Jackson, p.23)


 Repression is a core part of revolution. The drive to avoid it, in many cases, roots to reformism.


 Reformists, progressive and conservative alike, derive no benefit from ongoing direct conflict with the State and ruling classes, nor the wide-spread repression accompanying it, when a path to negotiation is available. In fact, even when no such path exists, the benefit of this type of conflict and its accompanying repression is still negligible; because it indicates some strategic failing on the part of the reform movement or the reformist currents in a revolutionary …

title: Atakum Belediyesi işçileri: Alacaklarımızın bir bölümü ödendi, mücadele bitmedi
content:
Atakum Belediyesi önünde 11 gündür direniş çadırında bulunan işçiler, alacaklarının bir bölümünün hesaplarına yatırıldığını ve belediye yönetiminin kendileriyle diyalog kurmaya başladığını açıkladı. İşçiler, bu gelişmeleri “ilk kazanım” olarak değerlendirerek 8 gündür sürdürdükleri açlık grevini sonlandırdı. İşçiler, tüm talepleri karşılanana kadar direniş çadırındaki nöbetlerine devam edeceklerini bildirdi.

Atakum Belediyesi önünde yapılan basın açıklamasına emek ve demokrasi güçleri de destek verdi. Açıklama öncesinde işçiler, kendilerini ziyaret eden Atakum Belediyesi Özel Kalem Müdürü Gökhan Çakır ile görüşerek taleplerini aktardı.

Çakır, "işçilerin taleplerinin meşru ve haklı olduğunu belirterek sorunların çözümü için elinden geleni yapmaya çalıştığını" söyledi.

İşçi Dayanışması adına Fatma Ayyıldız Sayım tarafından okunan açıklamada, direnişin 11’inci, açlık grevinin ise 8’inci gününde olduğu belirtildi.

Açıklamada, Atakum Belediyesi işçilerinin alacaklarının bir bölümünün hesaplarına yatırıldığı belirtilerek, belediye yetkililerinin de önceki süreçten farklı olarak işçileri dikkate almaya ve taleplerini dinlemeye başladığı ifade edildi.

İşçiler, belediyedeki yetkili sendika Genel-İş’in aldığı iş bırakma kararını da olumlu bulduklarını belirterek, bu eylemin bir parçası olduklarını ve bundan sonraki süreçte nöbet eylemlerini sürdüreceklerini açıkladı.

Açıklamada, “Niyetimizin ailemizden, sevdiklerimizden, çocuklarımızdan uzakta direniş çadırında kalmak olmadığını, hızlı ve gerçek bir çözüm için elimizi taşın altına koymaya hazır olduğumuzu hatırlatmak istiyoruz” denildi.

İşçiler, açlık grevinin Samsun halkında ve grevdeki işçilerin ailelerinde endişe ve kaygı yarattığını belirterek bu kaygının daha fazla yaşanmasını istemediklerini ifade etti.

Bu nedenle, hesaplara yapılan kısmi ödemenin ardından açlık grevini sonlandırma kararı aldıklarını belirten işçiler, bunun taleplerinin tamamının karşılandığı anlamına gelmediğini vurguladı.

İşçiler; tüm birimlerde çalışanların alacaklarının ödenmesini ve şeffaf bir ödeme planının işçilerle ve Samsun halkıyla paylaşılmasını talep etti.

Açıklamada, “Bu taleplerimiz gerçekleşene kadar nöbet eylemimizi sonlandırmayacağımızı, Atakum Belediyesi bahçesine kurduğumuz direniş çadırını kaldırmayacağımızı ilan etmek istiyoruz” ifadelerine yer verildi.

İşçiler, yaşadıkları sorunların geldiği aşamada eylem dışında başka yollarının kalmadığını belirterek haklı ve meşru talepleri için mücadele ettiklerini söyledi.

Hükümetin belediye üzerindeki baskılarının farkında olduklarını belirten işçiler, sorunun çözümü için Atakum Belediyesi ve siyasi muhatabının halkı da sürece dahil eden siyasi bir adım atması gerektiğini ifade etti.

Eyleme destek veren Kamu-İş ve Tez Koop-İş üyeleri de işçileri ziyaret etti. Açıklamanın ardından “Direne direne kazanacağız”, “Kurtuluş yok tek başına, ya hep beraber ya hiçbirimiz” ve “Yaşasın sınıf dayanışması” sloganları atıldı.

Tez Koop-İş Sendikası Samsun Şube Başkanı Tarık Sayın da Atakum Belediyesi'ne bağlı 4 kreşte çalışan toplam 87 Tez Koop-İş üyesinin 5 aydır maaşlarını alamadığını belirtti.

Sayın, işçilerin 4857 sayılı İş Kanunu'nun 34'üncü maddesi kapsamında iş görmekten kaçınma hakkını kullanarak iş bırakma kararı aldığını ve eyleme katılımın yüzde 100 olduğunu açıkladı.

İş bırakma eyleminin 21 Eylül Pazartesi gününe kadar devam edeceğini belirten Sayın, direnişteki Atakum Belediyesi işçilerine destek vereceklerini ve işçilerin eylemlerini bir araya getireceklerini söyledi.

İşçiler açıklamayı, “Yaşasın sınıf dayanışması”, “Yaşasın işçilerin birliği” ve “Yaşasın mücadelemiz” sloganlarıyla tamamladı.

author: Jake Bittle
title: Trump’s EPA Repeals Limits on Power Plants’ Carbon Emissions
content:
The move will likely delay the phaseout of coal and will have significant effects for the nation’s public health.

Truthout is an indispensable resource for activists, movement leaders and workers everywhere. Please make this work possible with a quick donation.

Coal is by far the dirtiest of the world’s major energy sources. It accounts for almost half of the cumulative global carbon emissions since the industrial era began — as much as oil and natural gas combined. And it generates much more carbon dioxide per unit of energy than either oil or gas. Most climate experts agree that phasing out coal power is the single biggest change the world could make to slow down global warming.

For almost twenty years, the United States has whipsawed on the question of whether the federal government should try to speed up that phaseout. After Barack Obama failed to push a carbon tax through Congress, his administration drafted the “Clean Power Plan,” which would have forced electric utilities to cut their emissions by shifting away from coal. President Donald Trump repealed that rule during his first term, and the Supreme Court later said that the president could not unilaterally force utilities to give up the fuel.

Instead of forcing utilities to abandon coal, the Biden administration tried to work around the Supreme Court ruling in its 2024 rule by giving utilities a choice. They could either retire their coal plants sometime in the 2030s, or they could equip them with new machines that would capture almost all the carbon dioxide that would come out of their smokestacks. The result either way would be a significant drop in carbon emissions from the power sector.

The Trump administration is now repealing that rule. The Environmental Protection Agency announced on Monday that it plans to wipe away all federal regulations for carbon emissions from the electricity sector, essentially allowing utilities to warm the earth as much as they want. The agency used the same justification as it did in its repeal of climate regulations on motor vehicles earlier this year, arguing that the science of climate change was uncertain and that the repeal would save consumers money on power bills.

“For over 15 years, the Obama and Biden administrations implemented a war on coal to destroy reliable and affordable energy,” said Trump’s EPA chief Lee Zeldin at an international energy summit in Texas. “We are working to go even further so that American energy can be fully unleashed. Realizing the full potential of American energy means more jobs, lower prices, and a more prosperous America.”

This repeal deals a significant blow to the federal government’s efforts to force the power sector away from coal. The whiplash between Democratic and Republican administrations has been so frequent and so severe that neither the Obama nor the Biden rules have done much to speed the decarbonization of the power sector, especially when compared to other federal efforts like the Inflation Reduction Act subsidies for solar and wind.

“The reason to have a target is that it sends a clear signal to decision-makers in companies,” said Kenneth Gillingham, a professor of environmental economics at Yale University and an economic adviser to the Obama administration, where he helped draft the Clean Power Plan. “If you’re on the fence between choosing two things, you might as well choose the one that’s in line with the target. That’s been undermined. There has to be some teeth behind it.”

Even though the Obama and Biden rules never took effect, coal power has still been plummeting in the United States over the past twenty years. That’s thanks to the shale fracking boom, which lowered the cost of natural gas and made it cheap for utilities to replace their coal plants with gas plants. When burned, natural gas does warm the earth, but slower than coal, and the shift has caused overall power sector emissions to fall in the U.S. by almost half.

The repeal of the Biden rule will likely delay that phaseout and will have significant effects for the nation’s public health. Coal plants also release harmful toxins like mercury and particulate matter, leading to thousands of premature deaths around the world. Inasmuch as the Biden rule would have sped up coal closures, it would also have prevented around $370 billion in health damages from climate change and air pollution. author: Joe Sandler Clarke
title: Supermarkets Sue in Bid to Stop Mamdani’s Plan for Cheaper Groceries
content:
Zohran Mamdani’s plan to create city-run grocery stores to help New Yorkers struggling with the cost of living is being challenged in court by supermarkets, who say they won’t be able to compete with the stores’ low prices.


The New York City mayor plans to create five municipally owned stores on city-owned property by 2029 that will offer a 30% discount on goods like meat, dairy, and fruit and vegetables. 


The lawsuit – led by the National Supermarket Association and supported by other groups and private stores – says Mamdani’s policy would create an unfair business environment. It also alleges that the administration failed to conduct a “serious analysis” of how local business would be impacted by the move.


It follows

a similar legal action

 launched last month by the Multicultural Business Coalition, which argued Mamdani did not have the legal authority to set up the stores. 


Attorney Mark Jaffe, the coalition’s general counsel, told CNN: “You cannot expect hard-working small business owners to compete with a supermarket that isn’t going to pay rent, won’t have to pay an electric bill and won’t have to buy their products at full price. They cannot possibly compete because no one will be subsidising them.”


Mamdani said last week he remained committed to his plan.


“I continue to be fully confident in both the legality and the importance of our initiative to deliver five city-run grocery stores, one in each borough, to the people of our city,” he said. 


“We are talking about a reflection of a cost of living crisis that has seen grocery prices increase by about 30% over the last few years, and we’re also talking about delivering five city-run grocery stores in a city of 8.5 million people that has more than a thousand grocery stores.”


He also noted that pre-existing city subsidised stores in Manhattan and Brooklyn have “not had a negative effect on bodegas around them or on grocery stores around them”.

author: Chris Walker
title: Kennedy Center Board Claims Trump Name Change Is Needed to Avoid Fiscal Collapse
content:
Donors and performers distanced themselves from the venue in the immediate aftermath of it being renamed for Trump.

Honest, paywall-free news is rare. Please support our boldly independent journalism with a donation of any size.

Board members of the John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts in Washington, D.C. have reportedly created a draft resolution that warns of “certain fiscal collapse within weeks,” claiming that the only way to remedy their current crisis is to place President Donald Trump’s name back on the building.

During the first month of his second term in office, Trump fired all of the board of trustees for the center, replacing them with handpicked loyalists who eventually voted to rename it “The Donald J. Trump and The John F. Kennedy Memorial Center for the Performing Arts.” A federal judge ruled earlier this year that the name change was improper without the passage of a congressional bill. The question of the center’s name is currently tied up in the courts.

According to reporting from The Washington Post and The New York Times, members of the board appear to have drafted a resolution meant to bolster arguments in favor of putting Trump’s name back on the building’s exterior. The draft says that Trump has “offered to step in and raise the necessary funds” for the center, adding that, “without such appropriate recognition, it is unlikely that President Trump will provide the fundamental oversight of the renovation of the main building and lead the fiscal rescue of the center.”

Board member Paolo Zampolli, who is a longtime Trump loyalist, told The New York Times that Trump’s name on the building would supposedly help bring in donors.

“Trump attracts money. So when Trump says donate to this place, everyone will donate,” Zampolli said.

But Trump’s ability to turn the center’s purported funding crisis around is questionable. For starters, there is nothing stopping him right now from asking for donations to the Kennedy Center, with or without his name attached. Secondly, several sponsors of the venue actually pulled their support from it specifically because Trump tried to put his name on its exterior. Several performers, too, canceled their upcoming shows because of that move.

In other words, the center’s financial issues are unlikely to be fixed by somehow getting the president’s name back on the Kennedy Center.

The way in which Trump raises funds is also worrying. With other projects, including the funding of the ballroom he wants for the East Wing of the White House, and the 250th anniversary of the founding of the country, Trump’s fundraising has raised serious questions about conflicts of interest.

Several commentators reacted negatively to the draft document’s claims.

“Trump [is] basically holding the Kennedy Center hostage,” said Clara Jeffery, editor-in-chief at Mother Jones.

“Trump is trying to blackmail the Kennedy Center into putting his name on it. They should refuse,” The Atlantic’s Tom Nichols said.

The center is “another incredible part of our country’s culture that Donald Trump is well on the way to destroying, simply to satisfy his own ego,” opined former U.S. Attorney Joyce Vance, writing about the matter on her Civil Discourse Substack page.

author: CMI Argentina
title: “Lo desaparecieron para frenar los juicios de lesa humanidad”
content:
Entrevista al exjuez federal Carlos Rozanski a 20 años de la desaparición de Jorge Julio López. “El Estado no estuvo a la altura para esclarecer la desaparición de López”, afirmó el exmagistrado en conversación con Página/12.


Jorge Julio López. Carlos Cermele Te


Por Adriana Meyer


Faltan pocos días para que cumpla 75 años. Carlos Rozanski está en su casa en Villa Elisa y escribe, algo que siempre hizo y seguirá haciendo. Tiene dos hijos, tres nietos, está jubilado como juez federal de La Plata y fundó la Asociación Civil de Altos Estudios en Violencias y Abusos Sexuales. “Llevo 40 años escribiendo. Decidí formarme en lo que tiene que ver con sectores vulnerables, en las patologías institucionales, uno de los más grandes desafíos”, dice apenas comienza la entrevista con Página/12.


–¿Cree que ese sistema institucional le falla a las víctimas de violencias y desapariciones?


–Sí, pero ahí hay contrasentido; por un lado, Argentina tiene una legislación de las mejores del mundo en protección de derechos en general y en especial de las víctimas. Durante las épocas de avance en materia de derechos humanos, legislamos muchísimo, adherimos a todas las convenciones internacionales de derechos humanos. Las pusimos en la Constitución Nacional en 1994. Estamos en un lugar privilegiado en cuanto a legislación protectora. Pero en la práctica se nota el abandono a la víctima. Es un tema complejo, cotidiano, en todas las provincias. Hay una falla estructural en la protección que es contraria a lo que las leyes dicen proteger.


–¿Cómo fue encarar el juicio contra el represor Miguel Etchecolatz, el primero tras la anulación de las leyes de impunidad, como presidente del Tribunal Oral Federal 1 de La Plata?


–Fue un momento muy especial. En cualquier profesión, toda la preparación que vos tenés desde el punto de vista académico tiene que ver con lo dogmático, con lo establecido. Y cuando aparece algo de este volumen, te das cuenta de que hay ciertas cosas para las cuales no estás preparado. La academia no te prepara para que un día vos tengas que llevar adelante un juicio 30 años después con un contexto social muy particular, sobre todo dentro del Poder Judicial, que es esencialmente conservador y reaccionario. Eso define lo que pasó en ese momento, por lo menos en lo personal. Yo venía de ejercer la profesión durante 10 años; no hice carrera judicial, sino que concursé desde el ejercicio como abogado en Bariloche. Al que empieza cosiendo expedientes y luego de años llega a juez, se lo tragó el sistema. Desde mi cosmovisión sobre qué había que hacer, no me presentó ningún problema llevar adelante ese juicio.


–¿No tuvo reparos cuando las querellas pidieron que la sentencia se enmarcara como genocidio?


–Era toda una apuesta en ese momento. Fue un desafío enorme, sobre todo porque se estaba produciendo al mismo tiempo que la desaparición de López. Al principio del juicio ni siquiera tenía dónde hacerlo. En un lugar pequeño estabas privando al público del ámbito apropiado. Hablé con el intendente de La Plata, Julio Alak, y me facilitó el Salón Dorado de la Municipalidad.


–¿Qué recuerdo tiene de la declaración de Jorge Julio López?


–En general, todas las declaraciones de las víctimas de la dictadura, de cualquier hecho de violencia extrema, como es el de la tortura, son especiales, porque es el individuo que está tratando de contar algo que no se puede contar. La mecánica del Poder Judicial no está preparada para eso. La forma de relatar la tortura es infinita en sus diferencias, pero lo que tiene en común es la crueldad del torturador; es decir, es el escenario de la crueldad en estado puro. López era una persona muy reservada con respecto a su familia y por eso la mayor parte de las cosas que cuenta en el juicio no las conocían sus familiares. En su relato contó todo sin ningún tipo de inhibición. Al igual que Adriana Calvo, son personas que, cuando están relatando lo terrible y lo inenarrable, logran contarlo sin frenos inhibitorios, como si estuvieran solos. López tenía muchas ganas de contar, y lo hizo con muchísimo detalle. Por ejemplo, López relató que cuando lo torturaban, en la parte superior de la Comisaría Quinta, veía un techo de tejas rojo y un par de palmeras. Cuando vamos a hacer una inspección ocular a ese lugar, al que él nunca más volvió durante todos estos años, él dice: ‘Acá está la escalera’. content:
Radio Futura abre sus puertas para llevar a cabo una nueva vigilia sonora al cumplirse 20 años de la segunda desaparición de Jorge Julio López. La vigilia comienza el jueves 17/9 a las 20 hs y se extenderá hasta el viernes 18/9 a las 8 hs.


Desde 2008, la radio comunitaria platense convoca a esta transmisión especial para conmemorar este aniversario.” A lo largo de este tiempo, se ha consolidado como un espacio de encuentro y reflexión en torno a las luchas por memoria, verdad y justicia en nuestro país y en la región”, describen los organizadores. Además, durante la vigilia se realizan intervenciones y producciones gráficas con artistas invitados/as. El programa es retransmitido también por otras radios que son parte del Foro Argentino de Radios Comunitarias. author: Dion Nissenbaum
title: Supreme Court Blocks Trump’s Mail Ballot Restrictions From Taking Effect in 2026
content:
The ruling leaves open the question of whether the restrictions are legal overall and can be implemented in the future.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

The U.S. Supreme Court on Monday night blocked the U.S. Postal Service from imposing new restrictions on voting by mail this November, delivering a fatal blow to President Donald Trump’s attempts to inject more White House control over the midterm election.

In a brief, unsigned ruling, the court kept in place a lower court’s freeze on the restrictions. “The Government is unlikely to succeed on the merits of its challenge” to the lower court’s ruling, the justices wrote.

Under the proposed restrictions, the Postal Service would have been able to block delivery of ballots that weren’t on a prereviewed list or met specific design requirements. But as a result of Monday’s decision, mail voting in the 2026 election will largely function the same way it has in previous elections.

The ruling leaves open the question of whether the restrictions are legal overall and can be implemented in future elections. But the structure of the decision suggests that a majority of the justices are skeptical. Only two justices — Samuel Alito and Clarence Thomas — joined a dissent arguing that the rules were likely to be upheld and should be allowed to proceed for the upcoming election.

In a concurrence with the main decision, Justice Brett Kavanaugh also wrote that “there is at least a fair prospect that the final rule falls within the Postal Service’s statutory authority” but that “state and local election officials do not have sufficient time to reasonably implement the rule before the elections.”

The Supreme Court ruling marked the culmination of a frenzied, monthslong legal battle over Trump’s effort to impose tighter restrictions on American elections, even though some states have already sent out mail ballots and people have begun to return them.

It began in March, when Trump issued an executive order meant to restrict mail voting. Trump’s order directed the U.S. Postal Service to set up a new system that would allow the agency to block delivery of mail ballots to voters not on a list presubmitted by state election officials.

It quickly prompted a slew of lawsuits by 23 Democrat-led states, voting rights groups, and Democratic organizations that temporarily put the brakes on the effort.

In June, U.S. District Judge Indira Talwani found that some of the order’s key provisions were unconstitutional and blocked them from going into effect for this year’s elections. The Trump administration fought Talwani’s decision and brought the case to the U.S. Supreme Court.

In late August, the Supreme Court lifted Talwani’s injunction against the order on narrow procedural grounds, finding it had been issued prematurely because the Postal Service had not yet issued the final rules when she blocked the agency from enacting its plan.

But shortly before the Supreme Court justices ruled, the Postal Service unveiled its final rules in a 95-page plan. The court’s order meant it would quickly go into effect, creating widespread confusion among election officials. But Talwani again put the Postal Service plans on hold.

The Postal Service rules require states to use a new online federal government system to send it a list of all voters who should receive mail ballots, though that portal is not yet available. The Postal Service would refuse to send ballots to anyone not on the list. Ballot envelopes would also have to meet new design standards, including unique barcodes that have to be checked by the Postal Service.

A bipartisan group of elections officials across the country have warned that they have neither the time nor money and resources to comply with the new rules if they were to be put in place for the November election. Some states said their laws would prevent them from following the Postal Service rules. Others said they didn’t have the time to redesign their ballot envelopes.

In court filings, the Trump administration argued that the Postal Service plan was a legal effort by the federal government to prevent voter fraud in the election.

The Postal Service defended its efforts as a nonpartisan attempt to ensure people could vote by mail if they wanted to this fall.

author: Joe Sandler Clarke
title: UK’s Trade Ban on Israeli Settlements ‘Falls Far Short of Legal Obligations’
content:
The UK government has been urged to go further on sanctions against Israeli settlements in the West Bank, with senior lawyers warning that current measures “fall far short” of Britain’s obligations under international law.


Foreign secretary Ed Miliband last week announced a ban on the trade of goods with illegal Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank, a move seen as a major shift in UK-Israel relations. Canada and France announced similar actions the same day.


But 130 top lawyers and legal academics have written to prime minister Andy Burnham to say the measures do not meet the UK’s legal obligations, including those set out in a 2024 ruling by the International Court of Justice.


The letter’s signatories include former Lord Justice of Appeal Sir Alan Moses, prominent barrister Michael Mansfield KC and Ralph Wilde, a professor of international law at UCL.


They said they welcomed the new measures but that the UK must now extend sanctions to more sectors of Israel’s economy, prevent public bodies investing in settlements and enforce a full arms embargo.


Miliband last week said the UK would “continue to support important and valued trade” with Israel outside of illegal settlements, adding that he “wholeheartedly” opposed the boycott, divestment and sanctions movement.


Wilde told Novara Media that Miliband’s position was misguided: “It is Israel that maintains the occupation, not the settlers. The settlements are integrated into Israel ‘proper’. They cannot be carved off. It’s impossible to disentangle the economic activity in the settlements from the rest of Israel.”


The letter notes that the new sanctions don’t go as far as those taken by the UK against Russia following the invasion of Ukraine. These encompassed all aspects of the Russian economy – including banks and energy companies – on the basis that these institutions were enabling the war.


“By contrast to the improperly narrow approach to the sanctions regime adopted towards Israel, the UK’s Russia sanctions are not confined to economic activity in occupied Ukrainian territory,” the letter said.


On Monday B’Tselem, a leading Israeli human rights group, reported that the Israeli government

was trying to “eliminate”

 the conditions necessary for Palestinian life in the West Bank.


Its report found Israel is “dramatically intensifying its attacks on every aspect of Palestinian life” there, including “the ability to get to work, take children to school or university, and receive medical treatment.”

author: Unknown
title: KaosGL yöneticileri ve gazeteci Tuğba Tekerek için tutuklama talebi
content:
LGBTİ+ örgütlerine yönelik polis operasyonunda Ankara'da gözaltına alınan Kaos Gey ve Lezbiyen Kültürel Araştırmalar ve Dayanışma Derneği’nin (KaosGL) yedek üyeler de dahil olmak üzere yönetim ve denetim kurulu üyelerinin savcılık ifadeleri tamamlandı.


Savcılık, gözaltındaki Kaos GL’lilerin tamamını tutuklama talebiyle Sulh Ceza Hakimliğine sevk etti.


Tutuklama talebiyle hakimliğe sevk edilenler arasında gazeteci Tuğba Tekerek de bulunuyor. Tekerek, Kaos GL için Gürcistan’daki seçimlerde LGBTİ+’ların durumuna ilişkin hazırladığı haber gerekçe gösterilerek gözaltına alınmıştı.


Gazeteci Tuğba Tekerek, Gürcistan’daki LGBTİ+ hareketine ilişkin haberi nedeniyle gözaltında


Bugün  16:29


Operasyon kapsamında gözaltına alınan beş trans kadın da tutuklama talebiyle hakimliğe sevk edildi. bianet’in ulaştığı bilgiye göre tutuklama istenen toplam kişi sayısı 20.


Savcılık paylaşımları gerekçe gösterdi


Savcılık, sevk gerekçesinde Kaos GL’nin faaliyetleri ile sosyal medya paylaşımlarının “genel ahlak anlayışını ihlal edecek” ve “toplumun ar ve haya duygularını rencide edebilecek” nitelikte olduğunu ileri sürdü.


Bazı paylaşımlarda “cinsel içerikli fiziki temas” ve “hayasızca hareketler” bulunduğunu öne süren savcılık, içeriklerin “tanıtım faaliyetinin ötesine geçtiğini” savundu.


Gerekçede ayrıca paylaşımların kişilerin cinsiyetlerini seçebilecekleri yönünde “algı oluşturduğu” iddia edildi. Bazı görsellerde temsili çocuk çizimlerinin kullanılmasını da gerekçe gösteren savcılık, çocukların “eşcinselliğe özenmesinin teşvik edildiğini” öne sürdü.


Ne olmuştu?


LGBTİ+’ları hedef alan “Ailem Güvende” operasyonu kapsamında Kaos GL Derneği’nin yedek üyeler de dahil olmak üzere yönetim ve denetim kurulu üyeleri evlerine düzenlenen polis baskınlarında gözaltına alınmıştı. Dernek ofisinde de arama yapılmış, dijital materyallere el konulmuştu.


Ankara’daki soruşturma, “müstehcenlik” ve “Dernekler Kanunu’na muhalefet” suçlamaları kapsamında yürütülüyor. Gözaltındaki LGBTİ+ aktivistlerin Emniyet ifadelerinde Kaos GL’nin internet sitesinde yayımlanan haber ve yazılar, sosyal medya paylaşımları, derneğin finansman ve fon kaynakları ile aldığı hibeler hakkında sorular yöneltilmişti.


Adalet Bakanı Akın Gürlek, “Ailem Güvende” adıyla 15 ilde yürütülen operasyonlar kapsamında 162 kişi, 9 dernek ve 13 işletme hakkında adli işlem başlatıldığını açıklamıştı.

Îsal bi giştî 72 serlêdan hatin kirin. Di pêşbirkê de di beşên Nûçeya Kurdî, Nûçeya Tirkî, Wêne, Nûçeya Dîtbarî (Video) û Karîkatûrê de û ji bo bîranîna Huseyîn Aykol jî “Xelata Rûmetê ya Azadiya Çapemeniyê” hatin dayîn. 


Di beşa nûçeya Kurdî de nûçegihan Nedîm Orûç, di beşa Nûçeya Tirkî de nûçegihanên Evrenselê Fîlîz Gazî û Ozlem Temena, nûçegihana Yenî Yaşamê Reyhan Hacioglû û nûçegihana berê ya bîanetê Tûgçe Yilmaz, di beşa nûçeya vîdeoyan de nûçegihanê Ajansa Mezopotamyayê Emrûllah Acar, di beşa fotografan de rojnameger Ardil Batmaz, di beşa karîkatur de Mahmût Ûlûsan ê li Girtîgeha Ereglî ya Konyayê tê ragirtin hêjayî xelatê hatin dîtin. Her wiha xelata Mansiyonê ya Nûçeya Kurdî nûçegihana me Heval Onkol, xelata Mansiyonê ya Wêneyî rojnameger Sûltan Kiliç wergirt. 


Xelatgirên 32emîn Xelatên Rojnamegeriyê yên Mûsa Anter diyar bûn

Rêzenûçeya ku ji aliyê Fîlîz Gazî û Ozlem Temenayê ve hate amadekirin; qezayên kar ên ku di fabrîkayan, maden û avahiyan de diqewimin, jiyana karkerên ku di encama van qezayan de organên xwe winda kirine û pirsgirêkên hiqûqî, aborî û civakî yên ku piştre pê re rû bi rû dimînin digire dest. title: Aydar: The law must be implemented and Öcalan’s path opened
content:
The adoption of the framework law has opened a new phase in the Peace and Democratic Society Process, prompting discussions over how the process will move forward and how the law will be implemented. Zübeyir Aydar, a member of the Executive Council of the Kurdistan Communities Union (KCK), spoke to ANF about the process, saying that despite its shortcomings, the law has opened an important door, while delays in its implementation are a cause for concern.


Aydar stressed that conditions must be created for Abdullah Öcalan to play an active role if the process is to advance, adding that the Kurdish question cannot be resolved through a single law. He said the Kurdish people’s identity, language, culture and rights to organise and engage in politics must be guaranteed, while the democratisation of Turkey must also form a central part of any solution.


Honouring the martyrs means honouring the struggle


Aydar reflected on the process, which has been under way for nearly two years, and commemorated the martyrs of the freedom struggle whose martyrdoms were recently announced, drawing attention to the heavy price paid over decades of conflict. He stressed that this legacy must be upheld in the new period and that the struggle must continue through democratic means.


Aydar said: “The people are honouring their martyrs. This is very important. There has been a great struggle and a long war. That war has come at a heavy price, and one of the greatest sacrifices has been martyrdom. In this sense, however much we honour our martyrs as a people, it can never be enough. We can see that the people are embracing them with great commitment. But this is not simply a matter of commemoration. We must uphold all our values, the process itself and our own organisation. That is how we see it.


In the person of all the martyrs whose names have now been announced, I once again commemorate all the martyrs of freedom with gratitude and bow before their memory. Our task is to fulfil their legacy, bring the struggle they left unfinished to its conclusion and secure the freedom of this people. We stand today where we have always stood. Nothing short of the freedom of this people will satisfy us. This is the legacy of our martyrs.


On this occasion, I offer my condolences to all our people and friends, particularly the families of the martyrs. Commemorations are continuing; they are also being held across Europe, and we are taking part in them. This too is a reality of the struggle. But as we bow before their memory, we must also fulfil their aims. We must organise ourselves as a people so that when we ultimately achieve our goal and stand before their graves, we can say to them, ‘We fulfilled your aims.’ Once again, I offer my condolences to all our people and the families of the martyrs.”


This delay is not right


Aydar said the mechanisms envisaged for implementing the framework law have yet to become operational, stressing that Abdullah Öcalan’s position will be decisive for the process to move forward. He said the law must not remain merely on paper and that the first step should be to enable Öcalan to participate actively in the process.


Aydar continued: “The framework law has been adopted, but it has not yet been implemented. It needs to be put into practice. It has been published in the Official Gazette for more than a month. So far, the high-level board attached to the Presidency has held one meeting. There have been no further developments since then, and the other boards have not yet been established. This is a very serious delay.


The board through which Öcalan could play an active role has not yet been established, nor has his situation changed. No one has visited him yet, and no meetings have been held with him during this period. In other words, a form of isolation has been imposed. Yet meetings should have begun as soon as the law was published. A delegation will visit on the 14th, but this should have happened much earlier. This delay is not right. Moreover, the delay is not caused by the organisation; it stems from the government.


Öcalan should by now have been able to receive visitors, meet with the press, convey his message and become directly involved in the process. Yet there has been no change in this regard. The requirements of the law therefore need to be implemented as soon as possible. For us, the first step is to change Öcalan’s situation and create conditions in which he can act freely, take ownership of …

title: HPG commemorates fallen members and honors memorial events in North Kurdistan
content:
The People’s Defence Forces (HPG) commemorated the fallen members of the Kurdish freedom movement and paid tribute to the recent memorial events held in North Kurdistan and Turkey. In a statement on Tuesday, the guerrilla organization particularly remembered Kemal Pir, Mehmet Hayri Durmuş, Akif Yılmaz and Ali Çiçek, who died in September 1982 as a result of the July 14 death fast.


At the same time, the HPG expressed self-criticism for having been unable, in some cases, to document the lives and struggles of fallen members in a timely and comprehensive manner due to wartime conditions and limited resources.


The HPG also commemorated Ramazan Oslo, the brother of fallen YJA-Star fighter Arîn Goyî (Binevş Oslo). Oslo was killed in a traffic accident on September 11 while traveling from Manisa to a memorial event in Uludere district of Şırnak. Four other people were injured, one of them seriously.


The full statement by the HPG Press and Information Center reads as follows:


“Kemal Pir, Mehmet Hayri Durmuş, Akif Yılmaz and Ali Çiçek were among the leading cadres of our struggle and the resistance fighters of the Great July 14 Death Fast. Kemal Pir fell on September 7, 1982, Mehmet Hayri Durmuş on September 12, Akif Yılmaz on September 15 and Ali Çiçek on September 17.


On the anniversaries of their deaths, we remember our pioneering comrades with love, respect, gratitude and the deepest sense of devotion. We commemorate the July 14 resistance fighters who fell one after another within the space of a few days in September, and through them, all those who have fallen in our struggle. We renew our pledge to remain faithful to their memory and to fulfill their goals.


In recent days, our people in North Kurdistan have commemorated their martyrs with the participation of people from all generations. We respectfully salute our patriotic people across North Kurdistan and Turkey who have honored the memory of their martyrs. By standing by their own values in this way, strengthening their moral resolve, and holding commemorative events in an exemplary manner worthy of our martyrs, our people have once again demonstrated how alive and powerful their memory remains in their hearts.


This devotion shown by our people has once again demonstrated that our martyrs and our leadership are among the strongest sources of our morale and inner strength. We once again extend our condolences to the families of our martyrs, to Rêber Apo [Abdullah Öcalan] as their comrade, to the comrades who follow in their footsteps, and to all those whose hearts beat for the martyrs.


Our martyrs have created a great truth


The life, struggle and path of each and every one of our martyrs until their death embody a concrete truth that shows not only what a free person lives for, but also how they live.


As those who carry forward the legacy of our martyrs, we have at times been unable to document every detail of their struggle and lives, partly due to the conditions of war and partly due to limited resources. However, when announcing our martyrs, we have made it a principle to use every means available to share their photographs, recordings, documents and information with our people.


For the responsibilities in which we have fallen short or which we have failed to fulfill in a timely manner, we offer our self-criticism first and foremost to our martyrs and to our patriotic people. We are determined to address these shortcomings and to assume this responsibility even more strongly in the future. Through diverse and wide-ranging efforts, we will continue to honor our martyrs, make their lives and struggles known, and properly uphold and keep alive the path of struggle they embodied.


Our martyrs, however, have created such a profound truth that every moment of their lives, every word they spoke and every stance they took has entered our collective memory and become deeply engraved in our consciousness and hearts. In this way, a social reality has emerged in which a people defines itself through its martyrs, follows in their footsteps and makes their memory immortal. This legacy is not only our greatest source of morale and strength, but also a guarantee of our people’s free future. 


Condolences to the Oslo family


We know and firmly believe that our patriotic people do not regard the martyrs as a source of guidance only during commemorative events. Throughout their lives, they have taken inspiration from the martyrs’ sincere moral stance …

author: Unknown
title: PUK President visits Tehran, meets senior Iranian officials
content:
Bafel Jalal Talabani, President of the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan (PUK), is paying an official visit to the Islamic Republic of Iran, accompanied by a high-level PUK delegation.


The visit comes at the official invitation of the Iranian Foreign Ministry.


Talabani and Abbas Araghchi, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Islamic Republic of Iran, met in Tehran. During the meeting, which was attended by a high-level PUK delegation, discussions focused on the latest political developments and military changes in the region.


Talabani emphasised that problems require peaceful solutions and ongoing dialogue.


He also reiterated the PUK's continuous efforts to establish peace and de-escalate tensions, stating that the Kurdistan Region respects the security and sovereignty of neighboring countries, and that a shared and ancient history binds us together with the Iranian people.


For his part, the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Islamic Republic of Iran expressed his appreciation for the role of President Bafel and the PUK in their efforts to protect the stability of the Kurdistan Region, Iraq, and the region as a whole.

title: Συγκέντρωση αλληλεγγύης στους μετανάστες της Σιντικής Σερρών, Τρίτη 15/9, 19.30, στο Υπουργείο Μεταναστευτικής Πολιτικής
content:
Την Τρίτη 15/9, στις 19.30, στο Υπουργείο Μεταναστευτικής Πολιτικής (Λεωφ. Θηβών 196-198), η Ανοιχτή συνέλευση για τη διοργάνωση μπλοκ στη πορεία μνήμης του Π.Φύσσα και η Ταξική Αντεπίθεση – Ομάδα Αναρχικών και Κομμουνιστ(-ρι)ών, καλούν σε συγκέντρωση αλληλεγγύης στους μετανάστες που κρατούνται στο κλειστό καμπ-κολαστήριο της Σιντικής Σερρών, κάτω από αντι-ανθρώπινες συνθήκες.


Από την επιστολή των 300 έγκλειστων στο κολαστήριο της Σιντικής – Αύγουστος 2026


« Ζούμε υπό καθεστώς καταπίεσης για πάνω από έναν χρόνο. Είδαμε τον πόνο στη Λιβύη, είδαμε τον θάνατο στη θάλασσα και είδαμε τον εξευτελισμό και την καταπίεση στο κλειστό κέντρο της Σιντικής. Χωρίς ρούχα, χωρίς φαγητό, χωρίς μια αξιοπρεπή ζωή.»


Αναλυτικά τα καλέσματα:


Ανοιχτή συνέλευση για τη διοργάνωση μπλοκ στη πορεία μνήμης του Π.Φύσσα


ΠΑΥΛΟΣ ΦΥΣΣΑΣ: ΠΑΡΩΝ


Ο ΦΑΣΙΣΜΟΣ ΤΣΑΚΙΖΕΤΑΙ ΣΤΟΝ ΔΡΟΜΟ


Δεκατρία χρόνια από την δολοφονία του αντιφασίστα Παύλου Φύσσα στο Κερατσίνι από τάγμα εφόδου της Χρυσής Αυγής, η φασιστική βία δεν έπαψε να λειτουργεί ως οργανικό στοιχείο του καπιταλισμού, ειδικά σε περιόδους κρίσης. Ως παραπληρωματική δράση και χρήσιμη εφεδρεία του κράτους απέναντι στην αντιμετώπιση του «εσωτερικού εχθρού», ως εμπροσθοφυλακή τρομοκρατίας και πειθάρχησης των μεταναστευτικών ροών, ως απεργοσπαστικός μηχανισμός του κεφαλαίου για την καταστολή απεργιών και ταξικών αγώνων. Ειδικά σήμερα, η επικείμενη αποφυλάκιση του νεοναζί Κασιδιάρη και οι εξαγγελίες περί δημιουργίας νέου κόμματος επιχειρεί να λειτουργήσει ως σημείο αναφοράς των διασκορπισμένων σε ακροδεξιά κόμματα ορφανών της φασιστικής χρυσής αυγής.


Η επανασυσπείρωση των φασιστών, ειδικά με αιχμή το «αντιμεταναστευτικό», συμβαίνει σε μια συγκυρία που η ίδια η κυβέρνηση με την ακροδεξιά και νεοφιλελεύθερη πολιτική της έχει επιλέξει να βάλει στο τιμόνι του υπουργείου μετανάστευσης τον Θάνο Πλεύρη, έναν ανοιχτά ακροδεξιό πολιτικό. Ο νέος νόμος Πλεύρη για τη μετανάστευση αφενός καταργεί σχεδόν σε απόλυτο βαθμό τα δικαιώματα των προσφύγων και των μεταναστριών, εισάγοντας το φασιστικής έμπνευσης δόγμα «φυλακή ή επιστροφή», και αφετέρου πριμοδοτεί συνωμοσιολογικά θεωρήματα που στοχοποιούν τους μετανάστες σε έναν εσμό παρακρατικών και κρατικών κύκλων, ενώ προωθεί και συγκαλύπτει τη φασιστική δράση καλλιεργώντας ένα δίχτυ προστασίας και υποστήριξης των φασιστών στις τοπικές κοινωνίες. Είναι η ίδια η κυβέρνηση που στοχοποιεί τους μετανάστες ως αποδιοπομπαίους τράγους ώστε πάνω τους να ξεσπάσει η συσσωρευμένη κοινωνική οργή απέναντι στην ανθρωπιστική και οικολογική καταστροφή που βιώνει ο πλανήτης εξαιτίας των πολιτικών κράτους και κεφαλαίου.


Οι φράχτες της Ευρώπης-φρούριο, τα δολοφονικά pushbacks του λιμενικού και της Frontex που οδήγησαν μεταξύ άλλων στο κρατικό-καπιταλιστικό έγκλημα στην Πύλο, οι κατασταλτικές επιχειρήσεις εναντίον μεταναστριών στα κέντρα των μητροπόλεων, τα πολεμικά όπλα του ΝΑΤΟ και τα στρατόπεδα εξόντωσης μεταναστών (μόλις πριν έναν μήνα, στο καμπ μεταναστών Σιντικής Σερρών, οι κρατούμενοι εξεγέρθηκαν ενάντια στις άθλιες συνθήκες, ενώ κάποιοι κατάφεραν να αποδράσουν) λειτουργούν σε πλήρη αρμονία με τα μαχαίρια των φασιστών και τα πογκρόμ ενάντια στις εξαθλιωμένες του καπιταλιστικού κόσμου. Η ίδια η κυβέρνηση επιλέγει τους φασίστες ως το μακρύ της χέρι φροντίζοντας παράλληλα να τους οριοθετεί όταν εκείνοι την εκθέτουν στα μάτια της κοινής γνώμης ή αναλαμβάνουν πιο αναβαθμισμένη δράση από εκείνη που το σύστημα επιλέγει.


Ο φασισμός όμως στις μέρες μας δεν εκφράζεται μόνο οργανωμένα αλλά αποτελεί μια συνθήκη κοινωνικά διάχυτη μέσα σε ένα περιβάλλον κοινωνικού εκφασισμού, έντασης της έμφυλης βίας και γενικευμένης σήψης που οι αξίες της αλληλεγγύης δοκιμάζονται και οι ταξικές και κοινωνικές διεκδικήσεις βρίσκονται σε ύφεση. Το κράτος επενδύει συστηματικά και με σχεδιασμό στην συνθήκη αυτή ώστε οι φτωχοί να κυνηγάνε τους φτωχότερους, ώστε οι εκμεταλλευόμενοι να εξοντώνονται στα πέταλα των γηπέδων, στις πλατείες και στους δρόμους.


Ως αντικρατιστές, αντικαπιταλιστές και αντιφασίστριες μαχόμαστε επίμονα τον φασισμό, τον εθνικισμό και τη μισαλλοδοξία σε μια μάχη που είναι άρρηκτα συνδεδεμένη με αυτή κατά των πολέμων, του μιλιταρισμού, του εθνικισμού, της έμφυλης βίας και υποτίμησης, της φτώχειας, της καταπίεσης και της εκμετάλλευσης


Ο αγώνας αυτός είναι πιο αναγκαίος από ποτέ σήμερα, σε μια περίοδο που οι ισχυροί ξαναμοιράζουν τη γη, αμφισβητώντας τις μέχρι τώρα συμφωνίες και, σε κάποιες περιπτώσεις, συμμαχίες τους. Η ιστορία μας έχει διδάξει ότι, σε τέτοιους καιρούς, ο νέος κόσμος …

title: Che mille piattaforme autogestite sboccino! Chiusura di Autistici/Inventati. Fare un passo in più
content:
Nello scorso numero di “Umanità Nova” è stato dato, per ragioni di tempo, solo l’annuncio della chiusura dei servizi forniti da Autistici/Inventati (A/I). Ma c’era un articolo che raccontava cosa era successo e che – in parte – spiegava anche le ragioni della drastica decisione. Dopo una settimana proviamo a fare il punto su quello che è accaduto e ad immaginare qualcosa sugli scenari futuri.


L’enorme differenza tra la forza messa in campo dagli USA e le difese che poteva opporre un piccolo collettivo è la cosa che più dovrebbe farci riflettere. Una sproporzione tale da incutere davvero paura. Questa è una delle ragioni che hanno influenzato la decisione di mettere la parola fine a un progetto storico nel panorama dell’attivismo informatico. Nel comunicato col quale annunciava la chiusura, A/I ha però anche scritto che, con questa decisione, aveva lo scopo di tutelare in qualche modo le persone coinvolte nella loro vicenda:


“Non possiamo accettare uno scontro o prestarci a strumentalizzazioni che mettano in pericolo le loro vite, le vite dei loro cari, lasciandole alla mercé di autocrati, fascisti e agenzie che agiscono per vie extra-legali. La concreta possibilità di poter essere la causa di conseguenze penali o finanziarie per qualcuno che ci è vicino, o che anche solo interagisce con noi non ci permette altre scelte.”


E in queste parole si poteva chiaramente misurare la distanza esistente tra le due idee di comunicazione che sono entrate in collisione, quella tra una Rete completamente asservita al profitto e una che reclama e si prende degli spazi di libertà nel mondo delle merci. Ma anche la differenza tra due etiche completamente contrapposte e inconciliabili.


Nel corso delle tre ultime settimane sono stati in molt* a solidarizzare, in vario modo, con A/I dimostrando che l’impatto violento che ha avuto l’attacco su un ampio numero di persone non è passato certo inosservato.


Dal 26 agosto scorso – data della pubblicazione dell’Ordine Esecutivo – a oggi, quegli avvenimenti sono stati commentati e analizzati a vario livello, dai semplici post a carattere personale pubblicati sui social, alle interviste di personaggi importanti nel settore e attraverso comunicati firmati anche da organismi istituzionali.


Quella che è mancata, almeno fino a questo momento, è stata una più larga diffusione di questa storia a livello di massa. I giornali considerati “autorevoli” hanno praticamente bucato la notizia che invece, come già abbiamo scritto la scorsa settimana, ha costituito la base per una squallida campagna della stampa di destra rivolta contro il PD. Stesso discorso per la TV sulla quale, a quanto ci risulta, c’è stata un’intervista sull’argomento a uno scrittore nel TG Regionale della Lombardia, una trasmissione radio alla quale hanno partecipato giornalist* che si occupano di Media digitali e forse qualche altra cosa che ci è sfuggita.


Naturalmente non è stata questa la ragione principale della scarsa attenzione che i mezzi di comunicazione di massa ufficiali hanno avuto nei confronti della notizia. Hanno sicuramente pesato la difficoltà a raccontare una vicenda che ha dei complicati risvolti tecnici e che, dal punto di vista legale, è decisamente ancora più intricata. Per non dire dei risvolti politici.


Per fare solo un esempio, la “Banca Etica” ha bloccato il conto che A/I usava per il suo funzionamento. Mettendo da parte tutte le questioni collegate alla legittimità di questa deprecabile azione, resta il fatto che se l’Associazione volesse chiudere, come annunciato, non potrebbe farlo in quanto il suo Statuto prevede che nel caso di una chiusura i fondi presenti in cassa vadano devoluti ad un’Associazione simile. Cosa chiaramente impossibile da fare avendo il conto congelato. Giustamente A/I ha presentato un ricorso in tribunale contro la banca.


Va anche notato che la maggior parte dei comunicati prodotti da enti e organismi ufficiali, sebbene contengano tutti delle garbate proteste per quello che è successo, non sono stati seguiti da azioni più concrete di solidarietà. Nella quasi totalità dei casi si sono infatti limitati a lamentarsi della carenza di leggi appropriate e hanno intonato in coro il mantra della “sovranità”.


Svegliarsi all’improvviso e accorgersi che se gli USA impongono una sanzione di tipo finanziario allora tutte le banche, almeno quelle italiane, si devono inchinare dimostra solo un’enorme e colpevole ipocrisia.


Esattamente l’opposto di quello che è successo in rete, dove …

author: Mag
title: „Gerechte“ Sopo oder „antifaschistische“ Wipo – nicht allein gegen den Rechtsrutsch ausreichend und doch nicht in Sicht
content:
Dossier


Zweifellos ist richtig, dass (qualitativer und ökologischer) Wohlstand für alle und eine gerechte Sozialpolitik – ohnehin im Osten wie Westen dringend erforderlich – rechte Bewegungen schwächen können. Dies war z.B. in den 60ger und 70ger Jahren der Fall – als auch die sog. „Gastarbeiter“ weitgehend willkommen, weil sie Drecksarbeiten verrichteten, die kein einheimischer Mensch machen wollte und auch keinen Druck hierzu bekam. Bloß warum war dann plötzlich das „Boot so voll“, dass es nicht nur zu rassistischem Terror, sondern auch starker Asylrechteinschränkung Anfang der 90ger kam? Weil der zeitweilige relative Wohlstand (natürlich nie für alle) durch die unterlassene Entnazifizierung nur zu einer Verdrängung genau jener Ideologie führte, der z.B. die AfD heute anhängt. Wenn der Kapitalismus seine Gerechtigkeitsversprechen nicht mehr realisieren kann oder will tritt der Rassismus zu Tage, der nie weg war und mit etwas mehr Sozialpolitik eben nur kaschiert werden könnte – würde ihr Mangel nicht sonst die antikapitalistische Bewegung stärken? Siehe im neuen Dossier einige erste Hinweise zur hoffentlich breiten Debatte:


Antifaschistische Politik muss das „Nullsummendenken“ anders politisieren: Verteilungskonflikte und Ungleichheit (wieder) als vertikaler Konflikt zwischen oben und unten


„

Natürlich müssen wir davon ausgehen, dass die AfD noch aufzuhalten ist, sagt die Soziologin Carolin Amlinger. Ein Gespräch über antifaschistische Politik. (…)


taz: Aber die AfD ist doch – wie beispielsweise auch die Republikaner in den USA – eine Partei für Besserverdienende. Warum wählen die einfacheren Ar­bei­te­r*in­nen gegen ihre objektiven Interessen?


Amlinger: Weil sie die Gesellschaft, die Demokratie insgesamt, als eine Gesellschaft des kollektiven Verlustes wahrnehmen. Selbst wenn sie keinen Abstieg hingelegt haben, sorgen sie sich davor, sie haben also eine gewisse Statusangst. Diese Angst führen sie allerdings nicht zurück auf die gewachsenen Ungleichheiten oder auf die Kürzungspolitik der Bundesregierung. Nein, sie projizieren sie auf Migrant*innen. Und identifizieren sich selbst sogar mit Leistung und Wettbewerb.


[ taz: Im Buch „Zerstörungslust: Elemente des demokratischen Faschismus“, das Sie zusammen mit dem Soziologen Oliver Nachtwey geschrieben haben, bezeichnen Sie die Ursache für diese Projektion als „Nullsummendenken“. Was bedeutet das?]


Amlinger: Wenn Menschen die Welt, in der sie leben, nicht mehr als eine wahrnehmen, in der die Ressourcen wachsen, sondern schrumpfen, verändert sich die Logik sozialer Konflikte. Es geht dann häufig nicht mehr darum, wie verteilt wird, sondern darum, wer überhaupt noch mit am Tisch sitzen darf. Der Klimawandel befeuert das Bewusstsein noch, dass die eigene Zukunft schwindet.


[ taz: Es genügt also das Versprechen darauf, dass es anderen durch bestimmte Politik schlechter gehen wird, um das Gefühl zu entwickeln, einem selbst würde es damit besser gehen. Ohne dass das objektiv so sein mag.]


Amlinger: Genau, das ist die Nullsummenlogik: Der Nachteil des anderen ist mein Vorteil. Diese affektive Klammer hält die sehr heterogene Wählerbasis der AfD zusammen: ökonomisch tatsächlich benachteiligte Menschen, insbesondere aus der Arbeiterklasse, die sich von einer gesellschaftlichen Schließung mehr Wohlfahrtschauvinismus versprechen. Selbstständige und Kleinunternehmer, die sich selbst als leistungsstark wahrnehmen und eine verletzte Reziprozität des Gemeinwesens beklagen, die Leistungsschwache vermeintlich bevorteilen würde. Menschen aus der oberen Mittelklasse, die sich in ihren unternehmerischen Freiheiten eingeschränkt fühlen durch Gleichstellungsprogramme, Sozialreformen, Klimapolitik. (…)


Zunächst kommt es darauf an, das Nullsummendenken wieder anders zu politisieren: Verteilungskonflikte nicht horizontal zu führen, Ungleichheit nicht kulturell auf Mi­gran­t*in­nen zurückzuführen, sondern als vertikalen Konflikt zwischen oben und unten. (…)


Die enorme Vermögensungleichheit in unserer Gesellschaft müssen wir dringend eindämmen. Die obersten Einkommen müssen viel stärker besteuert werden, um Mittel für den Ausbau des Sozialstaates und der Infrastruktur zu schaffen. Hohe Vermögen und Erbschaften ebenfalls. Wir brauchen eine soziale Erneuerung der Demokratie, sodass alle die Chancen haben, ein würdevolles Leben zu führen. Zudem braucht es soziale Orte des Miteinanders. Offene Treffpunkte, in denen soziale Gruppen zusammenkommen, und auf diese Weise …

author: anred
title: Tierra del Fuego: en su séptima semana de paro, docentes evalúan en asambleas la nueva oferta de Melella
content:
Imagen: Huella del Sur.


Tras más de 40 días de paro, acampes y movilizaciones, y en medio de su séptima semana de paro por tiempo indeterminado, el Sindicato Unificado de Trabajadoras y Trabajadores de la Educación Fueguina (SUTEF) y el Gobierno de Tierra del Fuego, encabezado por Gustavo Melella, retomaron este lunes 14 de septiembre la mesa paritaria salarial. El Ejecutivo presentó una nueva propuesta que será debatida por la docencia en asambleas este martes 15 y miércoles 16, mientras el sindicato mantiene la medida de fuerza en reclamo recomposición salarial, la devolución de descuentos realizados por las medidas de fuerza y una ley de financiamiento educativo.

La secretaria adjunta del sindicato, Soledad Rottaris, sintetizó semanas atrás el reclamo: «tenemos que poder vivir, no sobrevivir». La oferta anterior había sido rechazada en el 99,5% de las instituciones consultadas por el gremio. El jueves 17, un congreso provincial de delegadas y delegados deberá reunir los mandatos de las instituciones para definir la posición del sindicato.

Por ANRed.


En el inicio de la

séptima semana de paro docente por tiempo indeterminado

, el Gobierno de Tierra del Fuego, encabezado por

Gustavo Melella

, y el

Sindicato Unificado de Trabajadoras y Trabajadores de la Educación Fueguina (SUTEF)

 retomaron este lunes 14 de septiembre la

mesa paritaria salarial

, donde

el Ejecutivo presentó una nueva propuesta que será puesta a consideración de la docencia en asambleas durante este martes 15 y miércoles 16

.


La oferta oficial contempla ocho puntos: “Decreto de emergencia salarial docente”, “Ley de Financiamiento Educativo”, un “Plan de inversión, refacciones y ampliaciones de edificios escolares”, “Salario Mínimo, Vital y Móvil”, “Mesa de salud docente”, “Planta Orgánica Funcional”, “Reactivación de la transformación educativa” y una propuesta salarial. El sindicato informó que las grillas serán revisadas de acuerdo con las distintas antigüedades del escalafón antes de que las bases definan sus mandatos.


Imagen: Indymedia.


El conflicto lleva más de 40 días y atraviesa ya la séptima semana de huelga

. Entre los reclamos sostenidos por SUTEF aparecen la

recomposición salarial, la devolución de descuentos realizados por las medidas de fuerza y una ley de financiamiento educativo.

 Desde el gremio habían advertido que las propuestas anteriores no permitían recuperar el poder adquisitivo perdido y que una parte de la discusión debía estar separada de la deuda salarial acumulada.


La oferta que precedió a esta nueva instancia había sido rechazada de manera contundente

. Según el propio SUTEF, el pasado 28 de agosto

la docencia fueguina rechazó aquella propuesta con un 99,5%: 201 instituciones educativas votaron por el rechazo y apenas una por la aceptación

. Una de las críticas centrales era que

la propuesta representaba unos $59.000 de aumento en cuatro meses

, con una parte significativa en conceptos no remunerativos.


Imagen de la marcha de antorchas en Ushuaia el viernes 4 de septiembre, en el cierre de la quinta semana de paro. Foto: SUTEF


Desde el SUTEF plantean además que

el deterioro salarial está obligando a docentes a buscar otros ingresos para sostener sus hogares

. En ese marco, la secretaria adjunta del sindicato en Río Grande,

Soledad Rottaris

, resumió así el reclamo: “

tenemos que poder vivir, no sobrevivir

”. El gremio también impulsa un

anteproyecto de ley de desendeudamiento no bancario

 y sostiene que

la pérdida de poder adquisitivo y el aumento de alquileres, servicios y alimentos llevaron a una parte importante de la docencia a financiar gastos básicos con deuda

, un fenómeno que también se está repitiendo en diferentes puntos del país producto de las políticas de ajuste, hambre, pobreza y deliberada recesión buscada del gobierno de

Javier Milei

.


El conflicto también se desarrolla en un clima de creciente confrontación política:

SUTEF denunció recientemente ataques contra su secretario general, Horacio Catena, por parte de referentes de La Libertad Avanza en la Legislatura provincial

. El sindicato consideró que las intervenciones realizadas contra su dirigente

buscan “menospreciar la capacidad de decisión del colectivo docente de la provincia”

 y cuestionó que e

l debate sobre el financiamiento educativo se haya convertido en un escenario de agresiones políticas

.


Foto: SUTEF


Mientras tanto,

el paro continuará durante esta semana, durante los días miércoles …

title: Greifvogel stirbt durch Tellereisen: PETA erstattet Anzeige
content:
Wir von PETA Deutschland erhielten Mitte September 2026 eine Meldung über einen jungen

Greifvogel

, der mit einem Tellereisen gefangen und so schwer verletzt worden sei, dass er schließlich habe getötet werden müssen. Die angewandte

Jagdmethode

 ist illegal – wir erstatten daher Anzeige bei den zuständigen Behörden und fordern Konsequenzen. 


Erfahren Sie hier mehr über den Vorfall!


Schockierende Bilder: Greifvogel wurde durch ein Tellereisen schwer verletzt  


Eine erschütternde Meldung aus Buchen im Odenwald im Norden Baden-Württembergs zeigt einmal mehr, welches Leid Tellereisen verursachen können: Anfang September sei ein ansässiger Tierschutzverein, die Tierrettung Odenwald Hohenlohe e.V., gemeinsam mit der Polizei zu einem Einsatz gerufen worden. Auf einem Grundstück hätten die Beteiligten mehrere Tellereisen entdeckt, die um ein in einem Käfig mutmaßlich als Köder gehaltenes Huhn ausgelegt worden seien. Eine der Fallen habe bereits zugeschlagen und einen Greifvogel schwer verletzt: Nach Aussagen der mitteilenden Person habe es sich dabei um einen Bluthabicht, einen jungen Habicht, gehandelt. 


Der Vogel habe so schwere Verletzungen erlitten, dass er aufgrund durchtrennter Sehnen und Muskeln habe nicht mehr gerettet werden können. 


Illegale Jagdmethode: PETA fordert Verbot der grausamen Fallen 


Wir haben am 15. September Strafanzeige bei der Staatsanwaltschaft Mosbach erstattet wegen möglicher Verstöße gegen das Tierschutzgesetz, das Bundesnaturschutzgesetz sowie das Strafgesetzbuch. Zudem haben wir den Fall der Naturschutzbehörde sowie der Unteren Jagdbehörde gemeldet. Wir fordern, die Verantwortlichen schnellstmöglich zur Rechenschaft zu ziehen und sicherzustellen, dass in der Umgebung keine weiteren Schlagfallen aufgestellt wurden.


„Der Tierquäler, der die illegalen Tellereisen ausgelegt hat, muss dringend zur Rechenschaft gezogen werden. Der Vogel hatte sicher unvorstellbare Schmerzen erlitten und panische Angst. Tellereisen sind grausame Fanggeräte, die unermessliches Leid verursachen und nicht nur Tiere, sondern auch Menschen schwer verletzen können. Deshalb müssen auch Kauf und Verkauf dieser gefährlichen Fallen endlich konsequent verboten werden, nicht nur deren Einsatz.“ 

Lisa Redegeld, Fachreferentin bei PETA Deutschland

 


Tellereisen: Grausame Fanggeräte verursachen massives Leid 


Tellereisen verursachen massives Tierleid: Sie schnappen mit enormer Kraft zu und können zu schwersten Verletzungen führen. Tiere, die in die Fallen geraten, leiden häufig stunden- oder sogar tagelang unter extremen Schmerzen und Todesangst. Nicht selten versuchen sie verzweifelt zu entkommen und verletzen sich dabei noch schwerer. 


Tellereisen werden regelmäßig für verschiedene Lebewesen zur tödlichen Gefahr: Neben

Wildtieren

 geraten immer wieder auch

geschützte Tierarten

, Hunde,

Katzen

 oder sogar Menschen in die gefährlichen Fallen. 


Melden Sie Tierquälerei – helfen Sie Gewalt an Tieren zu beenden! 


Wer Tierquälerei beobachtet oder Hinweise zu Fällen wie diesem geben kann, sollte nicht wegsehen. Hinweise können Sie vertraulich über unser Whistleblower-Portal melden.

title: HPJ: Jin, Jiyan, Azadî is the foundation of the women’s century
content:
The Eastern Kurdistan Women’s Defence Forces (HPJ) Command issued a written statement marking the fourth anniversary of the Jin, Jiyan, Azadî (Woman, Life, Freedom) Revolution.


The statement said women across the world, particularly those in Eastern Kurdistan (Rojhilat) and Iran, have taken to the streets and embraced the Jin, Jiyan, Azadî revolution, which developed on the basis of Abdullah Öcalan’s philosophy. It stressed that throughout history, women have refused to submit to the patriarchal system and its policies of massacre, harassment, rape and other forms of inhumane treatment, and that the history of women’s struggle for freedom has deep roots.


The statement said Abdullah Öcalan’s ideas and philosophy had shed light on the reality of women, which had long been kept in darkness, and that society was increasingly reconnecting with its essence and truth on this basis. It continued: “Abdullah Öcalan brought this understanding to life through Jin, Jiyan, Azadî. It was the philosophy of a new and free life. Four years ago, when Kurdish woman Jina Amini was killed by the occupying and genocidal Iranian regime, society rose up under the leadership of women in Eastern Kurdistan and Iran. With the slogan Jin, Jiyan, Azadî, they stood against the patriarchal system embodied by the genocidal regime and demanded accountability.”


The statement said women across the world had created a new momentum of resistance against the patriarchal system through the philosophy of Jin, Jiyan, Azadî, adding that for the first time a philosophy had transcended boundaries of nationality, religion, belief and culture. It argued that both the Iranian regime and the patriarchal system of capitalist modernity had been shaken to their foundations, exposing deep fractures within them and bringing to light realities they had sought to conceal. The statement said, “Humanity has once again understood that the only path and alternative to these dark hegemonic powers and the entire system of capitalist modernity is the paradigm proposed by Abdullah Öcalan on the basis of women’s freedom. The 21st century is therefore the women’s century, and the Jin, Jiyan, Azadî revolution has become one of the turning points that has carried the march for freedom in the history of women’s liberation into a new phase,” 


HPJ said the organised stance that emerged through the actions of the Jin, Jiyan, Azadî revolution, together with its ideological demands and emphasis on self-defence, once again demonstrated the multidimensional character of the revolution and its ability to challenge its opponents on every front. It said forces that felt cornered and regarded the revolution as a major threat had resorted to what it described as immoral methods against women and society, stressing the need to build effective organisation in every sphere of life and intensify the struggle.


HPJ called on all women to defend the gains achieved through Abdullah Öcalan’s vision of a women’s revolution and to embrace the revolution with a spirit of unity, strong organisation and profound commitment in order to achieve victory. The statement described upholding the aims and aspirations of the martyrs who struggled for freedom as a fundamental responsibility and called on women in the streets to build strong self-defence and remain united until the end.

title: KNK to hold conference in Brussels on Kurdish representation at the UN
content:
The issue of Kurdish international representation remains one of the longest-standing problems in Kurdish political history. In the period following the First World War, when the Middle East was reshaped, the Kurds were excluded from the international system and, over the course of nearly a century, remained in fragmented political and legal positions within the borders of different states.


At a time when balances in the Middle East are once again shifting and international diplomacy and institutions are gaining greater importance in terms of regional developments, the representation of the Kurdish people at the United Nations is once again coming to the fore. With the conference to be held in Brussels on 3 October, the Kurdistan National Congress (KNK) aims to develop a common position on the representation of the Kurdish people at the UN, establish cooperation at the national and international levels, and determine the steps to be taken in this direction.


At its 24th General Assembly, held on 6-7 June 2026, the KNK put the issue of Kurdish representation at the UN on its agenda and decided to apply for the Kurdish people to be recognized like other nations and represented as observers in UN-affiliated organizations. The conference in Brussels stands out as an important step following this decision, where the next steps in the process will be discussed and the aim will be to establish a common position on behalf of the Kurds.


In a call issued by the KNK Executive Council regarding the purpose of the conference, the following was stated:


“Much has been said and written about the need for diplomacy and the international representation of the Kurds and the people of Kurdistan. For more than a century, writers and academics have written extensively on this issue, while political party leaders, leaders, politicians and diplomats have spoken about it and carried out work in this area. Likewise, many meetings, consultations, conferences and various initiatives have been held; commissions have been established and institutions created. There has been no shortage of work in this field. However, it is also a fact that, to date, diplomacy has not been conducted with the strength required or at the level the Kurdish people deserve. One of the fundamental problems preventing this is that the Kurdish nation does not have a legal status at the international level and is not represented at that level.


60 million Kurds are not represented in international organizations


The people of Kurdistan have a population of approximately 60 million. Despite such a large population, the Kurds are not represented in international organizations. Particularly at the United Nations, a structure in which almost all nations are represented, there is no representation of the Kurdish nation and its name is not heard.


For this reason, the KNK placed this issue on the agenda of its 24th General Assembly, held on 6-7 June 2026. Following extensive discussions, a decision was taken to apply to the UN so that the Kurds would be recognized like other nations and represented as observers in UN-affiliated organizations, in a status similar to that of the Palestinians.


Letter to UN Secretary-General


To date, meetings have been held with many experts in this field and their views have been sought. In addition, a letter was submitted on behalf of the KNK to UN Secretary-General António Guterres on this issue. However, this is a major and complex matter; it cannot be resolved through a few limited meetings and the submission of a few letters. The KNK cannot undertake this work alone. Cooperation at the national and international levels is needed.


From this perspective, one of the most pressing needs is for leaders, political party leaders, representatives of organizations, influential figures in society, and representatives of all components and sections of Kurdistan society to come together at a high level to address this issue and adopt common decisions. At the same time, the people of Kurdistan must be included and mobilized in this process through meetings, various events and strong campaigns, such as petition drives.


We want to organize a conference with the participation of experts, academics and various prominent figures, as well as representatives of parties, organizations and institutions from Kurdistan, in order to assess the current situation, establish a common position and develop cooperation.


Conference on the representation …

title: Iran Freedom Congress supports general strike in Rojhilatê Kurdistan
content:
The Iran Freedom Congress announced its support for the call by the Alliance of Political Forces of Rojhilatê Kurdistan for a general strike in the cities of Kurdistan on September 16, marking the fourth anniversary of the killing of Jina Amini and the Jin Jiyan Azadî Revolution.


In a written statement, it said: “As written on her gravestone, Jina became immortal, and her name became a symbol. At the funeral ceremony held at the Ayçî Cemetery in the city of Saqiz, the slogan ‘Jin, Jiyan, Azadî’ echoed and became the main slogan of a nationwide serhildan against discrimination and repression. The experience of previous strikes has shown that calls by Kurdish parties rooted in the people have been welcomed by the masses in different cities across Kurdistan. This form of protest was also repeated during the Jin, Jiyan, Azadî serhildan in other cities of Iran. The Iran Freedom Congress considers the general strike a civil and effective step for expressing the people’s demands and resisting repression.”


The statement said that from the suppression of the Jin Jiyan Azadî uprising and the uprisings that preceded it to the unprecedented massacre of people during the January 2026 uprising, the Islamic Republic has resorted to criminal acts to preserve its rule. It continued: “Commemorating the martyrs, following in their footsteps and demanding justice for them cannot be separated from our struggle. Achieving the goals of the Jin Jiyan Azadî Revolution requires the end of the Islamic Republic and the establishment of a multifaceted, protective cultural-democratic system based on human rights, equality and opposition to discrimination.”


The Iran Freedom Congress stated in its declaration that it supports the Alliance of Political Forces of Rojhilatê Kurdistan and considers the call by Kurdish political forces for a general strike across Kurdistan part of the civil struggle for justice and freedom.


The statement concluded: “The Congress will support citizens, civil society and political forces in other regions of Iran according to their local conditions and circumstances and in whatever way they deem appropriate. As the Iran Freedom Congress, we commemorate Martyr Jina Amini and all the martyrs of the revolution and emphasize that we will achieve the goals of the ‘Jin Jiyan Azadî’ revolution.”
